title: Account Director - Financiers
descriptionHtml:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers. We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs. We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?

Purpose of the role

The successful candidate will own Keyloop's relationships with financiers, both captive (OEM-owned) and independent, while maximising client adoption of the Keyloop Retention Hub through a customer retention lens and growing the use of Keyloop's AI-based capabilities within the Retention space. The role is UK-based with a global account book and regular international travel, reporting directly into the Financiers & Fleet Director. The candidate will understand the commercial dynamics of automotive finance and be equally comfortable operating at operational and senior commercial/strategic levels within each financier.


Key Headlines
  • First point of contact for existing and new financier accounts, spanning captive and independent financiers.
  • Own the senior relationship with financiers and grow the Keyloop Retention Hub agenda across their organisations and, where relevant, their dealer networks.
  • Drive adoption of the Keyloop Retention Hub with a specific focus on customer retention outcomes.
  • Lead cross-sell of AI-based capabilities within the Retention space (such as AI video and lead nurture), and identify new client opportunities across the wider Keyloop portfolio.
  • UK-based role with regular international travel; account book is global.
  • Monthly face-to-face team meetings in the UK.

    • Key Duties & Responsibilities
  • Deliver excellent account management across captive and independent financier stakeholders.
  • Maintain weekly dialogue with clients on Keyloop Retention Hub adoption and customer retention outcomes.
  • Build and maintain multi-level relationships within financier organisations (commercial, risk, retention/customer, operations and IT), from operational teams through to senior leadership.
  • Develop and apply a thorough understanding of financier commercial models, the customer ownership lifecycle (including PCP/PCH and trade cycle management) and retention dynamics, and how these intersect with dealer network operations.
  • Support contract renewals and commercial negotiations alongside Legal and the Enterprise Team, including liaison with financier procurement and legal teams.
  • Position the Keyloop Retention Hub and its AI-based capabilities as drivers of customer retention and commercial value in client conversations.
  • Produce Quarterly Review Packs covering retention outcomes, adoption of the Retention Hub and AI-based capabilities, and system development delivered.
  • Collaborate with key financier contacts to understand their short, medium and long-term retention strategies, ensuring Keyloop is the partner of choice.
  • Keep product/sales presentation material and POS assets current and available on shared portals.
  • Feed back market intelligence on competitor retention and AI-based offerings to sharpen internal positioning.

    • Skillset and Experience required
  • Experience within the automotive sector, ideally within automotive finance (captive or independent financier).
  • Direct experience working with captive or independent financiers — understanding of their commercial models, customer lifecycle and retention priorities, and relationships with dealer networks. Financier-side experience is strongly favourable.
  • Thorough understanding of the automotive finance customer lifecycle, including origination, contract management, end-of-contract customer journey, and retention and trade cycle management.
  • Experience selling SaaS/cloud-based solutions.
  • Proven track record in account management, ideally managing senior corporate stakeholders within financiers.
  • User or provider experience with customer retention solutions, ideally within automotive finance.
  • Customer- and outcomes-focused, with the maturity and diplomacy to manage engagement across financier stakeholder levels — from operational through to senior commercial/strategic.
  • Able to implement a professional, structured sales approach using MEDDPIC (Keyloop's preferred sales methodology) — covering Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Paper Process, Identify Pain and Champion — alongside use of Salesforce.
  • Self-driven, ambitious, resilient, highly motivated, competitive, resourceful, excellent communication skills, especially around listening, questioning – politely assertive.
  • Fluency in English is required, and proficiency in another European language — such as French, Spanish, Italian, or German — is preferred.
  • Highly organised within a process-oriented environment. Computer literate and familiarity with SF.com an advantage.
  • Fluency with AI tools such as Claude and Copilot is a plus but not mandatory.
    • Why join us? We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way. An inclusive environment to thrive We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day. Be rewarded for your efforts We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration. Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials. We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. "At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity."

title: Account Executive - Berlin (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung 

Der deutsche Gesundheitsmarkt befindet sich an einem entscheidenden Wendepunkt – und Du digitalisierst ihn, Praxis für Praxis. Als Account Executive (x/f/m) in Berlin führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business und bringst mit unserer KI-gestützten All-in-One Lösung echten Mehrwert direkt in den Praxisalltag. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben. 

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Eigenverantwortlicher Vertrieb: Du begleitest den gesamten Sales-Prozess – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss

  • Umsatz & Wachstum: Du bist verantwortlich für Deine Pipeline, den Umsatz (MRR), Beziehungen und das Wachstum in Deiner Region 

  • Kundenzentrierte Beratung: Du analysierst die Bedürfnisse von Ärzt:innen, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und begeisterst sie mit unserer digitalen Lösung

  • Datengetriebene Erfolgsmessung: Du trackst Deine Performance regelmäßig mit Salesforce und nutzt Daten für eine gezielte Vertriebsstrategie

 

Dein Profil

  • Sales ist Deine Welt: Du hast mindestens 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb (idealerweise im Außendienst und B2B-Bereich)

  • Proaktivität und Akquise-Talent: Du glänzt mit exzellenten Akquise- und Pitching-Skills

  • Energie & Überzeugungskraft: Du hast ein hohes Energielevel, verkaufst mit Leidenschaft und überzeugst mit Deinem sicheren und professionellen Auftreten

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Du bist ergebnisorientiert, hast ein hohes Organisationsgeschick und behältst auch bei Herausforderungen den Fokus

  • Kommunikation auf Top-Niveau: Du kannst Dich sehr gut mündlich und schriftlich auf Deutsch (C1-Niveau oder höher) ausdrücken

    Für unsere internen Trainings, All-Hands und den Austausch mit internationalen Kolleginnen und Kollegen ist es hilfreich, wenn du Englisch gut verstehen kannst. Falls du dich sprachlich noch weiterentwickeln möchtest, unterstützen wir dich gerne mit entsprechenden Lernangeboten. Perfektes Englisch ist keine Voraussetzung. Deine Kundentermine finden auf Deutsch statt.

  • Flexibilität & Mobilität: Dein Vertriebsalltag findet dort statt, wo es zählt: direkt bei Ärzt:innen vor Ort. Ein Führerschein Klasse B ist vorausgesetzt

 

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

 

Was wir Dir bieten 

  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

  • Einen Firmenwagen – auch privat nutzbar, versteuert nach der 1%-Regelung

  • Eine private Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Zusatzleistungen (u.a. Zahnreinigung u.v.m.)

  • 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)

  • Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 %

  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

  • Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das 1 Monat extra Elternzeit u.v.m. enthält

  • Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über unseren externen Partner moka.care

  • Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

 

Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team, das gewinnen will. Du auch? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt und werde Teil der Doctolib-Erfolgsgeschichte! Weitere Informationen zum Arbeitsalltag im Sales bei Doctolib findest Du hier. 

 

Der Interview-Prozess  

  1. Interview mit unserem Talent Team (remote - 25')

  2. Interview mit der/dem Regional Manager:in (Teamlead) (remote - 60')

  3. DoctoDay: Verbringe einige Stunden mit Deinem zukünftigen Team und erhalte einen ersten Einblick in den Job als Account Executive

Job Details

  • Berlin

  • zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt

 

Unsere Philosophie

Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei uns nicht toleriert.

title: Account Executive -DACH
descriptionHtml:
About the team: Reporting to the EMEA Head of Sales, you will be joining a team of Account Executives, located in Paris and whose sole mission is to bring on new customers. This team has been the engine of DataDome exponential growth in the past years: be ready to join a rocket!

You will be expected to collaborate closely with other teams and show great enthusiasm and energy.

DataDome is a full SaaS solution, with a short Sales Cycle that allows new Account Executives to secure deals within their first 3 months after joining the company.

You will be responsible for generating new ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) by bringing on new enterprise customers.

As the Enterprise Account Executive for DACH, you will be more specifically in charge of things like..

#1 Originate and grow a strong and balanced pipeline on the Assigned Territory:

  • From your own hunting efforts on targeted accounts.
  • From the highly qualified leads delivered by our Growth team & BDR team
  • From the highly qualified leads delivered by our Partners.

#2 Ensuring high conversion rates for your leads and opportunities

  • Make sure the leads and prospects are qualified following DataDome step by step Customer Journey. We use MEDDPICC as a framework to qualify our opportunities.
  • Follow the company playbooks and guidelines, as well as established peers’ best practices and proactively find new creative solutions.
  • Keep detailed track records of your progress and gather all relevant information in the CRM (we use Salesforce)

#3 Carrying out negotiations and closing deals.

  • Grow a deep understanding the prospects pain points, expectations and desired ROI (#MEDDPICC)
  • Use the Free Trial as an opportunity to dig deeper and demonstrate DataDome added value
  • Leverage DataDome offering to reach mutually beneficial agreements

It would be great if…

  • You have a Bachelor degree or equivalent.
  • You have at least 5 years SaaS solution Sales experience in Enterprise B2B with a track record of exceeding sales quotas.
  • You are a Hunter and enjoy getting your own leads
  • You are Fluent in German and English - any other European language is a plus
  • You are eager to learn, and have a great ability to adapt in a constantly evolving and fast-paced environment.

Bonus Points

  • Bot Management

What’s in it for you?

  • Paris-based (preferred)
  • Generous Health Benefits: Employees are covered by statutory health insurance (or private insurance if eligible), with contributions shared between employee and employer.
  • Social Security: Full coverage under the German social security system, including statutory pension insurance, unemployment insurance, and long-term care insurance, with contributions shared between employee and employer.
  • Work Accident Insurance : Full coverage for work-related accidents and occupational diseases, 100% covered by the employer.
  • Professional Development: #Growth is part of our DNA, therefore we provide an annual stipend to invest in yourself.
  • Events & Teambuilding: Feel the #TeamSpirit both virtually & onsite, with several events & workshops planned throughout the year, including two annual offsite events, summer & winter parties, lunch & learns, & much more.
  • Parent Care: Gift & care packages for parents. Employees also benefit from mandatory parental leave and job protection in line with local regulations.
  • PTO : Includes a minimum of 20 paid vacation days per year (based on a 5-day work week), plus public holidays.

What are the next steps?

  • You x Talent Acquisition Manager - a first interview allows you, and us, to make sure your profile and motivations fit with our expectations for the job and DataDome company culture.
  • You x Head of Sales EMEA & APAC - you will then meet our Head of Sales EMEA & APAC and assess together how your experience and skill set will allow you to outperform in this role.
  • You x Extended Team Panel - Take-home assessment & Presentation - you will be provided with a real-life case study, something very similar to what you’ll be facing on a daily basis as a DataDome Account Executive. Once done, you’ll have a presentation of your work and a feedback session with one of our Sales exec.
  • You x Member of the leadership team - the closeness of the teams and a shared culture are central to DataDome’s success. You meet a member of our leadership team to make sure DataDome is the right setting for you to thrive.
  • Welcome to DataDome :)

About DataDome:

DataDome delivers real-time bot and agent trust management, giving businesses complete visibility and control over all traffic—human, bot, or AI. Named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™ for Bot Management, DataDome is trusted by enterprises like Etsy, PayPal, and Soundcloud. Acting as a traffic control plane, DataDome's multi-layered AI engine leverages thousands of models and 5 trillion signals daily to analyze intent and stop fraud in under 2 milliseconds—letting legitimate users through seamlessly across websites, apps, APIs, and MCPs. Backed by a 24/7 SOC and expert threat researchers, DataDome stops 20k+ attacks every second. With 30+ global PoPs, and 50+ ready-made integrations, DataDome is a recognized Leader on G2 across several categories—delivering protection that outperforms.

DataDome is an equal opportunity employer, and proud to be committed to diversity and inclusion. We will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability or age.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications or analyzing resumes. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

descriptionHtml:
About Agicap Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France. Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies. We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024. These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world. We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure! Home page Customer Stories Our Values

About the Account Executive - SMB role:

We are growing our team in Düsseldorf! Working closely with the Business Development team, Outbound SDRs, Inbound SDRs and Partnership Managers on a daily basis, your mission will be to generate new business by acquiring new clients.

As an SMB Account Executive at Agicap, you will drive sales and expand our customer base within the SMB segment. You will play a crucial role in identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with potential clients and closing deals in order to achieve your sales targets.


You will be responsible for:
  • Defining and implementing a sectoral development strategy with your SDRs.
  • Identifying and targeting SMB companies that could benefit from Agicap’s financial management solutions.

  • Building and nurturing relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers within target organizations.
  • Negotiating contracts and closing sales to meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.
  • Staying informed about industry developments, competitor activities, and market trends.
  • Regularly monitoring and analyzing your performance with Management to identify areas for improvement.
  • Providing feedback to the Marketing, Business Development, and Product teams to improve processes and the product.
  • Sharing your commercial expertise and good ideas to enhance the team’s performance.

    • What we are looking for:
  • Native/Bilingual level of German
  • 2-4 years of experience in B2B Sales, preferably in the SaaS industry and with mid-market space, and with some experience working in a finance department/audit/consulting/TS.
  • Studies background in a top business or Engineering school.
  • A passion for sales and a proven track record of meeting and exceeding targets.
  • A tenacious, resilient salesperson who never gives up and is driven by results.
  • Someone who can put themselves in the shoes of business leaders to understand their current and future cash flow needs.
  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, excellent verbal communication, and a high level of intellectual curiosity.
  • Great ambition, with the drive to meet and even exceed objectives.
  • A strong business acumen and above-average interpersonal skills.
  • A team spirit and a desire to share knowledge, helping colleagues grow.

    • 7 Reasons to Join Agicap as an AE:
  • Exceptional product-market fit, confirmed by our latest funding round:
  • Crucial need → cash = the lifeblood of business, top priority for CFOs (PwC)
  • Strongly differentiated solution, leader in Europe (G2)
  • Gigantic market: over 350k companies in DACH alone
  • Unique company culture: meritocracy, high standards, continuous learning, European scale-up (>50% revenue outside France)
  • Opportunities for functional and geographical growth
  • Strong financial situation
  • Team of rockstars, friendly and skilled
  • A growth engine of a large Outbound SDR team, Inbound & Partner leads to help you scale fast!
  • Competitive package - with uncapped commissions!

    • Our benefits:
    - Competitive Compensation: Attractive package including both fixed and variable components. - Professional Development: Access a “Mini-MBA” with a focus on Finance & Treasury via the Agicap Academy. - Global Collaboration: Join a diverse international team with occasional trips to our headquarters in France. - Meal & Grocery Allowance: Receive up to €108/month tax-free for lunch or groceries, easily managed via the Hrmony app. - Tenure Rewards: Enjoy a €30 monthly shopping voucher after one year and up to two additional vacation days based on your length of service. - Team culture: Join us and be part of a dynamic environment, enjoying global offsites such as our recent annual seminar on a French island, as well as local team events. AGICAP is committed to providing equal opportunities for everyone, and we foster an inclusive work environment that values diversity!

title: Account Executive - Enterprise (London)
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE
Enterprise at Baseten means the companies with the most to gain from AI and the most complexity in getting there: large digital natives running products at massive scale, and category leaders in software, financial services, healthcare, and beyond. They have the data, the distribution, and the budget. Most are still deciding what to build, what to run themselves, and what it should cost.

That makes this a consultative sale. You'll spend as much time helping a VP of Engineering pressure-test their AI strategy as you will selling against an alternative, mapping use cases, framing build-vs-buy, and giving clear recommendations grounded in what you've seen work at the frontier. Then you'll do the enterprise work: multithreading across a buying committee, navigating security and procurement, and turning a first workload into an eight-figure relationship.

You'll work alongside our founders, forward-deployed engineers, and GTM leadership, in a seat where the playbook is still being written.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own a revenue target end to end, from prospecting and outbounding through closing Tier 1 accounts in your verticals

  • Act as a strategic advisor on AI adoption: identify use cases, shape architecture decisions, and lead with clear, opinionated recommendations

  • Multithread across large organizations, from the engineers running evals to the executives funding the program to security, legal, and procurement

  • Win lighthouse customers that become references for their entire industry

  • Partner with forward-deployed engineering on technical evaluations, POCs, and architecture reviews

  • Feed signal back to product and engineering. What enterprises need next is a roadmap input we don't get anywhere else

REQUIREMENTS

  • 8+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience in technology, ideally infrastructure, API/platform, or developer tooling

  • A track record of closing seven- and eight-figure deals by navigating multi-stakeholder buying committees and long, complex cycles

  • Demonstrated ability to run a consultative sale. You've helped customers define a strategy, not just evaluate a product

  • Strong technical acumen: you can hold your own on model serving, GPU infrastructure, latency, and API architecture

  • Experience selling into large digital natives or regulated industries (financial services, healthcare/life sciences, insurance, government)

  • Excellent communication and comfort with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment

NICE TO HAVE

  • Direct experience selling AI/ML infrastructure, cloud compute, or model deployment platforms

BENEFITS

  • Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

  • (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

  • Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

  • (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

  • Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).

descriptionHtml:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We’re building the next chapter of AI-native craft and creativity - where craft and technology meet. Our unified platform bridges the gap between AI capabilities and human creativity, and lets professional creatives and designers harness the power of the world’s leading AI models without losing precision, expression, or soul. Together, we’re building tools that help people move faster without sacrificing quality, precision, or craft — a platform where AI supports creativity instead of flattening it.

We are looking for Account Executives who are excited to help creative teams explore what’s possible with generative AI. Figma Weave is a startup within Figma, and you will play a key role in winning new business while helping contribute to how our team sells. You will work closely with Figma Account Executives and cross-functional partners to understand customer needs, demonstrate relevant workflows, and guide opportunities from first conversation through close. This is an opportunity to get hands-on with a fast-evolving product, work with exciting logos as they embrace GenAI, and help shape a growing team.

This is a full time role that is based in our London hub.

What you’ll do at Figma Weave:

  • Create and manage a pipeline of new business through outbound prospecting, inbound engagement, and Figma AE introductions to consistently exceed sales targets
  • Prioritize your book and time to focus on top priorities amongst change
  • Apply effective discovery and value-selling techniques to uncover business challenges, build relationships with key decision-makers, and connect Weave to customer priorities
  • Partner with your customers through demos to help identify high business priority use-cases and inspire what’s possible in Weave. Build your product knowledge through hands-on use of Weave
  • Manage proposals, business cases, and negotiations, partnering with legal, procurement, finance, Figma sellers, and security teams to move deals forward
  • Collaborate with customer success and workflow advocates to prepare thoughtful handoffs and identify opportunities for customers to grow with Weave
  • Maintain accurate pipeline and forecasts, share customer feedback, and help develop sales practices and resources as the product and team evolve

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • Experience managing the full sales cycle from high-growth startups to F1000 companies, including prospecting, discovery, negotiation, and close
  • A track record of exceeding sales goals and generating your own pipeline of new business
  • Demonstrated experience using discovery to connect customer challenges to business value
  • Experience learning a technical product and delivering customer demos that explain its value and capabilities
  • Excited by working with other sellers and cross-functional partners to manage customer opportunities and buying processes

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience working in creative industries and/or selling to creative teams
  • Worked at startup in hypergrowth
  • Familiarity with post-production, VFX, Film, creative workflows, or Figma / Weave itself

At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to

By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with Figma's Candidate Privacy Notice.

title: Account Executive, Portworx, FSI (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure is seeking a Strategic Accounts Account Executive to accelerate growth of the Portworx platform across Strategic FSI accounts in EMEA. You will own a small number of named FSI customers and prospects, build and execute multi-year account plans, and drive platform adoption with a focus on business outcomes such as resilience, risk reduction, faster application delivery and operational efficiency.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams across Everpure and Portworx, including Systems Engineering, Customer Experience, Marketing, Partner teams, Product and field leadership. This is a high-impact individual contributor role with a strong emphasis on strategic planning, disciplined execution and customer intimacy.

Location: Paris (preferred) or Staines, UK

What You’ll Do

  • Own and grow a portfolio of named Strategic FSI accounts, delivering against annual and multi-year revenue targets.
  • Build and execute account plans that map buying centres, application priorities, Kubernetes roadmaps and transformation programmes.
  • Develop executive relationships across CIO, CTO, CISO, Head of Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, SRE and Application leaders.
  • Lead complex sales cycles from discovery through close, including security, risk, procurement, architecture review and legal processes.
  • Position Portworx around measurable outcomes: application resilience, ransomware recovery, data protection, regulatory compliance, cloud portability and modernisation at scale.
  • Orchestrate account teams and partner ecosystems, including GSIs, cloud providers and regional partners, to drive pipeline creation and deal execution.
  • Run a rigorous, value-based sales process tailored to cloud native software, with accurate forecasting and strong hygiene in Salesforce and forecasting tools.
  • Partner with Customer Experience to expand adoption post-sale, identify expansion triggers and build customer advocacy within the FSI community.
  • Stay ahead of competitive dynamics in Kubernetes data services, backup and recovery, and container storage, using insights to sharpen strategy and messaging.
  • Represent Portworx in customer meetings and relevant industry events, with a field-first mindset.

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven enterprise software sales or customer-facing solutions architecture experience, with a track record of winning and expanding high-value, multi-stakeholder deals in large organisations.
  • Demonstrable experience selling into FSI, with an understanding of procurement, governance, risk and security requirements.
  • Strong grasp of cloud native concepts and the Kubernetes ecosystem, such as OpenShift, Rancher or similar platforms, plus the ability to credibly engage architects and platform teams.
  • Experience selling to both technical and executive stakeholders, translating technical capabilities into business value and risk outcomes.
  • Disciplined pipeline generation, qualification, deal management and forecasting, with strong operational habits in Salesforce.
  • Comfort working in a matrixed environment, influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Strong communication and programme management skills, with clear account planning and stakeholder alignment.
  • A customer-first mindset and a bias for action, with resilience and curiosity.
  • Fluent in French and English. Spanish would be a bonus.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

descriptionHtml:
Het team en de functie

Binnen ons Banking & Finance team werken we op dit moment met zeven advocaten. We begeleiden transacties, adviseren over financieel toezichtrecht en staan cliënten bij in procedures over onder andere zorgplicht en verhaal. Dat doen we voor banken, verzekeraars, fondsen, leasemaatschappijen, factoraars en grotere bedrijven. Samen met ons Herstructuring & Insolventie-team staan we ook bedrijven met een herstructureringsvraagstuk en hun stakeholders zijn.

Ons team wordt erkend als toonaangevende praktijk in de internationale ranglijsten Legal500 en Chambers and Partners. In het afgelopen jaar heeft ons team voor meer dan EUR 8 miljard aan financieringen naar closing begeleid.

Ter ondersteuning en uitbreiding van onze praktijk zijn we op zoek naar een juridisch medewerker en/of beginnend advocaat-stagiair. Als juridisch medewerker begin je in eerste instantie op fulltime basis, met de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar de functie van advocaat-stagiaire. De functie is opgezet voor een periode van twee tot vier maanden, afhankelijk van het mogelijke startmoment van de beroepsopleiding. Als advocaat-stagiaire streven we ernaar om je op te leiden tot een succesvolle advocaat. Je krijgt onder begeleiding van ervaren collega's snel verantwoordelijkheden en speelt een zelfstandige rol in dossiers.

In jouw functie ben je bezig met het coördineren van transacties, het opstellen van besluiten, zekerheden, leningsovereenkomsten en andere transactiedocumenten en het adviseren op het gebied van financiering en zekerheden. Je hebt veel interactie met cliënten en andere adviseurs. De transactiepraktijk is internationaal en altijd in beweging. Daarom werk je altijd samen met onze ervaren advocaten, die je ondersteunen in je ontwikkeling.

Wij bieden

  • Een inspirerende werkomgeving met veel aandacht voor persoonlijke verhoudingen en samenwerking

  • Alle ruimte om je persoonlijk en professioneel verder te ontwikkelen, onder andere door onze VBK Academy en de mogelijkheid tot het volgen van een specialisatieopleiding

  • Uitstekende doorgroeimogelijkheden en de kans om je wetenschappelijk te ontwikkelen, bijvoorbeeld door te doceren en door het schrijven van publicaties

  • Ruime gelegenheid om je collega's te leren kennen tijdens de vele sociale activiteiten, zoals de wekelijkse donderdagmiddagborrel, sportactiviteiten, uitjes en kantoorfeesten

  • Een marktconform salaris en breed pakket aan secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een Microsoft Copilot+ laptop, iPhone, NS-businesscard of mobiliteitsbudget en fietsplanregeling.


Wij zoeken een collega die

  • Aantoonbaar geïnteresseerd is in financiering en zekerheden en de transactiepraktijk

  • Sociaal, proactief, servicegericht en analytisch is

  • In staat is om cliënten op een praktische en doeltreffende wijze bij te staan

  • Zowel in teamverband als zelfstandig goed kan werken

  • De Engelse taal op een goed niveau beheerst

Zo maken wij Legal

Onze medewerkers zijn gedreven, altijd in beweging en verbinden zich met elkaar, onze cliënten en met de maatschappij. Niet voor niets verkozen zakelijke beslissers ons al drie keer tot beste juridisch dienstverlener (2019, 2021, 2023) van Nederland (MT1000).

In ons vakgebied betekent stilstand achteruitgang. We bieden je daarom alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en te ontplooien. Vakinhoudelijk, maar ook qua soft skills. Tegelijkertijd is er meer dan werk alleen. Onze successen vieren we daarom samen en we hechten veel waarde aan onze onderlinge verbinding. Zo blijven we individueel en als team in beweging om samen de beste resultaten te behalen. Want samen maken wij legal.

Maak jij Legal met ons?

title: Agent administratif SAV
descriptionHtml:
Le Groupe Cybertek

Le Groupe Cybertek est un acteur majeur dans le secteur de la vente de matériel informatique et High-Tech en France. Créé en 1996, son siège social et ses plateformes logistiques se trouvent à Bordeaux. Cybertek possède 28 magasins sous les enseignes Cybertek et Grosbill, ainsi que cinq sites de commerce en ligne. Employant 250 personnes, Cybertek a réussi à atteindre un chiffre d'affaires annuel de plus de 100 millions d'euros en s’appuyant sur des équipes dynamiques et soudées. Le Groupe Cybertek affirme son engagement en faveur de l’égalité professionnelle entre les femmes et les hommes et veille à promouvoir un environnement de travail inclusif, notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap.

Vos missions :

Gestion et suivi administratif des dossiers SAV :

· Créer, suivre et mettre à jour les dossiers SAV dans les outils métiers du service, notamment REVERS.IO ;

· Assurer le suivi des statuts, informations et échanges liés aux dossiers dans REVERS.IO ;

· Vérifier les éléments nécessaires au traitement des dossiers : factures, numéros de série, descriptions de panne, accessoires, photos, états des produits.

· Assurer le suivi administratif des dossiers RMA, PAD, échanges, avoirs et réparations. ;

· Effectuer les demandes de prise en charge auprès des fournisseurs, assurer le suivi des accords, refus, échanges, avoirs et réparations fournisseurs ;

· Garantir la traçabilité et la mise à jour des statuts des dossiers dans les outils internes ;

· Respecter les procédures internes ainsi que les procédures spécifiques à chaque fournisseur.

Suivi opérationnel des dossiers et coordination des flux SAV :

· Assurer le suivi des retours produits et des enlèvements transporteurs ;

· Collaborer avec le pôle Logistique SAV concernant les flux entrants et sortants des produits ;

· Travailler en coordination avec le service Logistique / Stock pour le suivi des mouvements de produits ;

· Assurer la bonne transmission des informations nécessaires au pôle Technique SAV dans le cadre des diagnostics et réparations ;

· Participer au suivi des dossiers complexes nécessitant une coordination entre les différents pôles du SAV ;

· Veiller à la bonne circulation des informations liées aux dossiers SAV.

Communication et collaboration transversale :

· Collaborer quotidiennement avec les différents pôles du service SAV ;

· Maintenir une communication régulière avec le service Relation Client afin d’assurer le suivi des demandes clients et la cohérence des informations transmises ;

· Répondre aux demandes des magasins, fournisseurs et autres services internes ;

· Assurer la remontée des anomalies, retards ou difficultés rencontrées dans le traitement des dossiers ;

· Appliquer les consignes et recommandations transmises par la Cheffe d’Équipe Administratif SAV.

Respect des procédures et qualité de traitement :

· Appliquer les procédures internes et fournisseurs ;

· Garantir la qualité et la fiabilité des informations saisies ;

· Respecter les délais de traitement et les priorités définies ;

· Assurer un traitement rigoureux et organisé des dossiers ;

· Signaler les anomalies ou blocages rencontrés à la hiérarchie ;

· Participer au maintien de la qualité de service du SAV.

Outils, suivi et amélioration continue :

· Utiliser les logiciels métiers et outils SAV mis à disposition ;

· Participer à la mise à jour et à la fiabilisation des données SAV ;

· Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des méthodes de traitement et de suivi des dossiers ;

· Respecter les bonnes pratiques d’utilisation des outils et procédures internes ;

· Participer à la bonne organisation administrative du service.

Profil recherché

Vous disposez idéalement d’une première expérience en gestion administrative, en service après-vente (SAV). Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques et êtes à l’aise avec le suivi de dossiers, la saisie de données et la gestion des échanges avec différents interlocuteurs. Rigoureux(se) et organisé(e), vous savez assurer le suivi administratif des dossiers SAV, contrôler la fiabilité des informations et veiller au respect des procédures internes et fournisseurs. Réactif(ve) et méthodique, vous êtes capable de gérer les priorités, de respecter les délais et de suivre plusieurs dossiers simultanément. Doté(e) d’un bon relationnel, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez collaborer avec différents services afin de garantir une bonne circulation des informations. Votre sens du service, votre autonomie et votre capacité d’adaptation vous permettent d’assurer un traitement fiable et efficace des demandes. Si vous vous reconnaissez dans ce profil, n’hésitez plus à postuler chez Cybertek !

Rémunération

La rémunération proposée pour ce poste est de EUR 1,867.02–1,868 par mois.

Avantages

Vous bénéficiez d'un parking gratuit ainsi que d'un accompagnement par le biais du mentorat.

title: Agentic Marketing Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Growth at Private Equity Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.

title: AI Research Scientist
descriptionHtml:
About the Science and AI Team

The Science and AI team is at the heart of Maki People. It builds the science and AI behind our platform, from job analysis and assessments to AI interviews and predicting performance. Led by our Head of Science, Aiden Loe, and working closely with our COO, Paul-Louis Caylar, the team brings together business psychologists, psychometricians and AI scientists. Together, they make sure every hiring decision on our platform is accurate, consistent and fair.

As Maki grows, the Science and AI team’s job is to show, with evidence, that our approach leads to better hiring decisions.

About the Role

The AI Research Scientist works at the intersection of AI, psychometrics and research, ensuring that Maki’s automated scoring systems are scientifically robust, fair, and continuously improving.

1. Evaluating and testing LLMs for scoring

  • Assess the accuracy and reliability of LLMs used for automated scoring, such as structured grids, job-specific skills and multilingual proficiency (written and spoken).

  • Benchmark closed- and open-source models across assessment types and languages.

  • Test robustness to prompt variation, input noise and adversarial behaviour such as prompt injection.

  • Explore prompt engineering and model optimisation, and recommend which models and prompts go into production.

2. Building our own scoring models

  • Move our scoring onto self-hosted open-weight models, and fine-tune them on expert-rated data where they can beat frontier models.

  • Check every model switch keeps accuracy, reliability and fairness at least as good as today's.

3. Comparing AI with human judgement, and calibrating psychometric models

  • Design studies that compare AI scores with expert ratings, against both individual experts and expert averages, to establish agreement and validity.

  • Develop hybrid scoring pipelines with engineering that combine human oversight with AI scoring.

  • Evaluate and calibrate psychometric models for validity and comparability across populations and test forms.

4. Bias and fairness analysis

  • Detect and analyse bias in AI-generated and psychometric scores across demographic groups, including subgroup analysis.

  • Apply mitigation techniques such as reweighting and calibration without losing model performance.

  • Contribute to fairness dashboards and compliance documentation that support transparent model governance.

5. Predictive analytics and performance insights

  • Model the relationship between candidate scores and job performance and retention, using large assessment and performance datasets.

  • Develop and test models that estimate success probabilities or identify behavioural and linguistic predictors of performance.

  • Work with data science, implementation and customer success teams to turn findings into recommendations for clients and colleagues.

6. Research output

  • Publish reports, papers and conference presentations, internal and external.

  • Explain technical findings clearly to non-technical colleagues and clients.

As one of Maki People's early employees, you'll help shape the team's future.

Our Ideal Candidate

Required

  • PhD or MSc in machine learning, computational linguistics, data science or psychology.

  • A track record of publications, such as peer-reviewed papers or conference papers.

  • Hands-on experience evaluating LLMs: designing benchmarks, measuring agreement with human raters, and testing consistency and robustness of model output.

  • Experience testing AI-driven decisions for fairness and bias.

  • Proficiency in Python or R, with experience in statistical analysis.

  • Clear communication of results to scientific and business audiences.

Preferred

  • Experience with NLP techniques for automated scoring.

  • Experience fine-tuning language models, for example with LoRA.

  • Experience working with cloud databases and large datasets.

  • Working knowledge of psychometric concepts such as reliability, validity and IRT, and how they apply to assessment design and validation.

  • Working knowledge of ethical AI, data governance and compliance, such as the EU AI Act.

  • Experience working with engineering, product and content teams.

Application Process

  • Stage 1 - Screening assessment (25 min)

  • Stage 2 - Power skill assessment with our AI agent (15 min)

  • Stage 3 - Hiring manager interview (45 min)

  • Stage 4 - Executive interview (45 min)

  • Stage 5 - Deep-dive technical interview (60 min)

  • Stage 6 - Interview with Co-founder (30 min)

you will build some of the first AI-for-cyberdefense systems deployed in real government and defense environments, on frontier models you can influence. title: Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why AssemblyAI

AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. We have a lab, and we also power our own models in our own proprietary inference environment. Our models serve 500M+ inference calls monthly, and process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we're looking for the best talent we can find to join a rapidly scaling team that's defining the future of the industry.

We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - and are rapidly approaching $1M ARR per employee. We sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. We have thousands of customers building with us including the top startups and world-renowned enterprises, and are serving at tremendous scale: we process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily and handle more than 15 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven, the revenue is durable, and the growth trajectory is steep and getting steeper. We have a super flat culture and expect our employees to be deeply intimate with the details at all levels.

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.

About the role

Applied AI Engineers are the technical half of every deal at AssemblyAI. You'll partner with two Digital Native Account Executives and own the technical side of their book: from the first conversation with customers, to helping them win technical evaluations, to driving successful technical implementations.

Our digital native customers are the fastest-growing AI companies building with voice: voice agents, AI notetakers, dictation, and conversation intelligence. They move fast and test on their own, so speed matters at every step.

This is pre-sales engineering, but far more hands-on than a typical SE role. You'll write code for customers, build MVPs, debug their integrations, tune our models on their real audio, and do whatever it takes to make sure customers have successful implementations. Your AE owns the business case and the commercials. You own the developer and the technical work, and together you make customers happy and get them scaled up.

What you'll do

Customer-facing technical work

  • Join early, often on the first call, and become the developer's direct line to AssemblyAI in a shared communication channel (often Slack)
  • Help our customers evaluate and test our products: get their success criteria up front, help them design fair benchmarks, and catch mistakes (wrong model, bad truth files, misconfigured streams) early
  • Tweak configurations and help customers design robust implementations for their unique use cases
  • Build demos, prototypes, and proofs of concept in the customer's stack
  • Debug customer code and production issues across our streaming and async APIs
  • Stay close to the customer, earn their technical trust, and deliver first-class service that turns them into champions
  • Work collaboratively with your AEs on every account
  • Meet customers in person, including flying around the world to work with them onsite
  • Stay with the customer through production rollout, then hand off cleanly to our post-sale Forward Deployed Engineers

Product and roadmap influence

  • Influence our roadmap by bringing what you hear from customers to Product, Research, and Engineering, and test new models and features before customers see them
  • Turn customer issues into reproducible cases for Research and Engineering, and track patterns across accounts
  • Contribute to docs, guides, and example code that help developers integrate faster

Community and events

  • Represent AssemblyAI at Voice AI meetups, conferences, and customer events
  • Build developer-facing resources that are shared publicly

What you'll need

  • A strong technical foundation: an engineering degree, a coding bootcamp, a software engineering role, or a sales or solutions engineering role
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript/JavaScript, and the ability to read and debug code in other languages
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; you'll write customer Slack messages, emails, and technical guides every day
  • Experience with web APIs, WebSockets, and real-time data streaming
  • An understanding of audio fundamentals (sample rates, encodings, codecs), or the drive to learn them quickly
  • Fluency with AI tools like Claude or Cursor to prototype, debug, and solve problems fast
  • A high sense of urgency and persistence
  • Comfort with ambiguity and context-switching: you can take a vague problem, figure out what matters, and drive it to resolution, while keeping many customers and priorities moving at once
  • Must be based in San Francisco, London, or New York City, with an expectation of 3 days a week in-office attendance, and willing to travel roughly 10–25% of the time for customer visits, events, and team offsites

Nice to have

  • Experience at a startup or API-first company
  • Customer-facing experience as a solutions engineer, sales engineer, or developer advocate
  • Hands-on work with voice agent frameworks (LiveKit, Pipecat) or speech models
  • Public speaking or community involvement

Pay transparency

Salary determinations consider a variety of factors, including relevant experience, technical depth, skills demonstrated during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. title: Assistant Financial Controller
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Reporting to our Financial Controller, you’ll own month-end for Flock’s finance team and strengthen the controls around it, running the close and producing the variance analysis and MI that FP&A and our senior team use for budgeting and reporting. We’re automating finance on our new platform and the team uses AI every day, so there’s plenty of room to improve how the work gets done as well as doing it.

It suits a recently qualified accountant with strong core accounting from practice, who has already improved a process or control somewhere and wants to keep growing within the finance team.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the month-end close from start to finish so it lands accurately and on time.

  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and post journals, keeping the ledger clean and well evidenced.

  • Run variance analysis and build the monthly MI pack, explaining what moved and why.

  • Strengthen our financial controls and automate manual steps wherever you find them.

  • Prepare our VAT returns and assist with group reporting.

  • Work with FP&A so the numbers behind budgets and senior reporting are right.

  • Support the annual audit and work alongside our external auditors.

  • Use AI tools in your daily work to speed up reconciliations, analysis and reporting, and share what works with the team.

  • Pick up ad hoc finance projects, including R&D tax claims if you have the experience.

 

What you’ll need

  • An ACA qualification, ideally recently qualified, although we’ll also consider strong ACCA or CIMA candidates.

  • A practice background with hands-on month-end experience, whether from non-audit client work or time in industry. Big 4 or not makes no difference to us.

  • Solid core accounting and close attention to detail, including balance sheet reconciliations, journals and variance analysis.

  • Experience strengthening financial controls or improving a finance process, with an example you can talk us through.

  • Curiosity and ambition, with the drive to push things forward and keep learning.

  • An interest in AI. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should already be using it at work or in your own time and want to do more with it.

Nice to have:

  • Audit experience.

  • Experience using NetSuite.

  • Experience automating finance processes.

  • Exposure to R&D tax claims.

  • Experience in the tech sector.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

 

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

title: B2B Marketing Graduate at SetSales
descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people? If so, you might be our next B2B Marketing Graduate.

About us

SetSales is Northern Europe’s leading sales community and aims to connect and develop commercially-minded executives, decision makers in sales, and aspiring entrepreneurs. We are connecting more than 4,000 professionals from more than 15 countries every year.

SetSales is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. 

What we offer you

As our B2B Marketing Graduate you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our content. You’ll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • Opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.
  • Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Email marketing: Manage copywriting, graphics, strategy and optimisation for our newsletter, product updates and exclusive promotions.
  • Social media growth management: Manage and grow our LinkedIn - our largest channel to interact with our audience - and frequently test new content formats. We would also like you to help us leverage our content on YouTube and launch our Twitter.
  • Graphic design: You will be responsible for our visual identity across all of our marketing channels. We will make sure you’re equipped to do this in the best way possible.
  • Website: Design, SEO activities, UX optimisation. Work with us on improving and launching new formats that reflect our brand identity.
  • Analytics: To continuously measure and improve our performance metrics across channels. You will be working towards challenging targets and KPIs.
  • Paid advertising and PPC campaign management.
  • Synergy: To collaborate with the other departments to identify content worth sharing with our audience, and also to inform them of our brands’ progress.

What we expect from you

Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit. We also expect candidates to have obtained a bachelors or masters degree, or to be working towards obtaining university qualification.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;
  • Possess and unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;
  • Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;
  • Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;
  • Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.

Startdate

Flexible 

The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Buckingham Gate. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.

title: Backend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Das ist kein gewöhnlicher Job. Wir arbeiten an dem, was unsere Gesellschaft zukunftsfähig macht: Bildung. Dafür bauen wir paddy, das Agentic Operating System für Teaching & Learning.

Unsere Mission ist es, Lehrkräfte zu entlasten, Lernergebnisse zu verbessern und die Unterrichtsqualität zu steigern.

Tausende Lehrkräfte und hunderttausende Lernende nutzen paddy bereits. Mit starken Investoren im Rücken wachsen wir schnell. Unsere Ambition ist es, den europäischen AI-Player für Bildung zu bauen.

Als Backend Engineer liegt dein Schwerpunkt auf Backend-Engineering und Architektur. Du konzipierst APIs, Datenmodelle und Services und verantwortest sie vom Verständnis des Nutzerproblems bis zum Betrieb in Production. Bei Bedarf bringst du Features auch bis zur UI und behältst so das gesamte Produkt im Blick.

Aufgaben

  • Backend-Architektur gestalten: Du entwickelst die APIs, Services und Datenmodelle, auf denen paddy aufbaut.
  • End-to-End shippen: Du übernimmst Features vom technischen Konzept über Backend und UI bis zum Deployment und dem Feedback aus dem Einsatz.
  • Infrastruktur und DevOps verantworten: Du entwickelst unsere Cloud-Infrastruktur und Deployment-Prozesse weiter und sorgst für einen zuverlässigen Betrieb.
  • KI ins Produkt bringen: Du integrierst KI-Funktionen in robuste Produkt-Workflows und arbeitest dafür eng mit Product und Design zusammen.
  • Engineering-Bar heben: Du stärkst Testing, Observability und IT-Sicherheit und steuerst technische Schulden bewusst.

Qualifikation

  • Backend und Architektur: Du hast Erfahrung mit dem Entwurf und Betrieb komplexer Backend-Systeme, APIs und Datenmodelle.
  • Full-Stack-Kompetenz: Du kannst Features über Backend und Frontend hinweg umsetzen und bis in die Nutzung begleiten.
  • Infrastructure und DevOps: Du hast Cloud-Infrastruktur und produktive Deployments betrieben und bringst Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code und Container-Orchestrierung mit.
  • KI-Kompetenz: Du hast KI-Funktionen in Produkte integriert und kannst ihre Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit im Betrieb beurteilen.
  • Ownership und Engineering-Qualität: Du arbeitest pragmatisch, denkst an Sicherheit und Qualität und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Features.
  • Sprachen: Fließend Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch.

Unser Tech Stack

  • Full-stack TypeScript: Next.js, Drizzle, Postgres
  • Web: Next.js, Tailwind, Zod
  • Mobile: React Native, Expo, EAS, React Query
  • AI: Vercel AI SDK, promptfoo, LiteLLM, Arize Phoenix, pgVector
  • Infra: DigitalOcean, Scaleway, Open Telekom Cloud, Azure
  • DevOps: Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, Cilium

Benefits

  • Sichtbaren Impact: Du arbeitest am wichtigsten Zukunftsthema unserer Gesellschaft, der Bildung.
  • 70.000 bis 100.000 € Bruttojahresgehalt, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung, plus Equity (VSOP).
  • 100 % Remote-Arbeit. Wenn du lieber ins Büro kommst, steht dir unser modernes Office in Bielefeld offen.
  • Großen Gestaltungsspielraum und Ownership sowie direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Foundern und einem starken Product- und Engineering-Team.
  • Ein hohes Budget, solange der Nutzen stimmt.
  • Zeit und Unterstützung für deine Entwicklung, mit Fortbildungsbudget, Coaching und klaren Entwicklungsperspektiven.
  • 30 Urlaubstage und 50 € monatlichen steuerfreien Sachbezug.
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und Offsites.
  • Starkes Backing durch erfahrene Investoren und Mentoren.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess: 5 Tage

Wenn die Kalender passen, können wir den gesamten Prozess innerhalb von fünf Tagen abschließen.

  1. Kennenlernen, Tag 1: Im ersten Gespräch schauen wir, ob es für beide Seiten passt. Wenn ja, vereinbaren wir direkt deinen Probetag.
  2. Probetag mit Case Study, Tag 4: Du arbeitest mit uns an einer echten Aufgabe und stellst anschließend dein Ergebnis vor.
  3. Gespräch mit unserem CEO, Tag 4: Das Gespräch findet am Abend deines Probetags statt.
  4. Teamgespräch, Tag 5: Du lernst die Engineers kennen, mit denen du arbeiten wirst.
  5. Entscheidung, Tag 5: Nach dem Teamgespräch geben wir dir unsere finale Rückmeldung.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Erzähl uns, welche Probleme du gelöst, welche Entscheidungen du getroffen und welche Systeme du in Produktion gebracht hast.

descriptionHtml:

Die Dr. Bernhard Burger AG ist ein wachsendes Familienunternehmen in zweiter Generation und einer der führenden Partner für Goldschmiede, Juweliere und Edelmetallhändler. Gemeinsam mit unserem Joint Venture Burger & Gyr Edelmetalle Recycling AG am selben Standort in Keltern, zwischen Pforzheim und Karlsruhe, verbinden wir Edelmetallrecycling, Analyse, Abrechnung, Metallkonten, Handel und eigene Fertigung.

Unser Rechnungswesen bildet die Werteflüsse beider Gesellschaften ab: von der Scheidgutabrechnung über Metallkonten bis zu Monats- und Jahresabschluss. In den nächsten zwei Jahren führen wir ein neues, voll integriertes ERP-System auf Odoo-Basis ein. Damit wachsen die Themen, die wir kaufmännisch sauber durchdenken, abstimmen und zu Ende bringen müssen.

Deshalb suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine Persönlichkeit mit betriebswirtschaftlichem Überblick, die der kaufmännischen Leitung in Abschlüssen, Steuern, Finanzierung und Projekten spürbar Arbeit abnimmt, in der Buchhaltung selbst mit anpackt und tatkräftig im ERP-Projekt mitarbeitet. Einen Jahresabschluss müssen Sie nicht allein erstellen, aber wesentliche Abschlussarbeiten sicher übernehmen und mit Steuerberatern und Wirtschaftsprüfern intensiv zusammenarbeiten.

Wir messen Erfolg daran, dass Abschlüsse und Meldungen für beide Gesellschaften termingerecht und nachvollziehbar vorliegen, dass die kaufmännische Leitung bei Koordination und Zuarbeit entlastet wird und dass unsere Prozesse nach der ERP-Einführung einfacher und sicherer laufen als heute.

Die Stelle in Kürze

Sie übernehmen wesentliche Abschlussarbeiten für zwei Gesellschaften, entlasten unsere kaufmännische Leitung bei Steuern, Finanzierung und Analysen und begleiten als Key User die Einführung unseres neuen ERP-Systems auf Odoo-Basis.

Welche Aufgabenfelder erwarten Sie?

Ihr Schwerpunkt ist die Bilanzbuchhaltung. Im ERP-Projekt sind Sie Key User Rechnungswesen/Finanzen: Sie begleiten den Fortschritt, testen, ob alles wie vorgesehen funktioniert, denken und handeln mit und übernehmen bei Bedarf eigene Aufgaben oder Teilprojekte. Die Projektverantwortung bleibt bei unserer kaufmännischen Leitung.

  • Mitwirkung an Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB für zwei Gesellschaften: Abschlussbuchungen, Kontenabstimmungen, Rückstellungen, Anlagenbuchhaltung, Datenaustausch mit Steuerberatern und Wirtschaftsprüfern
