  • Participate in pre-sales efforts - technical discovery, proof-of-concept design, demo environments.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with backend, ML, and product teams to ensure performance and reliability at scale.

  • Partner with the GTM Engineer and DevRel team to turn customer learnings into automation, tutorials, and playbooks.

  • Identify and implement technical integrations with our other partners in the value chain (workflow orchestration, AI frameworks, etc.)

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear explanations for both developers and business audiences.

Why This Role Matters

Every integration you build helps define how AI systems connect to live, trusted information.

You’ll operate on the frontier between customers and product - bringing the voice of the field into everything we build and say.

Your work will inform:

  • The stories we tell in marketing.

  • The use cases we automate in our GTM systems.

  • The features we prioritize in our roadmap.

If you love blending engineering with impact - building things users actually depend on: this role is for you.

You’re a Great Fit If You

  • 2+ years in technical support engineering, software engineering, or solutions engineering, with direct application development experience.

  • Strong API integration skills - able to design and debug REST/JSON payloads, manage auth flows, and optimize latency.

  • Understand web infrastructure, distributed systems, or retrieval pipelines.

  • Are comfortable debugging integrations and solving ambiguous technical challenges in customer environments.

  • Communicate clearly and empathetically with both technical and business audiences.

  • Are curious about AI infrastructure, retrieval, and the emerging agentic ecosystem.

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment.

Example Projects

  • Help a partner integrate Linkup’s /search endpoint into their multi-agent workflow.

  • Build a proof-of-concept combining a customer’s private data with Linkup’s real-time web results.

  • Collaborate with the backend team to improve SDK telemetry and enterprise deployment reliability.

  • Work with the GTM team to turn successful integrations into published use cases and reference architectures.

  • Identify recurring customer needs that can become productized templates or automation.

About Linkup

Our Vision

We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web. These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.

AI agents need web search. To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.

Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs. Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.

Web 2.0 is sunsetting. The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.

Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up. We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.

Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.

Our Mission

Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve.

Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.

Our Culture

Our culture is built on the following values:

  • Mission. We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents.

  • Speed. We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well.

  • Ownership. We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion.

  • Teamwork. Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset.

  • Humility. We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences.

We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture.

Our Team

We are small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents.

A bit more about our 3 co-founders:

  • Philippe Mizrahi- Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen, an open source search engine.

  • Denis Charrier- Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience.

  • Boris Toledano- Led robotics at Carrefour, after 3y at McKinsey & Co working on public affairs and digital transformation.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer – SAP (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Qorelo

Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We have raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.


The role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are Qorelo’s technical face at the customer. You run workshops and demos on the customer’s real SAP landscape, get Qorelo connected to their systems and tools, and make sure the platform delivers on their data and their processes. Then you bring what you learned back to our engineers.

You work directly with our engineering team and solution architects, report to Marino, our CTO, and spend a real share of your time with customers, both on site and remotely.

What you will own

  • SAP connectivity. RFC connections, technical users and authorisations. You make the connection work and explain it to Basis and security teams in their language.

  • Workshops and demos on real environments. You run on-site workshops of several hours and show Qorelo on the customer’s own SAP landscape, not a sandbox: their custom code, their processes, their data. You prepare together with sales and our solution architects, and you handle the technical questions in the room.

  • Integrations. You connect the customer’s tools to Qorelo through our existing integrations across the SAP, Atlassian, Microsoft and similar ecosystems, and make sure they work on the customer’s landscape.

  • The feedback loop. What you see at customers (where the product wins, where it falls short, what they asked for) comes back to engineering and product as clear, concrete feedback. You are the engineering team’s eyes and ears at the customer.

What you need

  • 5+ years in technical, customer-facing roles around SAP: technical SAP consultant, solutions or presales engineer, or an engineer who spent much of their time with customers.

  • Solid SAP technical understanding: you know how an SAP landscape fits together (ECC, S/4HANA), what RFC connections, technical users and authorisations are, and what a Basis team will ask you. You do not need to be an ABAP developer.

  • Enough technical depth to set up and troubleshoot a connection with the customer’s IT: credentials, firewalls, proxies, VPN, certificates.

  • Strong presence in the room: you can run a five-hour workshop with consultants, IT leads and process owners, demo live on their system, and keep it on track when something does not work.

  • Real AI curiosity: you use LLM tools yourself and can explain clearly what Qorelo does and where its limits are.

  • Willingness to travel within Europe for on-site demos and workshops.

  • Fluent English. German is a plus for our DACH client base.

 

You might be a fit if

  • You have been the person customers want in the room for the demo, and the one consultants call when the connection does not work.

  • You have worked at an SAP consultancy, system integrator or SAP software vendor and want to be closer to a product.

  • You enjoy a full day of workshops at a customer and can still explain clearly afterwards what worked, what did not and why.

  • You have taken software through an enterprise IT and security onboarding and know why it takes as long as it does.

What we offer

  • Real ownership. Meaningful equity and a direct hand in how Qorelo runs in the field. We are looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked for senior customer-facing technical talent in Berlin.

  • The problems. Fortune 500 and DAX 40 production landscapes, including Mercedes-Benz. You work at the core of SAP systems most engineers never get to touch.

  • The team. Short paths, fast decisions, and a direct line to our CTO, our founding engineer and our solution architects.

  • 25 days paid vacation + German public holidays.

  • Company offsites with the whole team.

  • An office at the Wasserturm in Prenzlauer Berg – where you work when you are not with customers. The fridge is stocked.

  • Wellhub membership, top-tier equipment and access to the latest AI tools.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call with Gaspar, our founding engineer (30 min)

  2. Deep dive on your SAP and customer-facing background with Marino, our CTO (60 min)

  3. Practical case: a workshop and live demo simulation with our engineers and solution architects

  4. Offer

How to apply

Send us your CV at

Qorelo is an equal opportunity employer. We make our decisions regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, disability or sexual identity.

title: Founder's Associate / Business Operations (m/w/d) – 100% Remote weltweit
descriptionHtml:
Remote von überall auf der Welt, direkt an der Seite von zwei Gründern, die schon über 20 Firmen aufgebaut haben.

Über uns

Wir bauen Firmen um Menschen herum, die eine gute Idee haben und sie selbst vorantreiben wollen. Unsere beiden Gründer sind Venture-Architekten: Sie bringen Kapital, Vertrieb, Administration und die richtigen Leute zusammen, die Gründer der neuen Firmen bringen Idee und Antrieb. So sind schon über 20 Firmen entstanden, von Pet-Tech über E-Commerce und Einkaufsdienstleistungen bis zu Software für Anwälte. Zusammen beschäftigt die Gruppe weltweit eine dreistellige Zahl an Mitarbeitern.

Unser Ziel ist eine Maschine, die aus jeder guten Idee eine erfolgreiche Firma macht, die ohne die beiden läuft. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die diese Maschine mit aufbaut. Von wo aus du das tust, ist uns egal.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du machst aus unserer Arbeitsweise Prozesse. Vieles steckt heute in den Köpfen der beiden Gründer: wie wir mit Gründern arbeiten, wie wir Firmen aufsetzen, wie Reporting läuft. Du schaust es dir an, schreibst es auf und baust daraus klare Abläufe.
  • Du baust ein System, über das die Gründer unserer Firmen regelmäßig berichten.
  • Du prüfst neue Ideen am Markt: Du führst viele Kaltakquise-Telefonate, holst ehrliches Feedback ein und hilfst schnell zu entscheiden, ob aus einer Idee eine Firma wird.
  • Du managst die Termine der beiden Gründer und buchst Flüge und Reisen.
  • Du übernimmst Backoffice-Aufgaben, die auf Deutsch erledigt werden müssen.
  • Mit der Zeit wirst du ihre rechte Hand.

Was du mitbringst

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gutes Englisch, weil ein Teil unseres Teams in Indien sitzt
  • Du denkst in Strukturen und machst gern aus Chaos klare Abläufe
  • Mit Fremden zu telefonieren fällt dir leicht, für dich ist es der schnellste Weg zu Antworten
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und brauchst nicht für jeden Schritt eine Anleitung
  • Du gehst sicher mit digitalen Werkzeugen und KI-Tools um
  • Du bist zuverlässig und diskret, denn du bekommst Einblick in viele Firmen

Erfahrung aus einem Startup, einer Beratung oder als Assistenz der Geschäftsführung hilft, ist aber keine Bedingung. Wichtiger als der Lebenslauf sind uns Lernbereitschaft und Motivation.

Was wir bieten

  • 100 % remote, egal wo auf der Welt du lebst
  • Festanstellung in Voll- oder Teilzeit, mit Wohnsitz außerhalb Deutschlands ist auch Freelance möglich
  • Du lernst extrem schnell: wie Firmen entstehen, finanziert und aufgebaut werden, in über 20 Firmen aus ganz unterschiedlichen Branchen und Phasen
  • Du arbeitest direkt mit den beiden Gründern zusammen
  • Du baust etwas Eigenes: Die Prozesse und Systeme, die du schaffst, tragen am Ende die ganze Maschine
  • Ein klarer Weg nach oben: Wer sich bewährt, wird Chief of Staff und hat Karriereperspektiven bis in die Geschäftsführung oder auf C-Level

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte vier kurze Fragen. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Fragen vorab beantwortet Felix Wilhelm gern unter +49 176 95422094.

title: Founding Account Executive – Belgium
descriptionHtml:
About Tacto

Tacto builds Industrial AI for procurement in manufacturing. Built for industrial complexity, designed to optimize every procurement decision.

Over 50% of a product’s cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world.

  • 400+ procurement organizations work with Tacto

  • ~110 people on the team in Munich

  • €50M+ raised, led by Sequoia and Index Ventures, with Cherry Ventures, UVC Partners and others

Our mission at Tacto

We make industry stronger.

Manufacturing is the backbone of the European economy, and supply chains are its biggest challenge. Yet procurement in many companies still runs on Excel and legacy systems. With AI, we are fundamentally changing how manufacturers buy: measurably lower material costs and far less manual work.

Your role

You open Belgium for Tacto and win the first customers that everything else builds on.

Why this role exists

Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit and a proven playbook, and now we are taking it into the rest of Europe. Belgium is one of our expansion markets. Flanders and Wallonia are home to a dense, export-driven manufacturing base, and the category is still wide open there. That’s where you come in: you take the market and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates and win the first customers and reference logos. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows in Belgium from there.

Why your role matters

  • A real greenfield. You have the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market, from the ICP to the first reference logos.

  • You’re not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation.

  • You write the blueprint. What works in your first deals becomes the playbook for everyone who follows you in Belgium.

  • You shape how Tacto goes international. Your insights go straight to Product, Marketing and Leadership.

What this role is and isn’t

  • Hands on: You send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won.

  • Not a managed territory: There is no machine behind you yet. You drive your own pipeline and build the motion as you go.

  • Not a remote role: You build Belgium from our Munich office and travel into the market.

Your tasks

  • Open up Belgium end to end: You sharpen the ICP for Belgian manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the market’s growth.

  • Run the full sales cycle: Discovery, demo, potential analysis on real ERP data, ROI business case and closing.

  • Build the outbound playbook: Hand in hand with the expansion team, you develop messaging, sequences, segments and channels for your market.

  • Turn marketing into pipeline: You coordinate the marketing activities in your market so they generate pipeline.

  • Shape our international expansion: You feed structured insight back to Product, Marketing and Leadership.

Your profile

Experience and skills

  • Experience: Several years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex or technical products and multi-stakeholder buying processes

  • Track record: You’ve carried a number before and know what it takes to hit it without a machine behind you

  • Value selling: You grasp complex products and translate technical depth into business impact

  • Languages: Fluent, business-level English. Dutch or French is a strong plus. We hire for mindset and ability, not origin or native language

  • Location: Based in Munich or ready to relocate

Core strengths

  • Entrepreneurial: You want to build and own a market result, and figure out the motion when the local one doesn’t exist yet

  • Hunter: You go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline

  • Builder: You turn what works into a system the next person can run

  • Thinks beyond the next deal: You lay Tacto’s foundation in your market, externally through brand, network and reference logos, internally through the playbook and the case for the market

You don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.

Our values

No fixed career path: everyone here grows their own way.

  • We stay real: Come as you are, wherever you come from.

  • Merit matters: Results count, not titles.

  • Bold ambitions: Excellence as the standard.

  • Real passion: Grit and ownership.

  • Transforming industrials: Close to our customers in manufacturing.

  • Fun built-in: We don’t take ourselves too seriously.

  • Caring is key: We help each other grow.

What we offer

What to expect

  • Building at the AI frontier: The newest models from day one, an AI Captain in every team and no limits on what you can try.

  • Growing with clear feedback: Regular feedback conversations mean you always know what it takes to reach the next step.

  • Munich’s tech ecosystem: Every week you meet leading founders and operators at our own and external events. All events: luma.com/tacto

Benefits

  • €1,500+ learning budget per year

  • 26 + 4 days of vacation

  • €300 childcare allowance per child

  • EGYM Wellpass

  • JobRad bike leasing and public transport tickets

  • Company pension plan and discounts

How you apply

Fast and transparent, with feedback after every step.

  1. Intro call with our Chief of Staff

  2. Deep dive with our Head of Revenue

  3. Get-to-know call with the AE you’d be working alongside

  4. Onsite interview incl. case study and team meetings

Equal opportunity and data protection

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We offer everyone the same opportunities regardless of ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity.

Please do not send us any personal data revealing your ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, and no data about your health or sexual orientation.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

How you'll make impact

This role is based in Manchester, with three days a week in the office.

 

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • Experience managing customer onboarding, implementation or activation processes from initial setup through go-live.

  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills, with the confidence to work with people across different functions, backgrounds and levels of seniority.

You'll thrive here if

title: Founding Engineer (Remote or Hybrid - EEA/UK)
descriptionHtml:
Founding Engineer


Role can be based remotely in the EEA or hybrid in our London or Munich offices.

Fixed software is the wrong shape for logistics, because every team runs its processes differently. Tare is our solution. Combining agentic AI with deterministic logic means Tare fits to any customer but runs the same way every single time. We have just closed our pre-seed funding round with a top European VC and we are now looking for a founding engineer to build Tare with us.

About Tarebase

We're Dom and Felix, the two co-founders of Tarebase. Dom is a former SVP at a global unicorn, overseeing tens of millions in global carrier spend, with deep logistics domain experience from Amazon, Nestle and EY. Felix was a founding engineer at Raycast and has spent more than two decades building software systems. We've raised pre-seed funding from a top-tier European VC and are building our MVP together with early design partners, who will become our first customers. As our first employee, you'd have a real say in both the product and the engineering decisions behind it.

Logistics is difficult to run well, and experienced people are hard to hire. Smaller businesses often pay too much for shipping, struggle to give customers a good delivery experience, and can't match larger competitors' technology or hiring budgets. The software available to them is often expensive, dated or too cumbersome. We want to make logistics less of a burden so these businesses can spend more time selling their products.They're the customers we want to build for: Europe alone has around 26 million SMEs, employing more than 100 million people.

Just putting a chat interface and GPT-wrapper on top of the problem is not what we're building. We're combining extraction and analysis, workflow automation, agentic and compiled AI with deterministic, verifiable logic. Recent advances in AI make more of this possible, but building a system that does it reliably is still hard. We're looking for someone who wants to advance the state of the art in this area with us.

About you

The description below is an ideal, not a checklist. If you don't tick every box but feel ready for the challenges of being the first engineer at an early-stage startup, we'd still like to hear from you. What matters most to us is that you're motivated, committed, willing to stick with hard problems, and someone we can count on.

You have a strong technical background and a track record of building and shipping software systems, whether that's cloud backends, web applications, AI-supported systems or a mix of these. You enjoy working across engineering and product. You think like a product engineer: you care about UX/UI, and you want direct contact with customers and the people who use what you build.

You'll work mostly in Rust and TypeScript, across the full stack: data engineering, AI, backend, frontend, infrastructure and deployment. We especially value experience with either language from before AI coding tools and a solid understanding of its ecosystem so you can make considered choices. We also value experience operating distributed systems and data-intensive systems in the cloud, including multi-tenant environments and the scaling and security challenges they bring, databases, and durable execution runtimes.

You use coding agents effectively, but stay close to the code. You know their limitations in a large codebase, review and challenge their work, and take testing, debugging, refactoring and documentation seriously. You can design useful tests and evaluations, manage complexity, and tell when something is genuinely ready to ship.

You also enjoy digging into challenging problems. You keep up with what current models, agent harnesses and research make possible, and you can judge what actually works for a given use case. You know how to build agents and AI workflows into a product and use evaluations, validation and deterministic logic to make what they produce consistent and verifiable. You're comfortable extracting structure from messy documents and care a lot about data quality. You experiment, measure the results, question your assumptions, and keep going until you've found a solution that really holds up.

You can turn that work into shipped software, taking a product idea or technical direction through design and implementation without waiting for someone to assign you a ticket. We work remotely, so clear communication and follow-through matter a lot to us. We value people who manage their own work, can be counted on, and raise important issues early.

How to apply

Apply with the button on this page.

Please ensure to use a hand-written CV. We read every application ourselves. It's fine to use tools for spelling or translation, but we want to hear your voice.

Our process

The process should take a few weeks from start to finish depending on your availability.

  1. Application review. If we move forward after reading your CV, we’ll send you a few short questions.

  2. Intro call with Dom and Felix. An informal chat about your experience, what you’re looking for next, and any questions you have about Tare.

  3. Technical deep dive with Felix. We’ll work through a system design problem together and talk through the trade-offs.

  4. Half a day with us in Munich or London. We cover your travel, hotel if needed, and meals. You spend about two hours on a made-up task similar to the problems we work on, using your usual tools and coding agents. Then we have lunch, go through your work together, and talk about Tare and the challenges we’re tackling.

  5. References and offer. We speak with 1-2 people you've worked with (only with your agreement) before making a decision.

If we don't move forward after the technical conversation or later, we'll share some feedback with you.

Compensation: €100.000–120.000 base salary plus 0.75–1% equity

Setup: A MacBook Pro and whatever else you need to work well. If you'd rather not work from home, we'll pay for a coworking space near you.

Location: Munich or London, or remote within Europe (GMT-1 to GMT+3) with regular meet-ups.


Candidate privacy policy available here: https://tarebase.com/candidate-privacy

title: Founding Full-Stack Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Founding Full-Stack Engineer

Build the software systems around planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. Work directly with our CTO and shape a greenfield product spanning Python backend, data, visualization, frontend, infrastructure, and integration with our optimization core. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews.

The opportunity

Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for.

We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.

About us

planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.

What you'll own

  • The product layer: Turn complex optimization systems into software planners can actually use.

  • Backend and data: Build Python services, APIs, data models, and pipelines around our optimization engine.

  • Interfaces and visualization: Make schedules, bottlenecks, dependencies, and alternative decisions understandable and interactive.

  • Integration: Connect native C++ components, factory data, and product workflows into one coherent system.

  • Infrastructure: Own CI/CD, containers, deployment, observability, and the supporting services we need.

  • The team: Grow into leading software engineering at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, and setting direction.

You set your own priorities and structure your work toward clear goals. No ticket queue, no micromanagement.

How we build

Our product sits at the boundary between algorithms, software systems, and real industrial operations.

We care about building systems that are easy to integrate, responsive, understandable, and maintainable as both the product and the underlying algorithms evolve.

We use GenAI extensively to prototype, implement, and explore alternatives. But generating code is not the hard part. The value lies in designing the right system, choosing good abstractions, validating behavior, and knowing what is worth building.

There are no points for cleverness. The simplest system that reliably solves the real problem wins.

What you'll bring

  • Strong Python and backend engineering. You are comfortable designing APIs, services, libraries, and maintainable system boundaries.

  • Full-stack product skills. You can work with TypeScript, React, or similar technologies and build interfaces that make complex systems understandable.

  • Data and integration. You can design data models and pipelines, work with databases, and connect messy external systems to clean internal interfaces.

  • Systems thinking. You think beyond individual services or screens: how data, algorithms, product, and infrastructure fit together.

  • Infrastructure fundamentals. You are comfortable with Docker, CI/CD, deployment, observability, and operating services.

  • Independence. You can turn an underspecified operational problem into working software without waiting for a detailed spec.

  • Fluent English. German and experience in manufacturing or industrial planning are useful but not required.

Bonus: C++ and native Python bindings such as pybind11 or nanobind; data visualization; optimization, scheduling, simulation, or other algorithmic systems; enterprise integrations such as ERP / SAP.

What you'll get

  • Real ownership: shape the product architecture from line one, working directly with our CTO.

  • A clear growth path into leading the software engineering team.

  • A real problem worth solving.

  • We equip you with the hardware, compute, and tools you work best with.

  • Remote-first or from our Munich office, with regular in-person workshops.

  • Competitive pay + VSOP.

The process (fast, real conversations, no puzzles)

  1. Send your CV.

  2. Talk with our CTO about your work and how you approach hard problems.

  3. Meet our CEO and selected investors.

More at home in C++, algorithms, and optimization? Check out our Founding Optimization Engineer role.

title: Full stack engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Nabla

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

The best of AI at the service of healthcare

Nabla’s phenomenal traction is the result of 3 years of diligent product development.

Led by former Meta AI Research engineers, our team has consistently anticipated how AI can revolutionize healthcare delivery. Our Machine Learning team continually leverages the latest advancements to unlock AI’s full potential in healthcare.

Yann LeCun, Meta’s ex-Chief AI Scientist and Turing award winner, is an advisor to Nabla. He’s now focused on AMI Labs, with whom we have a close partnership.

Engineering at Nabla

Engineering at Nabla is lean, fast-moving, and deeply technical. Our teams span machine learning, native desktop applications, and platform infrastructure to deliver AI into clinical settings reliably and at scale.

Your team

At Nabla, product development is led jointly by Engineering and Product and organized into cross-functional squads, each focused on a specific product area. Squads bring together product managers, designers, engineers of different profiles, and domain experts, and operate with a high level of ownership.

As a Full-stack Engineer, you'll join one of these squads and contribute end to end to a specific part of the product.

The technical challenges

  • Volumetry and efficiency: We handle more than 2.5 million medical encounters per month. Each one is automatically turned into a clinical note sent to the clinician's patient record system, saving thousands of hours of administrative work and giving healthcare professionals more time for their patients.

  • Real-time audio transcription: capturing and streaming audio reliably, from in-person visits as well as video consultations, and turning it into transcripts with very low latency

  • Resilience: keeping the product working on weak or unstable networks, with no data lost and no disruption to the clinician

  • Healthcare integrations: building robust connections to the third-party medical systems clinicians already rely on.

  • Complex AI services: designing and running multi-stage LLM pipelines and agentic workflows at scale, with the reliability and auditability a clinical setting requires

These challenges come with demanding product requirements:

  • Zero friction: clinicians have no time to learn a new tool, so the product must be fast to set up, intuitive, and useful from the very first consultation

  • Trust: what we generate goes into patient records, so quality and reliability are non-negotiable

  • Works everywhere: web, desktop and mobile, in clinics, hospitals or remote consultations

Your impact

  • Build and improve product features across web, desktop and mobile platforms

  • Design and evolve the back-end APIs and services that power them

  • Collaborate closely with Product, ML, and Design to take projects from idea to production

  • Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to team best practices

  • Learn from senior engineers and grow your skills across the stack

Your DNA

  • Solid foundations in Computer Science

  • 4+ years of industry experience in full-stack engineering

  • Proficient in React (strong Vue.js experience also considered)

  • Proficient in at least one back-end language such as Java, Kotlin, Scala, C#/.NET, Go, or Rust. We use Kotlin internally, and it's fine if you haven't worked with it yet

  • Comfortable working with AI coding tools and agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, etc.), and keen to use AI in your day-to-day work

  • Curious, eager to learn, and motivated to grow in a fast-moving team

  • Care about code quality and maintainability

  • Enjoy working in an international team where English is our primary language

Our Stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, Rust, Electron

  • Backend: Kotlin / JVM, GraphQL, PostgreSQL

  • ML & Infra: Python, PyTorch, Slurm, GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes

Where you'll be based

Our offices are based in Paris 3e (Arts & Métiers)

Remote policy: 2 days a week

Possibility of working abroad remotely up to 2 weeks, once a year.

Benefits

Just like we’re dedicated to supporting doctors’ well-being, ensuring yours is a top priority. We firmly believe that by prioritizing your well-being, we support you to excel in your work.

Here are the benefits you get when joining Nabla:

  • Stock ownership

  • 100% healthcare coverage

  • Meal vouchers

  • Public transportation costs covered at 50%

  • Exercise class during the workday: Yoga, running, pilates, HIIT

  • Unlimited budget for book purchases, so you can continue to learn about ML / Healthcare

  • Culture of trust & accountability — your output matters more than your clock-in time

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

title: Genesis-World: Core Simulation Engine Engineer
descriptionHtml:
What we’re building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

This is at the core of Genesis AI’s strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute.

The role

Simulation is still a hard sell in robotics. Outside a few success stories, like reinforcement learning for locomotion, most teams skip it, and friction is a big part of why: painful to use, painful to debug. We live that pain ourselves: debugging a failing experiment during policy evaluation takes 30 minutes, and there is no way to automatically generate a standalone reproduction script. That blocks adoption, even internally.

Your job is to kill that friction. You build the software engineering backbone of Genesis-World: everything that makes a large, fast-moving simulation codebase reliable, maintainable, frictionless. And it all ships in the open. Every hour of pain you remove, you remove for every roboticist who comes after you.

You join as core maintainer of Genesis-World, with shared stewardship of the whole platform from day one. Our physics team develops the algorithms, but just as importantly, you work to make everything around them excellent: infrastructure, tooling, APIs, architecture.

The problems waiting for you

  • Make testing of a JIT-compiled engine scalable. Running our full suite is already taking hours because the ratio between compile time and runtime can be as bad as x10. Getting rid of this bottleneck is a serious challenge that will require a joint effort from the Genesis-World and the compiler teams.

  • Make any bug reproducible. Dump and reload simulations bit-exactly, across machines, across backends, even when a single timestep of a batched simulation can already max out VRAM. Turn any failing run into a standalone reproduction script, automatically.

  • Make autodiff first-class. Genesis-World is differentiable today, but partially: memory-hungry, slower than it could be, and hard to maintain due to manual operation recording. The project spans the engine and the compiler: you drive the requirements on Quadrants and iterate in a tight loop with the compiler team until the integration is solid.

  • Edit scenes at frozen time. See the scene, move entities and robots around, iterate on layout, all without building the scene or compiling the engine. Authoring today means a full build cycle. Make it instant.

  • Make the simulator extensible. First-class plugins for physics solvers and interactive viewer backends, including Nyx. Sensors already work this way. Generalize it, and Genesis-World becomes a platform others build on.

  • Give robots real actuation. Motors and MIMO transmissions, cleanly abstracted at the interface between users and the physics engine.

  • Make time a local variable. Today the clock and the timestep are global to the engine, which forbids whole classes of speedups: environments cannot step independently, the timestep cannot adapt to the state, and individual solvers cannot advance at their own rate. Free the clock down to the sub-scene level and let the simulation fly.

  • Make scenes come alive. Events triggered by physics: press the button and the microwave door pops open, squeeze the trigger and the drill spins.

  • Keep the core sharp. Refactoring legacy subsystems, stronger typing, consistent coding style, less Python overhead on hot paths, full scene serialization, telemetry and replay.

Beyond the code: you review issues and pull requests with the core team, answer questions from users and contributors, and can join the push on adoption.

Who you are

You care about the engineer using what you build as much as the thing itself. A slow test, a cryptic error, a manual step: you see it, you go after the root cause, and you remove it for everyone. You have opinions about API design.

You are comfortable with physics and robotics: the right design choices take a working picture of what a simulator like Genesis-World does, how it works, and how it is used, a picture you can partly build on the job.

  • Strong Python engineering on large codebases: architecture, refactoring, typing, packaging, performance profiling (py-spy, Nsight, Xcode Instruments, RenderDoc).

  • Developer tooling, test infrastructure, or CI at scale.

  • Enough fluency with JIT compilation, code generation, or GPU computing stacks to reason about compilation caching, kernel dispatch, and startup cost. You will work closely with Quadrants.

  • At ease debugging across the full platform matrix: Windows, Linux, and macOS, on x86 and arm64, over CUDA, AMD, and Apple Metal (and possibly Intel XPU via Vulkan soon)

  • Open-source reflexes: triaging issues, reviewing external pull requests, communicating with a community.

Bonus points: experience with other robotics simulators (Drake, MuJoCo, Newton, Isaac, RaiSim, Jiminy, Brax). PyTorch, our user-facing interface. Other JIT compilers such as Triton, JAX, or Numba. 3D tooling and interactive editors (Maya, Blender, Houdini). Serialization formats (USD, glTF, MJCF/URDF). C++, CUDA, or Metal. Developer relations or community work.

title: Growth
descriptionHtml:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You generate pipeline for our account executives (AEs) in the markets where dollar access is hardest. Most of it happens in person, at conferences and the events around them. In between, you find the next targets and make sure every lead lands with the right AE.

You also own the numbers behind the top of the funnel and use them to recommend where the team spends its time next, including which new markets are worth testing. You'll help shape how we run Growth, with real autonomy and a scope that grows with what you show.

Your First Six Months

  • Months 1-2: Learn the product, our ICP and how we sell to banks and fintechs. Shadow our sales conversations, and get to know our stack, our playbooks and the way we operate. Go to your first conference with the team: help with pre-booking, work the floor alongside our Sales and Growth teams, and book your first meetings. By the end of month two, you can pitch Augustus on your own.

  • Months 3-4: Execution is yours. Own a conference end to end, from the target list to the follow-up: book the meetings, route each one to the right AE and make sure it happens. Take meetings on your own and work closely with Sales and Marketing.

  • Months 5-6: Own the pipeline for a set of markets and run your first event. You've turned what you've learned into data: which conferences, intros and markets bring deals that close, and which don't. You sync with the rest of GTM to bring in what they see and use it to shape our market strategy: where we go next, how we go in, who we target first and what we lead with.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

This role is for you if:

  • You're outgoing and at your best in front of people. You can start a conversation with a stranger at a booth and hold it with a bank's CFO.

  • You do what needs to be done, even when it's not glamorous: building a prospecting list, chasing a follow-up, carrying boxes to the booth.

  • You think clearly and work from data. You take an unstructured dataset and come back with answers and insights.

  • You're diligent and organised. Nothing falls through the cracks.

  • You use AI to move fast, but don't trust the output blindly. You check results, question the systems and don't ship anything you wouldn't put your name on.

  • You're curious: when something takes too long, you find a faster way to do it.

  • After every conference, you know what you'd do differently next time, and you do it.

This is not for you if:

  • You'd rather work behind a screen than in front of people. Most of our pipeline starts with a conversation in person.

  • You want a well-defined scope and clear processes. Ours change as we grow, and you'll help build many of them.

  • You want a predictable week. Plans change, the bar is high and the hours are long.

  • You expect your degree to count for more than your results.

Hard Requirements

  • You are currently pursuing or have obtained, in the last two years, a Bachelor's or Master's degree from a stellar institution.

  • You have 1-2 previous internships or roles in high-growth startups, venture capital, private equity, consulting or investment banking, and/or you have demonstrated initiative through side projects, student organizations or entrepreneurial experiences.

  • Fluent English. Spanish is a strong plus.

  • You can travel regularly, often at short notice.

  • Based in Berlin or willing to relocate.

Pay transparency

Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual base salary range for this role is €60,000-€80,000 + equity and benefits.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

  • Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.

  • Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.

  • Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.

Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.

Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status.

title: Growth Manager / Senior Growth Manager - Software (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du bist Hunter mit Strategie-Gen: Du jagst Wachstumschancen, denkst in Portfolios statt in Einzelprojekten und in Kundenbeziehungen statt in Einzelabschlüssen – und du machst andere erfolgreich? Dann gestalte mit uns, womit und wie die Coduct Solutions im deutschsprachigen Mittelstand wächst.

Coduct Group in 30 Sekunden

Wir modernisieren IT für Unternehmen, die mit Software Geld verdienen oder ihre Prozesse digitalisieren: Cloud-Migration, Daten & KI, individuelle Software und Betrieb. Dazu gehören unser Marke CODE LEAP in Vietnam für das Software Engineering, unsere Marke ainavio mit einer SaaS-Plattform für Produktinformationsmanagement und unser Geschäft als Microsoft CSP-Partner. Wir sind dreifach zertifizierter Microsoft Solutions Partner und arbeiten u. a. für JTL, Netze BW, Schleupen und Galeria.

Für die nächste Wachstumsphase haben wir die Funktion Growth gegründet. Ein VP Growth plant das Wachstum und befähigt Marketing und Vertrieb, es zu realisieren. Du wirst das erste Teammitglied an seiner Seite.

Deine Mission

Ein Portfolio und eine Roadmap bauen, mit denen Coduct nachhaltig wächst – und Marketing und Vertrieb so ausstatten, dass sie damit gewinnen.

Drei Prinzipien, die du mit uns umsetzt

Land & Expand

  • Kunden starten mit einem klaren, risikoarmen Einstiegsangebot – und wachsen über definierte Ausbaupfade in Projekte, Managed Services, Lizenzen und SaaS. Aus Aufträgen werden langfristige Kundenbeziehungen.

Balance Volumen & Premium

  • Standardisierte Volumenangebote sorgen für Skalierung und wiederkehrende Umsätze, individuelle Premiumleistungen für Differenzierung und Marge. Du gestaltest den Mix so, dass sich beide Welten verstärken.

Hunting

  • Wachstum wartet nicht. Du spürst Chancen aktiv auf – Segmente, Partner, Großchancen – und bringst sie gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb zum Abschluss. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich in Umsatz und EBIT – und in deiner variablen Vergütung.

Deine ersten 12 Monate

Monat 1–3

  • Du lernst Portfolio, Kunden und Teams kennen, analysierst Portfolio-Mix, Bestandskunden und Pipeline und legst mit dem VP Growth die Growth-Roadmap und die Prioritäten fest.

Monat 4–6

  • Die ersten zwei bis drei Einstiegsangebote mit Ausbaupfad sind marktreif. Der Vertrieb hat Playbook, Pitch und Pricing-Rechner, Marketing startet die ersten Kampagnen – auch für unsere CSP-Bestandskunden.

Monat 7–12

  • Das Portfolio ist klar strukturiert in Volumen und Premium, das KPI-System zeigt Expansion, Mix und Marge, und Marketing, Vertrieb und Delivery arbeiten mit gemeinsamen OKRs. Du übernimmst zunehmend bereichsübergreifende Growth-Themen.

Was du konkret tust

  • Hunting: Du jagst Wachstumschancen und Großchancen und bringst sie gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb zum Abschluss

  • Roadmap: Du entwickelst die Growth-Roadmap, bewertest Segmente, Partnerschaften und neue Geschäftsfelder und machst daraus priorisierte Initiativen

  • Portfolio: Du produktisierst Projektmuster zu skalierbaren Angeboten, schärfst unsere Premiumleistungen und verantwortest Positionierung, Pricing und Lifecycle

  • Land & Expand: Du baust Einstiegsangebote und Ausbaupfade – und Programme, mit denen der Vertrieb Bestandskunden weiterentwickelt

  • Enablement: Du gibst Vertrieb und Marketing Playbooks, Messaging, Kampagnen, Schulungen und Tools an die Hand

  • Steuerung: Du gestaltest Prozesse und Schnittstellen und baust ein KPI-System für Funnel, Expansion, Portfolio-Mix und Marge

  • Verbinden: Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Markt, Marketing, Vertrieb und Delivery in Deutschland und Vietnam

Das bringst du mit

Das brauchen wir

  • 5+ Jahre B2B-Erfahrung in Portfolio-/Produktmanagement, Growth, Strategie, Go-to-Market oder Business Development

  • Angebote entwickelt, produktisiert und bepreist

  • Erfahrung mit Land-and-Expand-Modellen und Bestandsentwicklung

  • Verständnis für Standard- und Premiumgeschäft

  • Eigene Vertriebspraxis und Gespür für den Mittelstand

  • Kenntnis von SaaS- und Microsoft-CSP-Modellen und dem DACH-Markt

  • Prozess- und Zahlenverständnis: Prozesse, CRM, KPIs

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und fließendes Englisch

Das macht dich besonders

  • Erfahrung mit Sales Enablement oder Revenue Operations

  • Ein Netzwerk im Mittelstand oder in der Microsoft-Partnerwelt

  • Routinierter Einsatz von KI-Tools

  • Erfahrung mit verteilten, internationalen Teams

  • Erste Erfolge beim Aufbau einer Growth- oder Portfolio-Funktion

Du passt zu uns, wenn …

  • du als Hunter neue Wachstumschancen jagst – und sie mit dem Vertrieb zum Abschluss bringst

  • du dich gern an Ergebnissen messen lässt – an KPIs, Umsatz und EBIT

  • du lieber machst als ankündigst und Ideen schnell im Markt testest

  • du Vertrieb und Marketing ohne Weisungsbefugnis für neue Wege gewinnst

  • du gern im Team arbeitest – auch verteilt, remote und über Zeitzonen hinweg

  • du wachsen willst: fachlich, in der Verantwortung und mit dem Unternehmen

Eher nicht, wenn …

  • du eigene Kunden betreuen und Abschlüsse allein verbuchen willst, statt Wachstum gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb zu realisieren

  • du dich lieber nicht an messbaren Ergebnissen orientierst

  • du Strategie lieber präsentierst, als sie umzusetzen

Das bekommst du

  • Echten Einfluss: Du baust eine neue Unternehmensfunktion mit auf – mit kurzen Wegen zu VP Growth und Geschäftsführung

  • Leistung, die sich lohnt: Fixgehalt plus variable Vergütung nach Zielerreichung deiner Growth-KPIs und deiner Wirkung auf Umsatz und EBIT

  • Eine klare Perspektive in Richtung leitender Growth-Rolle

  • Cloud-, KI- und SaaS-Themen mit eigenem Delivery-Center

  • Ein Team, das ehrlich kommuniziert, pragmatisch entscheidet und sich gegenseitig unterstützt

  • Flexibilität: flexible Arbeitszeiten, hybrides Arbeiten – Office Kamp-Lintfort oder Berlin (ca. 1 Tag/Woche), sonst mobil innerhalb Deutschlands; gelegentliche Reisen in der DACH-Region

So geht's weiter

  • Lebenslauf schicken und kurz beantworten: Welches Angebot hast du zuletzt so geschärft, dass es spürbar mehr Umsatz gebracht hat?

  • Erstgespräch per Video mit VP Growth, Chief of Staff und einem Teammitglied aus Vertrieb oder Marketing (ca. 75 Minuten)

  • Fallstudie und Zweitgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung: Du zeigst uns, wie du Wachstum gestalten würdest (ca. 90 Minuten)

  • Angebot – in der Regel innerhalb von vier Wochen nach dem Erstgespräch

Bei uns findest du ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und gemeinsam seine Ziele verfolgt. Wir setzen auf ehrliche Kommunikation, pragmatische Lösungen und eine Atmosphäre, in der Arbeiten Freude macht. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft innovativer Projekte!

descriptionHtml:

title: GTM Engineering Intern | Revenue Operations (d/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
In a nutshell: 4 to 6-month internship in our RevOps team at our Munich headquarters (hybrid), starting between February and April 2027, with the opportunity to move into a full-time role straight afterwards.

About this role at Luminovo

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we have recently expanded into North America and the rest of Europe.

GTM engineering at Luminovo is part of Revenue Operations, the department that sits between marketing, sales and customer success and makes sure our revenue organisation runs smoothly.

Our go-to-market engineering function builds the systems that find the right companies and the right people for our sales team: target lists, data enrichment, hyper-personalised outbound campaigns that signal our sellers whom to call next. We work closely with Account Executives, the BDR team and marketing and directly contribute to pipeline generation.

As our GTM engineering intern, you will run outbound campaigns end to end and help build the next layer: signal-based lead generation. You will also help us improve account scoring and build AI automations that take manual work off our sales reps.

There is no textbook for this role. You will learn it the way we did: by building, shipping and seeing what works.

By the end of your internship, you will have shipped revenue systems that our sales & marketing teams rely on every day, and gained hands-on experience in go-to-market engineering, one of the hottest roles on the market right now!

You will also see first-hand how a modern B2B start-up operates day to day, with AI built into its workflows.

This role is for you

  • You combine technical thinking with commercial curiosity: perhaps you studied engineering and want to understand how companies sell, or you have discovered a passion for the commercial side of start-ups.

  • You are keen to work in a fast-paced environment and to grow alongside a high-growth start-up.

  • You bring the drive to learn quickly, a sharp analytical mind and the ambition to take on real responsibility from your first weeks. You collaborate well, ask questions without hesitation and are happy to get your hands dirty.

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. You have built your own automations, workflows or tools, and can explain what you shipped and what came of it.

  • You are fluent in both German and English. Much of our outbound targets buyers in the DACH region, while the company operates in English.

  • You stand out if you have built something entrepreneurial during your studies, be it a side project, a student society or a small business.

  • You have first experience in GTM engineering, sales operations or automation (this is a big advantage but not a requirement!)

Your performance objectives

🧬 Run outbound campaigns

  • Deliver multichannel campaigns end to end. Build target lists, source and enrich the right contacts, and write the messaging in German and English.

  • Go where coverage is thin. Your campaigns will go wherever our sellers need the most support or wherever there is an opportunity worth pursuing, starting with DACH and extending to the rest of Europe and North America. Take on event campaigns, new regions and opportunistic plays, and turn them around to contribute to our pipeline.

🌀 Build signals and tooling

  • Ship signals. Build plugins or scrapers that generate high-intent leads for our sellers.

  • Process scaling. Transform website engagement into automated outbound triggers and create repeatable playbooks.

⚙️ Build automations

  • Remove manual work. Automate the repetitive manual tasks our revenue teams deal with day to day.

  • Challenge what exists. Get to know the systems we have built, then tell us where they fall short and help improve them.

💶 Unblock the sales team

  • Understand what sales reps need. Work closely with our AEs and BDRs, get to know their accounts and processes, and remove the friction that slows them down.

  • Close the loop. Feed what you learn from replies and campaign results back to sales and marketing.

🗂 Own the data

  • Own enrichment and imports. Take responsibility for account enrichment and every data import into HubSpot on contact, company and lead level.

  • Keep data accuracy high. You will be responsible for maintaining our enrichment so that data stays clean and workflows keep firing.

Your Toolkit

You will learn to work with the most modern sales automation tools on the market, such as Clay, n8n, Twain, Lusha, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and many more.

Work location

Our Munich headquarters. For your first two months you will be in the office most days, so you get to know the product, the team, our ICP and the basics of our market. After that, the role is hybrid, with the flexibility to work from home. Occasional travel for team retreats and industry events (expenses covered).

Whom you will be working with

  • Max Hungenbach, Revenue Operations Team Lead and your line manager

  • Danny Bodnar, GTM Engineer, your mentor and day-to-day coach

  • Clifton Lobo, VP Global Sales. You will work directly with him on GTM strategy.

  • Dasha Vyazemskaya, Head of BDR and your partner on handing campaigns over to the BDR team

  • George Knight, Demand Generation Manager in Marketing and your partner on campaigns run alongside marketing

  • Our Account Executives and BDRs across Europe and North America, for whom your campaigns run

Skills, knowledge, and expertise

Just so you know, we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care about your CV.

If you’re interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles, see here.

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things.

We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.

title: Hardware Lead (Principal Hardware Engineer)
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

As Hardware Lead, you'll build and own the hardware function at Laelaps AI from the ground up. Today we have deep expertise across AI, autonomy, and software, with zero hardware in-house. You'll change that.

You'll define our hardware strategy across ground, aerial, and stationary platforms, take ownership of the physical robots that run our field foundation models, and grow the hardware team behind you as the company scales. This is a high-leverage role. You'll be the senior hardware voice in the company, working directly with founders to decide what we build, how we source it, and how it survives in the field.

Expect to be deeply hands-on for the first year: building, testing, and iterating on real platforms in real conditions, while laying the foundation for a hardware org you'll later lead.

What You'll Work On

  • Hardware strategy: platform choices (build vs. partner vs. integrate) across ground robots, drones, and stationary sensors.

  • Mechanical design: chassis, mounting, and ruggedization for outdoor security deployments.

  • Electrical and electromechanical systems: power, compute, actuation, sensing integration.

  • Sensor integration (cameras, LiDAR, IMU, GPS, audio): selection, calibration, and physical integration.

  • Manufacturing and supply chain: prototype-to-production pipeline, vendor management, BOM ownership.

  • Field reliability: environmental qualification, MTBF, failure analysis, and durability programs.

  • Hiring: build the hardware team behind you as the product scales.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for an experienced hardware engineer who has shipped real robotic systems into the field, not just prototypes that demoed well. You've seen what breaks at scale, what survives, and what doesn't. You move fast without compromising on reliability, because security customers can't tolerate flaky hardware.

Your Background

  • 8+ years in robotics, autonomous systems, or adjacent hardware, with at least one product taken from prototype into the field.

  • Deep expertise across mechanical, electrical, and systems integration. World-class in at least one, strong in the others.

  • Hands-on experience taking robots through prototype, DVT, PVT, and into production.

  • Track record of ruggedizing hardware for outdoor, all-weather, or harsh environments.

  • Experience managing manufacturing partners and supply chains.

  • Strong systems thinker. You reason cleanly across mechanical, electrical, firmware, and software boundaries.

Nice to Have

  • Experience across multiple mobile robot form factors (legged, wheeled, aerial).

  • Background in defense, security, industrial inspection, or other outdoor field robotics domains.

  • Familiarity with ROS 2 and modern robot bring-up workflows.

  • Prior experience starting and scaling a hardware team from zero.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.
