title: Head of Brand & Thought Leadership (Founders) (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du baust Founder-Brands, die Deals schließen?

Dann baue zwei B2B-Founder-Brands von 0 auf, steuere LinkedIn & Funnel und werde direkt am erzeugten Umsatz beteiligt.

Das ist eine Senior-Rolle mit voller Verantwortung, direkt an der Seite der beiden Gründer.

Vor 5,5 Jahren saßen wir zu zweit in einer WG in Düsseldorf. Kein Büro, kein Umsatz, keine Kunden. Nur ein Telefon.

Heute sind wir 35 Leute auf knapp 900 m² Office. Rügamer & Steiner ist eine E-Mail- und CRM-Marketing-Agentur für E-Commerce: Wir helfen Onlineshops, mehr Umsatz aus ihren Bestandskunden zu holen – mit E-Mail-Marketing, WhatsApp, Printmailings und datengetriebenem CRM. Für über 150 Shops steuern wir so über 200 Mio. € Jahresumsatz mit. Unser eigener Umsatz liegt im mittleren einstelligen Millionenbereich und hat sich seit der Gründung jedes Jahr verdoppelt.

Alles davon ist aus Telefonaten entstanden. Kein Marketing, keine Brand, kein Content. Erst haben wir selbst telefoniert, heute tut es ein 6-köpfiges Sales-Team, das gerade auf 10 wächst.

Unser Haken: Uns kennt kein Mensch.

Das ändern wir jetzt. Bis 2028 wollen wir 30 Mio. € Jahresumsatz machen und europäischer Marktführer werden in dem, was wir tun. Für unsere Kunden wollen wir jedes Jahr über 1 Mrd. € Umsatz bewegen. Dafür brauchen wir Sichtbarkeit. Und dafür brauchen wir dich.

Das Material liegt bereit: eine echte Geschichte, Zahlen, Cases und zwei Gründer, die jedes Jahr über 300.000 € investieren, um von den Besten zu lernen – unter anderem in der höchsten Mastermind von Alex Hormozi.

Deine Mission

  • Du baust die Personal Brands von Noah Rügamer und Aurelian Steiner auf – zuerst auf LinkedIn, später Newsletter, YouTube und Podcast.

  • Du entwickelst Positionierung, Content-Strategie, Formate, Hooks und Redaktionsplan – mit Fokus auf E-Commerce-Unternehmer, die mehr aus ihren Bestandskunden holen wollen.

  • Du baust den Weg von Reichweite zu Umsatz: Post → Kommentar oder DM → Termin → Auftrag für unser Sales-Team.

  • Du machst die Brands gleichzeitig zum Recruiting-Magneten für die besten Leute.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit uns Gründern: Content-Tage, Interviews, Skripte. Dein Ziel ist, dass wir so wenig Zeit wie möglich brauchen.

  • Daneben schärfst du den Marketing-Auftritt der Firma mit: Website, Ads, Bewerber-Kommunikation. Das ist der kleinere Teil.

Was du mitbringen musst

  • Du hast nachweislich eine B2B-Founder-Brand aufgebaut oder mit aufgebaut – deine eigene oder als Ghostwriter, Stratege oder Head of Content.

  • Über diese Brand ist nachweislich Umsatz entstanden: mindestens 100.000 € im Monat, idealerweise 200.000 bis 300.000 €.

  • Idealerweise kommst du aus dem B2B-Dienstleister- oder Agentur-Umfeld oder hast selbst eine Agentur über Personal Branding skaliert. Bonus: E-Commerce, Marketing oder SaaS.

  • Du denkst in Zahlen, nicht in Likes: Impressions → Leads → Termine → Aufträge.

  • Du bist stark in Strategie und dir trotzdem nicht zu schade, selbst Hooks zu schreiben, Posts zu veröffentlichen und DMs aufzusetzen.

  • Du arbeitest vor Ort in Düsseldorf.

Was wir bieten

  • 7.000 bis 10.000 € Fixgehalt im Monat. Mit variabler Vergütung sind 25.000 € und mehr im Monat möglich. Deine Ergebnisse bestimmen dein Gehalt.

  • Mentoring von den Besten auf dem internationalen Markt: Für Masterminds, Mentorings und Beratung geben wir jedes Jahr über 300.000 € aus, unter anderem für die höchste Mastermind von Alex Hormozi. Du bekommst Zugriff auf alle Inhalte und kommst als Teilnehmer mit auf die Events.

  • Direkter Draht zu beiden Gründern, keine Politik, keine Konzernstrukturen.

  • Ein hochmotiviertes Team, in 5,5 Jahren von 2 auf 35 Leute gewachsen.

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:
Über Hanwha Defence Deutschland GmbH

Die Hanwha Defence Deutschland GmbH ist die deutsche Tochtergesellschaft von Hanwha Aerospace und Teil der Hanwha Group – einem der größten Industrie- und Technologiekonzerne Südkoreas. Das Unternehmen treibt zukunftsweisende Lösungen in den Bereichen Verteidigung und Luft- und Raumfahrt voran, wobei der Fokus auf Innovation, technischer Exzellenz und internationaler Zusammenarbeit liegt.

Als Teil des globalen Hanwha Defence-Netzwerks erstrecken sich unsere Aktivitäten auf hochmoderne Verteidigungssysteme, Luft- und Raumfahrtkomponenten sowie integrierte Gesamtlösungen, die auf die sich wandelnden Anforderungen der nationalen Sicherheit und strategischer Verteidigungspartner zugeschnitten sind. Unter Nutzung der umfassenden Expertise von Hanwha in den Bereichen Land, Luft, See und Weltraum stärkt die Hanwha Defence Deutschland GmbH unsere Präsenz in Europa und unterstützt das gemeinsame Wachstum in der Region.

Mit dem Anspruch an Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit und langfristige Partnerschaften leisten wir einen Beitrag zu missionskritischen Programmen und technologischen Fortschritten, die die Verteidigungsfähigkeiten auf den globalen Märkten nachhaltig stärken.

Positionsprofil

Hanwha Defence Deutschland sucht einen hochstrategischen, tatkräftigen und gut vernetzten Head of Sales & Business Development zur Leitung unseres Wachstums in den Regionen DACH (Deutschland, Österreich, Schweiz) und Benelux.

Der ideale Kandidat verfügt über tiefgreifende Domain-Expertise im Bereich schwerer Landsysteme und/oder Luftverteidigung / C-UAS, untermauert durch ein etabliertes und aktives Netzwerk innerhalb des Bundesministeriums der Verteidigung (BMVg), des BAAINBw (speziell Sparte Kampf und Sparte Luft) sowie der regionalen Streitkräfte.

Es handelt sich um eine leitende Position, die eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Gestaltung, Akquise und Abwicklung langfristiger, hochvolumiger und komplexer Systemintegrationsprogramme erfordert.

Hauptaufgabe & Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Regionale Geschäftsstrategie: Formulierung und Umsetzung der BD-Strategie für schwere Landsysteme und C-UAS/Luftverteidigung in DACH & Benelux.

  • BAAINBw- & Kundenbeziehung: Aktive Schnittstelle und Projektanbahnung zu Schlüsselentscheidungsträgern im BMVg, BAAINBw sowie den Streitkräften.

  • Industrielle Kooperation: Anbahnung von Partnerschaften (Local Content, Sub-contracting) mit deutschen/europäischen Defence-OEMs und Systemintegratoren.

  • Offer & Capture Management: End-to-End-Verantwortung für Akquiseprozesse – von der RFI/RFP-Beantwortung bis zur finalen Vertragsverhandlung.

  • Leadership & Management: Strategische Führung übernehmen, funktionsübergreifende Teams koordinieren und leiten, Geschäftsentwicklungsprioritäten vorantreiben sowie das Senior Management bei wichtigen strategischen Entscheidungen unterstützen.

Kandidatenprofil & Qualifikationen

  • Domain-Expertise: Mindestens 10 Jahre nachweisbare BD-/Vertriebserfahrung im Bereich Landsysteme oder Luftverteidigungs-/C-UAS-Systeme.

  • Etabliertes BAAINBw-Netzwerk: Belastbare und aktuell nutzbare Kontakte zu BAAINBw Sparte Kampf (K1/K2) und/oder Sparte Luft (L) sowie zum BMVg.

  • Verhandlungs- & Abschlussstärke: Nachgewiesene Erfolge bei der Verhandlung und dem Abschluss von mehrjährigen Großprojekten im Verteidigungssektor.

  • Führungserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der fachlichen und disziplinarischen Führung sowie Entwicklung von Teams.

title: Head of System Architecture & Engineering (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
PHENOGY AG is a leading innovator of battery energy storage technologies and solutions for the green electrification of the planet. Our team members work on future-proof and sustainable battery systems that are powerful, safe, and robust – with circularity as a central principle. Our technology partner network spans leading battery research institutes. PHENOGY is an environmentally and socially conscious enterprise. We are committed to fostering prosperity for the people and our planet, ensuring sustainable growth – starting in the area of our greatest expertise and impact: energy storage solutions.

We energize the future.

PHENOGY is seeking curious, entrepreneurial-minded energy pioneers to help shape our vision, systems, and growth; playing a key-role as we launch into our ambitious future. If you’re inspired by our mission, values, and drive to change how we energize the future — we’d love your application.

We are looking for an experienced Manager who takes technical ownership how PHENOGY turns technology into system solutions from system strategy and architecture to the engineering that delivers it. You will define which applications we serve with which system solutions: Standard solutions configured from a modular kit of standard components, and application-specific solutions for selected target segments where a business case justifies them. Working closely with CTO, product lifecycle management and the business side, you make sure our engineering resources go where they create the most value. 

Your Tasks & Responsibilities 

  • Develop and own the system strategy: which applications we serve with which system solutions, and which belong to the standard kit or to application-specific solutions. 
  • Define and maintain the modular kit of standard components and reference architectures from which standard solutions are configured.

title: Helpdeskmedewerker Tandheelkundige Software
descriptionHtml:
Helpdeskmedewerker Tandheelkundige Software

Kwadijk | € 2.800 - € 3.600 per maand | 32-40 uur

Ben jij degene die klanten met een glimlach verder helpt?

Word jij blij van mensen helpen? Kun je goed luisteren, doorvragen en houd je ervan om samen tot een oplossing te komen? Dan zijn wij misschien wel op zoek naar jou!

Voor onze helpdesk zoeken we een klantvriendelijke en enthousiaste collega die onze klanten helpt bij vragen over het gebruik van onze software.

Je hoeft hiervoor geen programmeur of IT-specialist te zijn. Veel belangrijker vinden we dat je makkelijk contact maakt, geduldig bent en het leuk vindt om een vraag tot op de bodem uit te zoeken.

Heb je daarnaast ervaring binnen de tandheelkunde of mondzorg? Dan heb je bij ons absoluut een streepje voor!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Helpdesk-/supportmedewerker ben jij één van de eerste aanspreekpunten voor onze klanten. Zij nemen telefonisch, per e-mail of via het klantportaal contact met ons op met vragen over onze software.

Jij zorgt ervoor dat de klant zich gehoord en geholpen voelt.

Daarbij:

  • luister je goed naar de vraag van de klant;

  • stel je de juiste vragen om helder te krijgen wat er speelt;

  • help je de klant stap voor stap verder;

  • zoek je zaken uit als het antwoord niet direct duidelijk is;

  • overleg je met collega's wanneer dat nodig is;

  • registreer je duidelijk wat je hebt onderzocht en afgesproken;

  • en denk je mee over hoe we onze ondersteuning steeds een beetje beter kunnen maken.

Je hoeft echt niet op iedere vraag direct het antwoord te weten. Juist daarom werk je nauw samen met je collega's van de helpdesk en andere afdelingen.

Wie ben jij, en wat neem je mee?

Voor ons is vooral belangrijk hoe jij met mensen omgaat.

Je bent iemand die:

  • oprecht plezier haalt uit het helpen van klanten;

  • vriendelijk en geduldig blijft, ook als een klant gefrustreerd is;

  • goed kan luisteren en doorvragen;

  • duidelijk kan uitleggen, zonder het onnodig ingewikkeld te maken;

  • graag problemen uitzoekt en naar een oplossing toewerkt;

  • makkelijk met computers en software overweg kan;

  • graag samenwerkt en kennis deelt met collega's;

  • beschikt over minimaal mbo 4 werk- en denkniveau.

Tandheelkundige ervaring? Dat is voor ons een dikke pré!

Onze software wordt gebruikt binnen de mondzorg. Heb jij gewerkt als bijvoorbeeld tandartsassistent, preventieassistent, baliemedewerker, praktijkmanager of in een andere functie binnen de tandheelkunde? Dan helpt die praktijkkennis enorm om onze klanten en hun vragen snel te begrijpen.

Maar heb je geen tandheelkundige achtergrond en herken je jezelf sterk in de rest van het profiel? Dan nodigen we je zeker uit om te solliciteren.

Ook ervaring binnen een klantenservice, servicedesk of andere klantgerichte functie is mooi meegenomen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Zelfstandige en afwisselende functie in een dynamisch team;

  • Een open, vriendschappelijke en professionele sfeer met korte communicatielijnen;

  • Deelname aan fitness programma binnen werktijd in onze eigen fitnessruimte;

  • Mogelijkheden tot deels thuiswerken (na inwerkperiode);

  • Salaris is afhankelijk van opleiding, leeftijd en ervaring. Indicatie: Tussen €2.800 - € 3.600,-

  • Reiskostenvergoeding & Thuiswerkvergoeding;

  • 25 vakantiedagen o.b.v. 40 uur;

  • Een ruim opleidingsbudget en veel mogelijkheden tot ontwikkeling;

  • Meegroeien in een financieel gezonde en intern informele organisatie;

  • Een super mooi kantoor (oud stationsgebouw) met nog leukere collega’s;

  • En allerlei andere leuke voordelen!

Wie zijn wij?

In 1990 ontwikkelden we ons eerste Windows-softwarepakket voor tandartspraktijken in Nederland: Exquise. Inmiddels zijn we ruim dertig jaar verder. Dagelijks vertrouwen tandartspraktijken, mondhygiënisten en tandtechnische laboratoria op onze oplossingen. We kennen de mondzorg goed en begrijpen hoe belangrijk het is dat onze software gewoon doet wat het moet doen. Daarom blijven we continu ontwikkelen en zorgen we ervoor dat onze klanten optimaal met onze producten kunnen werken.

Uiteindelijk zijn het natuurlijk onze mensen die het verschil maken. Met ruim 100 enthousiaste collega’s zetten we ons iedere dag in om meer dan 3.000 relaties binnen de Nederlandse mondzorg te ondersteunen en te ontzorgen.

En daar komt onze Helpdesk om de hoek kijken!
Onze Helpdesk bestaat uit een betrokken en gezellig team van ongeveer 25 collega’s. Een mooie mix van fulltime en parttime medewerkers die samen klaarstaan voor onze klanten én voor elkaar. Je werkt dus in een team waarin altijd wel iemand is om mee te sparren, kennis te delen of natuurlijk even mee te lachen.

We werken hard, helpen elkaar waar nodig en vinden het minstens zo belangrijk dat er ruimte is voor gezelligheid en plezier. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat onze klanten verder kunnen, en hopelijk doe jij dat binnenkort met ons mee!

De sollicitatieprocedure

Ben je enthousiast geworden? Leuk! We maken graag kennis met je. Stuur je cv en motivatie naar

Uiteindelijk vinden we het vooral belangrijk dat het van beide kanten goed voelt. Heb je eerst nog vragen over de functie of over werken bij Vertimart? Neem dan gerust contact met ons op. We vertellen je graag meer!

Aan bureaus & recruiters: we got this. Profielen en cv’s die tóch ongevraagd worden toegezonden, zullen behandeld worden als directe sollicitaties van de kandidaat.

title: HR Generalist
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As HR Generalist, you are the go-to HR contact for managers and teams in Crissier and Zurich. You turn company priorities into concrete HR actions: contract administration, onboarding, development, employee relations and compliance with Swiss employment law.

  

Responsibilities

Manager & Employee Partnership

  • Work in close collaboration with R&D management to support them in the design of the organization

  • Act as the single HR contact for Switzerland: present daily in Crissier, and a reliable remote partner for Zurich with regular visits

  • Give managers concrete, operational HR answers grounded in Swiss law, and address employee concerns promptly

  • Communicate with the teams with pedagogy to support and explain the organization

Stay aligned with the Paris HR team and group policy while remaining locally compliant

Local Compliance & Employment Law

  • Own compliance with Swiss employment law across the employee lifecycle (contracts, probation, working time, leave, termination) and adapt group contracts and HR policies to Swiss requirements

  • Manage relations with cantonal labor and migration authorities (Vaud and Zurich): filings, registrations, inspections

  • Handle employee representation obligations as headcount grows and keep leadership ahead of regulatory change

Payroll & Social Declarations

  • Own the monthly payroll cycle with our provider and Finance: validate variable inputs (absences, overtime, bonuses, joiners, leavers) and cross-check payslips

  • Ensure timely social and tax declarations and manage benefits (health, accident, pension)

HR Operations & Personnel Administration

  • Manage individual employee situations end to end: disciplinary procedures, conflict resolution, sensitive cases

  • Handle personnel administration (contracts, amendments, files, certificates), run absences in HiBob and produce HR metrics

  • Own work permit applications (G, B,L) for foreign nationals joining Crissier and Zurich: file with the DGEM, follow up until approval, and handle related cantonal and residence formalities

Onboarding, Offboarding & Mobility

  • Work with Talent Acquisition, who own recruitment: take over once an offer is accepted and run contracts, administration and onboarding for both sites

  • Handle offboarding with correct Swiss formalities and clear handover

  

Candidate Requirements

  • Master's degree or equivalent in HR, law, management or a related field

  • HR Manager certificate (Certificat de Gestionnaire RH, HRSE)

  • 10+ years in generalist HR or HR Business Partner roles, ideally in an SME or scale-up

  • Strong knowledge of Swiss employment law and social insurance; experience with work permits (G, B, L) is a plus

Skills

  • Credibility with managers and engineers; able to advise and decide

  • Rigor, confidentiality, autonomy and a taste for building processes

  • Comfort with an HRIS (HiBob) and reporting tools

Languages

  • Fluent French and English; Swiss-German is an asset for Zurich

Nice to have

  • Experience in defense, aerospace or deeptech, and with multi-site teams

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Inbound Account Development Representative - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach.

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Inbound Sales 🇫🇷
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).

You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.

At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.

What does make this role exciting :

  • You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating!

  • The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements

  • You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

  • You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members

  • You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects

  • We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!

⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: 

  • Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills

  • Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects

  • Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems

  • Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team

  • Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: Ingénieur-e R&D Instruments Chirurgicaux
descriptionHtml:
Notre univers

eCential Robotics est une entreprise française innovante spécialisée dans la chirurgie assistée par robot.

Nous développons et commercialisons des solutions alliant imagerie 2D/3D robotisée, navigation en temps réel et robotique chirurgicale, afin d’accompagner les chirurgiens orthopédiques et neurochirurgiens dans leurs interventions.

Avec plus de 15 ans d’expérience et plus de 100 brevets déposés, nous proposons une technologie de pointe, simple d’utilisation et facile à mettre en œuvre, au service d’une chirurgie plus sûre, plus précise et moins invasive.

Reconnue à l’international, eCential Robotics poursuit son ambition de devenir un leader du secteur de la robotique chirurgicale, un domaine en pleine croissance, et de contribuer chaque jour à façonner le bloc opératoire de demain.

Vos missions

Au sein de l’équipe R&D, vous interviendrez notamment sur :

  • la conception et le développement d’instruments chirurgicaux ;
  • la traduction des besoins cliniques et utilisateurs en solutions techniques ;

L’instrumentation chirurgicale est un élément essentiel de nos systèmes de navigation, combinant les problématiques propres aux instruments chirurgicaux avec les challenges des systèmes de navigation robotisés (stérilisation, biocompatibilité, précision, ergonomie, gestion des risques, …).

Une première expérience dans le dispositif médical, l’instrumentation chirurgicale ou le développement de produits soumis à de fortes contraintes réglementaires constituera un réel atout.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Travailler chez nous, c’est :

· Évoluer dans une ambiance bienveillante, simple et collaborative, où chacun se connaît et contribue aux succès collectifs ;

· Participer à de beaux projets porteurs de sens, dans un environnement stimulant et innovant ;

descriptionHtml:
Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. As an Inside Sales Account Executive, you will be part of a team that is transforming the way restaurants operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new restaurateurs across the UK by understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customized solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion and expertise to help us build the Toast brand. 

Hybrid role with 3 days in our London office. London W1W 8BJ, UK

About this roll*?  (Responsibilities)

  • Generate list of prospective restaurants and manage the entire sales cycle from initial call to close (experience with self-sourcing clients is a huge plus)
  • Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs 
  • Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery
  • Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities
  • Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Toast in the market

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

  • 1+ years of experience in a sourcing or closing sales role, restaurant operations, or a relatable field and industry
  • Strong communication, organisational and presentation skills with the ability to sell and negotiate at all decision-making levels
  • Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and team environment
  • Self-motivated, creative, and flexible
  • General technical proficiency with software
  • Experience with Salesforce CRM is a nice to have

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.


Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

title: Internal Communications Manager
descriptionHtml:
Every team has AI. Few have mastered it. Humans were built to adapt, but AI is now moving faster than most workforces can.

Multiverse is the AI adoption layer: the missing link between the AI tools that companies have invested in and the people expected to use them.

Our ambition is to put AI capability in every worker’s hands. Apprenticeships got us started: we’ve trained over a third of the UK’s data and AI apprentices, worked with a third of the FTSE 100, and generated £2bn+ in verified ROI. Now Mastry, our new adaptive learning platform, takes that further, guiding a company’s AI workforce transformation from start to finish. Mae, our AI guide inside Mastry, is a real-time AI agent that thinks, speaks, listens and sees, working alongside the tools you already use, like Claude and Copilot.

We closed our latest fundraising round in April 2026, with $500m+ raised in total from VC partners including Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Schroders Capital and Lightspeed. With a $2.1bn valuation, we are Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn, and we are just getting started.

If you want to shape how the workforce wins in the AI era, come and join us.

The Opportunity

Internal communications at Multiverse isn't a downstream function. It's a strategic one.

You'll own the story Multiverse tells itself — making sure every colleague understands who we are, why it matters, and where we're going. That means shaping All Hands, advising the exec team, translating data into narratives people can actually repeat, and building the rhythms that keep colleagues informed week to week — not just when something big happens.

We operate in a fast-moving space with real external scrutiny. You'll need to be a strong instinctive writer, calm under pressure, and confident enough to tell leadership what needs to be said and when. If you want to own the internal narrative of one of the most ambitious companies in the UK skills and AI space — this is the role.

Specifically, you will

  • Own the canonical story Multiverse tells itself: maintain a living messaging framework that captures who we are, what we do, and why it matters, keeping it current as the business evolves

  • Produce internal briefing materials ahead of major external moments like regulatory decisions, product launches, policy developments, so leadership is never scrambling and every Multiverser finds out what the need to know, first.

  • Own the internal FAQ and "what to say if asked" resources that equip every colleague to be an informed and confident ambassador for the business

  • Take editorial ownership of All Hands: theme, narrative arc, content commissioning, and speaker preparation, ensuring it consistently moves the needle on alignment and energy

  • Support our Exec team with internal-facing communications - town halls, written updates, video messages - ensuring tone and content are consistent with our external narrative

  • Build a rhythm of regular leadership communication that doesn't only happen at All Hands, so colleagues feel informed week-to-week, not just quarter-to-quarter

  • Own the content programme that tells the employee story: learner outcomes, team culture, career progression, mission moments, taking guidance and inspiration from the EVP and aligning with priority recruitment marketing campaigns where required

  • Partner with the People team on key cultural moments so messaging is coherent and consistently on-brand

  • Own and optimise our internal channels (Slack, intranet, email newsletters), deciding what goes where, at what frequency, and in what format, and build measurement into the channel strategy through open rates, engagement, and feedback loops

  • Work hand-in-hand with Data & Insights and the wider Comms team to translate internal performance data into narratives that colleagues can understand, use, and repeat

  • Build a simple framework for measuring whether internal comms is working — do people feel informed, do they understand the strategy, can they articulate the narrative — and report quarterly to the Director of Communications on channel health and narrative consistency

About you

  • You embody the mission. You believe in equipping workers to win in the AI era, and you want every colleague to feel that purpose in how they show up at work

  • You have hands-on experience leading internal communications in a fast-moving, complex organisation, and you've owned narrative, channels, and leadership comms

  • You understand that internal comms is not a downstream function. You sit at the intersection of Data & Insights, Product, and external Comms

  • You're a strong, instinctive writer and editor, able to sharpen a leadership message, a town hall script, or a sensitive change announcement with equal confidence

  • You know how to translate data into story: you can take customer ROI evidence, learner outcomes, or operational performance figures and turn them into something every Multiverser can articulate and believe in

  • You're fluent in AI tools and use them to move faster and think bigger, but you apply rigorous human judgement to everything that goes out under Multiverse's name

  • You're calm and clear-headed under pressure: comfortable drafting sensitive internal communications in real time when external scrutiny spikes, and confident telling leadership what needs to be said and when

  • You're operationally strong on channels - Slack, intranet, email

  • You partner well with senior leaders: you can hold your own in a room with the exec team, give honest counsel on tone and timing, and earn trust quickly

  • You thrive in networked organisations, collaborating fluidly with People, Product, Tech, Data & Insights, and the wider Comms team

  • You see All Hands and leadership comms as strategic levers, not logistical exercises, and you have a track record of using them to drive genuine alignment

Benefits

  • Time off: 27 days holiday (including 3 winter shutdown days) and bank holidays, plus 5 extra days off (1 life event, 2 volunteer days and 2 summer shutdown days).

  • Health and wellbeing: Bupa private medical insurance, a medical cash back plan, therapy through Spill and gym access through Wellhub.

  • Equity for all: we believe that when Multiverse wins, we all win, which is why every permanent employee receives share options.

  • Financial security: life insurance at 3x salary, a workplace pension with 4% contribution from us, Cycle to Work and a Tech Scheme.

  • Family support: enhanced maternity and paternity leave, adoption and shared parental leave, paid leave after pregnancy loss, and a workplace nursery scheme.

  • Hybrid working: 3 days a week in the office - except for Coaches & Instructors who come into the office 1 day per month. Plus 10 days a year to work from anywhere.

  • Work perks: quarterly team socials, company-wide events, happy hours, lunch delivered to the office once a week, fully stocked snack bar and a drinks fridge!


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy, our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).

For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings.

Providing false information is an offence and could result in the application being rejected or summary dismissal if the applicant has been selected, and possible referral to the police and the DBS.

title: Internship - Founders Office (Talent)
descriptionHtml:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

mission
As the Founders’ Office Intern (Talent) at telli, you’ll work right alongside the founding team on the thing that decides how fast we grow: hiring. You’ll have a front-row seat to how an early-stage AI company builds its team and a very hands-on role in finding, assessing and closing the people who join us next. Your focus is talent, with the option to grow into broader ops and strategic projects in the founders’ office over time.

what you’ll do:

  • help us build the hiring engine behind telli’s growth

  • spot outlier candidates through LinkedIn, Juicebox, communities, referrals and new channels you come up with

  • write signal-based outreach that gets replies, and don’t take a plain “no” for an answer

  • run first interviews: assess fit quickly and pitch telli to the best candidates

  • own hiring pipelines across teams, from outreach to offer, and keep hiring managers and interviewers aligned

  • track the funnel per role, spot friction like unusual drop-off rates and fix it

  • build automations and AI workflows, e.g. for sourcing, messaging, interview prep and candidate coordination

  • help shape how telli shows up as an employer, through job posts, social content and events

  • once you’ve got hiring running, pick up first ops and strategic projects alongside the founders’ office

  • work closely with Dat, Ennie & the founding team

what makes you a great fit:

  • you’re hands-on and not afraid of unglamorous work

  • you’re open, curious and love meeting new people

  • you have an eye for what makes someone exceptional

  • you can sell: you get people excited about an opportunity and handle objections

  • you take ownership, move fast and follow up with urgency

  • you’re data-minded, tech- & AI-savvy and pick up new tools fast

  • you communicate clearly and top-down in English and German

  • you have first experience in recruiting, sales, a startup or your own projects

  • you could imagine joining full-time after the internship

you may not make a good fit if:

  • you’ve never used AI or automation tools and aren’t keen to learn

  • you don’t get excited about finding the people who’ll shape telli’s next chapter

  • you find it hard to keep many candidates and interviewers moving at once

  • you’d rather wait for instructions than pick up the phone and follow up yourself

  • you’re only looking for a typical 9–5 internship

Compensation: €3K – €5K per month

title: IoT Embedded Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:
• Take ownership of the development of IoT systems, with a focus on embedded software, system architecture, and hardware and firmware integration

  • Design and develop robust, efficient, and scalable embedded software for IoT products based on microcontroller platforms and, optionally, Linux based systems

  • Provide technical guidance for hardware development in collaboration with external partners, including reviewing and challenging PCB designs to ensure functionality, quality, and manufacturability

  • Collaborate closely with mechanical, software, and cloud engineering teams to ensure seamless end to end system integration

  • Define and refine product requirements from initial concept through to mass production in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders

  • Develop and integrate prototypes and support the transition from development into serial production together with manufacturing partners

  • Contribute to the continuous evolution of the embedded platform, including MCU based solutions as well as optional Linux and Yocto based components

  • Develop pragmatic testing strategies to ensure the functionality, reliability, and quality of both hardware and firmware

  • Support development and manufacturing partners with debugging, technical documentation, and production ramp up

  • Provide Level 3 technical support for complex system, firmware, and hardware related issues

  • Travel approximately 5 to 10 percent to support development partners, product validation activities, and product launches


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

  • Several years of hands on experience in embedded development, including firmware development and hardware related engineering

  • Strong understanding of hardware design and PCB layouts, with the ability to review design decisions and collaborate effectively with hardware development teams

  • Strong expertise in embedded firmware development and software architecture for microcontroller platforms such as ARM Cortex, ESP32, or STM32

  • Experience with sensor integration and wireless communication technologies such as BLE and WiFi

  • Experience with embedded Linux systems, particularly Yocto, is an advantage, especially in environments combining System on Modules with MCU based architectures

  • Broad system level understanding of mechanics, sensors, actuators, and their integration into robust IoT products

  • Hands on experience with hardware testing, debugging tools, and automated production testing

  • Familiarity with certification standards such as CE and FCC is an advantage

  • Fluent in German and English, with additional languages considered a plus

title: IT Security Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
As an IT Security Engineer (m/f/d), you will be responsible for strengthening and protecting our organization's IT environment against evolving cyber threats. You will work closely with infrastructure, software, and operational teams to design, implement, and maintain security controls that ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of our systems and data. We are looking for a hands-on security professional who is passionate about cybersecurity, enjoys solving complex challenges, and thrives in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Monitor, analyze, and respond to security events, alerts, and incidents

  • Develop and enforce security policies in collaboration with internal stakeholders, taking into account industry-specific compliance requirements

  • Perform system hardening and security baseline management for servers, endpoints, and critical infrastructure components.

  • Support the deployment and administration of security solutions such as Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR), SIEM, vulnerability management, and identity security platforms.

  • Design, implementation, and operation of firewall infrastructures using Fortinet and Sophos technologies.

  • Manage and improve access control concepts, identity management processes, and privileged access security.

  • Support for audits and certifications in accordance with industry-specific security standards (e.g., BSI Basic Protection, ISO/IEC 27001)

  • IT Collaboration with national and international subsidiaries

  • Investigate emerging threats, evaluate new security technologies, and contribute to the continuous enhancement of our cybersecurity posture.

  • Support for user network issues.

  • Create and maintain documentation, standards, and operational procedures.


What you bring to the team:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a comparable qualification. A plus would be CCNA, CompTIA+

  • Professional experience in IT security, system administration, infrastructure engineering.

  • Good understanding of cybersecurity principles, attack vectors, threat detection, and incident response processes.

  • Hands-on experience with security technologies such as EDR/XDR, SIEM, vulnerability scanners, firewalls, or identity and access management solutions.

  • Knowledge of Windows environments; experience with Linux systems is highly desirable.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 security services, Entra ID, Intune, and cloud security concepts.

  • Work with cloud security tools like Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Security Center

  • Understanding of networking, including TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and network segmentation.

  • A proactive mindset, high attention to detail, and a genuine passion for cybersecurity.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

  • Fluency in English; German language skills are considered a plus.

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

title: Jr. Marketing Development Representative (MDR)
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Every month, hundreds of potential customers show interest in Trengo. They start a free trial, request a demo, or leave their contact details. But not everyone gets the personal follow-up they need to take the next step.

That's where you come in.

As our Marketing Development Representative (MDR), you'll be the first personal point of contact for potential customers, helping them find the right way to get started with Trengo.

You'll join our Growth Marketing team and work closely with Sales, sitting right at the intersection of marketing and sales. You'll turn the demand we generate into real business opportunities, whether that's booking a meeting with an Account Executive or helping someone become a paying customer through our self-serve journey.

This is a hands-on junior role where you'll get to learn how a fast-moving AI SaaS company turns marketing efforts into revenue, with plenty of room to experiment, develop your skills, and make a measurable impact.

It's an 8-month contract with the possibility of extension.

About Trengo

Welcome to the forefront of AI-driven communication. At Trengo, we’re redefining the industry by replacing repetitive work with meaningful conversations through our AI-powered customer engagement platform. We unify communication channels and leverage agentic AI to deliver proactive, human-like service, boosting efficiency for thousands of businesses worldwide.

As a fast-moving Dutch scale-up, backed by a $36M Series A and an official WhatsApp Business Solutions Provider, we thrive on acceleration. Your expertise will drive growth: you’ll make a strategic impact, champion AI innovation, and help shape the product roadmap. You’ll do this alongside an international team guided by our Dynamic pace, Future-proof mindset, Ownership, and Open culture.

What your role looks like:

Turn inbound interest into opportunities

  • Be the first personal point of contact for new inbound leads, reaching out through calls and personalised emails, ideally within the same working day.

  • Follow up with qualified free-trial sign-ups, demo requests and prospects who have expressed interest but haven't booked a meeting.

  • Re-engage prospects whose meetings weren't booked, were cancelled or resulted in a no-show, and help them take the next step.

  • Connect qualified prospects with the right Account Executive, making sure they have the context needed for a productive conversation.

Help prospects become self-serve customers

  • Reach out to prospects who might not be the right fit for a sales conversation but could still benefit from Trengo.

  • Understand what they're looking for, answer initial questions and guide them towards the right self-serve plan.

  • Follow up with free-trial users to help them get started and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers.

Improve how we engage with leads

  • Experiment with different outreach messages, sequences and follow-up approaches to understand what converts best.

  • Share insights with Marketing and Sales about common objections, lead quality and what prospects are looking for.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate and up to date by logging interactions, tracking outcomes and maintaining clean lead data.

How we'll measure success

You'll have a direct impact on our growth, with clear results you can track:

  • Speed of follow-up: Making sure inbound prospects receive timely, personal attention.

  • Meetings generated: Booking qualified meetings that turn into conversations with our Account Executives.

  • Self-serve conversions: Helping prospects progress from initial interest to becoming paying customers.

  • Continuous improvement: Finding better ways to engage prospects and sharing insights that help our Marketing and Sales teams improve.

The tools you'll work with

You'll get hands-on experience with our commercial and AI toolkit:

  • HubSpot: CRM, lead management, outreach sequences and calling.

  • RevenueHero: Lead routing and meeting booking.

  • Fathom: Call recordings, feedback and coaching.

  • Slack & Notion: Team collaboration, processes and playbooks.

  • AI tools: Researching prospects, personalising outreach and experimenting with smarter ways of working.

What you’ll bring

  • 1-2 years of experience, ideally through an internship or an early-career role in sales, marketing, customer success or a customer-facing environment.

  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. Dutch is a big plus.

  • Confidence in communication: You're comfortable picking up the phone, writing personalised emails and starting conversations with people you haven't met.

  • A proactive mindset: You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You spot opportunities and take initiative.

  • An organised way of working: You can manage multiple conversations, prioritise your day and follow through on commitments.

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn: You're interested in SaaS, AI and how businesses grow, and you're open to coaching and feedback.

  • A results-driven attitude: You enjoy working towards clear goals, experimenting with different approaches and understanding what works.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with HubSpot or other CRM tools.

  • Exposure to inbound lead follow-up, prospecting or sales processes.

  • Additional language skills such as Dutch, German, French, Spanish or Italian.

  • Familiarity with eCommerce, WhatsApp Business or customer communication platforms.

  • Experience using AI tools to research prospects, personalise communication or improve workflows.

⚙️ Our tech & AI mindset

AI is not a buzzword at Trengo — it’s part of how we build and operate. You’ll work with AI-driven features, automation, data, or tools that help us move faster and smarter. We value thoughtful use of AI that creates real value for customers and teams.

What’s in it for you?

This is what we carefully prepared for you:

  • 🚀 A key role where you’ll make a visible impact in a vibrant scale-up environment.

  • 🌍 Hybrid working + 2 months per year to work abroad.

  • 🏗️ A strong onboarding program with hands-on training and a dedicated buddy to set you up for success.

  • 🧘 Mental health support with free sessions from on-demand psychologists (OpenUp).

  • 📚 Learning budget + 2 extra days off to attend courses or conferences.

  • 🌴 28 vacation days to rest, recharge, and travel

  • 🚆 Travel reimbursement to our Utrecht HQ.

  • 📶 Monthly internet & phone allowance to stay connected.

  • 🗣️ Dutch courses for our international colleagues.

  • 🍴 Daily warm lunches prepared by our workplace experience team when you’re at our beautiful Utrecht office.

  • 💼 Pension contribution to help you plan for the future.

  • 🛫 Sabbatical: After two years, enjoy up to three months away (unpaid) to rest, recharge, or see the world.

🔍 Our hiring process

  1. Introductory call – First conversation with our Talent team.

title: Junior Fullstack Engineer (m/w/d) TS, React, Next.js & AI  100% Remote
descriptionHtml:
NotarPartner baut die digitale Arbeitsumgebung für das deutsche Notariat – von Notaren für Notare. Aufgaben

- Du entwickelst Features end-to-end: von der Idee über das React/Next.js-Frontend bis zu den Node.js-Services und dem Datenmodell in PostgreSQL.

- Du prägst unsere Engineering-Standards mit: Code Reviews, Architekturentscheidungen und der Aufbau eines Teams.

Qualifikation

- Keine förmliche Berufserfahrung notwendig, stattdessen zeige uns spannende Projekte, die du als Fullstack Engineer eigenverantwortlich von Anfang bis Produktion umgesetzt hast.

- Sehr sicher in React, Next.js, TypeScript und Node.js; solide Kenntnisse in PostgreSQL (Supabase) und/oder NoSQL-Datenbanken.

- Echte Begeisterung für KI-Tooling (z. B. Claude) und agentische Workflows – du nutzt sie nicht nur, du denkst in ihnen.

- Ausgeprägtes Produktverständnis: Du fragst zuerst, welches Problem gelöst werden soll, und erst dann, wie es gebaut wird.

- Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2). Unser Produkt lebt von notarieller Fachterminologie – ohne sprachliche Präzision geht es hier nicht.

- Wohnsitz in Deutschland und Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Teamtreffen.

Nice to have: Erfahrung in Legal Tech oder anderen regulierten Branchen, mit Multi-Tenant-Architekturen oder mit datenschutzkritischen Systemen.

Benefits

- Gehalt: 50.000 – 65.000 € Fixum inkl. VSOP

- VSOP-Beteiligung: Du profitierst direkt am Unternehmenserfolg – mit klarem Exit-Fokus in den nächsten 3 bis 5 Jahren.

- 100 % Remote innerhalb Deutschlands, plus Workation-Phasen (z. B. zwei Wochen Spanien).

- Vertrauensarbeitszeit und 30 Urlaubstage.

- Modernste KI-Tools als fester Bestandteil des Workflows – nicht als Pilotprojekt, sondern als Standard.

- Starkes Team (3 leidenschaftliche Engineers, Product-Owner, Notar, Sales-Team), maximale Eigenverantwortung und echte Mitgestaltung statt Zuarbeit.

- Regelmäßige Teamtreffen in Hamburg, Berlin.

Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich – ein CV oder dein GitHub/LinkedIn-Profil reichen völlig, ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

So läuft es ab:

1. Kennenlernen: 20–30 Minuten Video-Call mit unserem CTO – über dich, das Produkt und deinen Blick darauf.

2. Practical Task: eine kompakte, praxisnahe Aufgabe (z. B. eine kleine Web-App) – KI-Unterstützung ausdrücklich erwünscht.

3. Deep Dive: gemeinsame Auswertung deiner Lösung und Kennenlernen des Teams.

Im Anschluss entscheiden wir zügig. Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt.

  • Frontend: React
  • Data: PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch
  • Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Google Cloud

5. Languages

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match. Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

title: Key Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Our Account Management team’s purpose is to make our key accounts stay and grow with Alan. We created the team in 2020 and we are now 30+.
We are looking for amazing people to help us take care of our growing pipe on Public Sector accounts (Ministries and other public entities).
Being a Key Account Manager at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate experts, with different backgrounds.
We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?


As a Key Account Manager, you will:

  • Handle a portfolio of strategic accounts in the Public Sector

You would be a great fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

  • You are very analytical, very comfortable with presenting deep data analysis to clients and solving complex problems

  • You have great active listening skills and are a master in the art of crafting the right follow-up message

  • You have a growth mindset: you are able to adapt to new trends and to develop an in-depth understanding of the health insurance market

  • You are currently based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux or Marseille.


It is nice to have a previous experience in Insurance or any industry linked to benefits. Having experience with or within the Public Sector space is also a nice to have.


For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-E level range.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Bordeaux or Marseille.

title: Lead Analytics Engineer - Finance Data (FinOps)
descriptionHtml:
About Finom
Finom is growing fast, and Finance needs data that grows with it. As our Lead Analytics Engineer for Finance, you'll be the data partner for treasury, reconciliation and accounting. You'll also support our corporate finance and investor reporting work together with the team's existing data partner. You'll build and scale the data model behind these areas, set standards, integrate the systems Finance relies on and bring in automation, including agents, where it saves real work

This isn't a "build what's in the ticket" role. You'll learn how Finance works and why, understand where the value is, and work with the team on how their processes run, proposing improvements and the data and tools to support them. You'll report to the Head of Central Data

What You Will Be Doing
- Partner with the Treasury, Reconciliation and Accounting teams on their processes, priorities and how data supports them.
- Build out treasury data: positions, cash flows and liquidity, as trusted data products the team can rely on day to day.
- Build and scale reconciliation, so that matching, breaks and exceptions are handled systematically rather than by hand.
- Support Accounting with the data, checks and integrations behind their close and day-to-day work.
- Support our corporate finance data partner on corporate finance and investor reporting, working from one shared model and set of definitions.
- Design and evolve the Finance data model, entities and metrics, with tests, lineage and documentation, so the team can reuse and extend them.
- Set data standards and quality checks for Finance data, and build integrations with the systems Finance uses.
- Bring automation and agents into Finance workflows where they remove recurring manual work.
- Look at how Finance processes run today, identify what can work better and connect each piece of data work to its business cost and value.


How We Work
You'll have high autonomy. You choose the tools and the approach, including trialling new vendors and open-source solutions. Sign-off is needed in two cases. The first is architecture: whether a solution scales, holds across use cases and growing volumes, and runs without constant support. The second is anything that feeds high-stakes decisions. Priorities are set by final business impact.


Who You Are
- You've worked in or closely with Finance: in a finance team, as a finance data partner, or in data work centred on treasury, reconciliation, accounting or FP&A.
- You understand how a finance function works: the close, cash and liquidity, reconciliations and the reports that come out of them.
- You write expert SQL and have strong dimensional or semantic data modelling skills.
- You've built metrics and data products that other teams depend on.
- You have ETL and data warehouse or lakehouse experience, including onboarding sources end to end.
- You choose precision over speed when the two conflict.
- You work like a consultant to the business: you understand how a process works, propose solutions and frame them in terms of business value.


Nice to Have
- Databricks and Unity Catalog
- Experience integrating ERP, accounting, banking or treasury systems
- Experience with workflow automation or agents in finance processes
- CI/CD, orchestration and infrastructure-as-code
- Background in fintech, banking or payments


How You'll Grow
In your first months you get to know Finance, the model, the stack and your stakeholders. By six months you're self-sufficient and make judgement calls on scope and design without escalating. From there, you set long-term goals together with your Finance stakeholders, own the data roadmap for treasury, reconciliation and accounting, and mentor others on analytics-engineering practice.

The Team
We're a small central team that works with every function, and Finance is our primary partner. We use a modern stack, you're free to try new tools, and there are incentives for driving change. AI assistants take on routine work so people can focus on harder problems. We work in English, think long term, and build data that functions keep developing after we deliver it
