title: Lead Cloud Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über das Unternehmen

Unser Partner Datasolut ist eine Data- & AI-Beratung aus Köln. Das Team hilft Unternehmen dabei, aus ihren Daten echten Mehrwert zu machen: von der ersten KI-Strategie über moderne Lakehouse-Plattformen bis hin zu Machine-Learning- und Agentic-AI-Lösungen, die im Alltag tatsächlich laufen. Und nicht nur auf Folien gut aussehen.

Was Datasolut macht:Datasolut begleitet seine Kunden auf dem ganzen Weg: gemeinsam verstehen, wo sie stehen, umsetzen, was wirklich gebraucht wird, und skalieren, was funktioniert. Strategie und Umsetzung kommen aus einer Hand. Kein Übergeben, kein Neu-Erklären, kein Stille-Post-Spiel.Technologisch ist Datasolut ganz vorne mit dabei: Als Databricks Silver Partner und einer der wenigen Microsoft Fabric Featured Partner in Deutschland arbeitest du mit den Plattformen, die gerade die Datenwelt prägen. CTO Laurenz ist Databricks MVP. Heißt für dich: Hier lernst du von Leuten, die wissen, wovon sie reden.

So arbeitet das Team:Datasolut ist kein Konzern, und das ist auch gut so. Es gibt kurze Wege, flache Hierarchien und echte Verantwortung von Anfang an. Deine Ideen landen nicht in einer Schublade, sondern im nächsten Projekt. Das Team teilt Wissen, hilft sich gegenseitig weiter und feiert Erfolge gemeinsam.

Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich! Wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen und dich mit Datasolut zusammenzubringen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust für unsere Kunden Cloud-Infrastrukturen und -Ressourcen in Microsoft Azure auf, verbindest Netzwerke und Datenquellen und bettest alles sauber in das Gesamtkonstrukt ein.

  • Du setzt Infrastructure as Code mit Terraform selbst um, inklusive Deployments, und sorgst mit CI/CD für saubere und robuste Prozesse.

  • Du führst das wachsende Cloud-Team mit aktuell drei Engineers fachlich.

  • Du baust Standards und Best Practices für die Cloud-Projekte auf, damit bei jedem Kunden schneller und verlässlicher geliefert wird.

  • Du entwickelst den Bereich Cloud weiter, bringst neue Impulse in unser Angebot ein und erkennst Potenziale bei unseren Kunden.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Data & AI Engineers zusammen, damit Cloud-Infrastruktur, Datenplattformen wie Databricks und KI-Lösungen nahtlos zusammenspielen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • 4 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Cloud Engineering, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft Azure.

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, insbesondere Terraform, sowie mit CI/CD und DevOps-Prinzipien.

  • Gutes Verständnis von Netzwerken, Security und der Anbindung von Datenquellen in Cloud-Umgebungen.

  • Erfahrung mit Databricks ist ein großes Plus. Kenntnisse in AWS oder Snowflake sind ebenfalls willkommen.

  • Beratungserfahrung ist sehr wünschenswert. Vor allem solltest du Bock auf Kundenkontakt haben.

  • Führungserfahrung ist kein Muss. Wichtig ist, dass du Lust hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und andere fachlich weiterzubringen.

  • Organisationstalent und Kommunikationsstärke: Du behältst den Überblick und erklärst komplexe Themen verständlich; im Team genauso wie gegenüber Nicht-Techies.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Muttersprache oder C1-Niveau mit Nachweis) und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Das bekommst du

  • Projekte mit echtem Impact statt Beschäftigungstherapie

  • Arbeiten mit modernsten Data- & AI-Technologien wie Databricks und Microsoft Fabric

  • Ein Team, das Bock auf Daten hat und dich mitzieht

  • Raum zum Lernen, Ausprobieren und Wachsen

  • Wahl zwischen JobRad und Deutschlandticket (Urban Sports Club folgt bald!)

  • 3 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche

  • Modernes Office mit zwei Büroflächen im Herzen von Köln-Ehrenfeld - viele Restaurants für die Mittagspause sind fußläufig erreichbar

  • Eigenes Gym im Office und alle 2 Wochen dienstags nach Feierabend Training mit unserer Personal Trainerin

  • Siebträgermaschine für richtig guten Kaffee

Warum Datasolut?

Als hochmotiviertes Team sind für Datasolut gute Zusammenarbeit, Transparenz und offene Kommunikation sehr wichtig. Das Team besteht aus echten Machern mit starken Meinungen, die sich trotzdem nicht zu ernst nehmen.

Die Projekte sind in der Regel auf den Großraum Köln fokussiert, lange Reisezeiten werden also möglichst vermieden. Datasolut legt sehr viel Wert auf ein starkes Team und versucht, Projekteinsätze wenn möglich gemeinsam als Team zu lösen. Neben der Arbeit bei Kunden ist es Datasolut wichtig, interne Projekte und innovative Datenprodukte voranzutreiben.

title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.


About the team

 

Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

About the role

As a Lead Machine Learning Engineer at Faculty, you will set the technical direction for complex AI/ML projects, ensuring models perform at scale and in production over time by balancing technical trade-offs and guiding team priorities.

You will lead the delivery of large-scale AI-powered platforms in high-risk environments while defining project roadmaps across multiple complex workstreams.


This is an ambitious, entrepreneurial leadership role where you will act as a trusted technical expert, defending your architectural rationale to senior stakeholders to ensure we deliver high-quality, high-value outputs.

  

What you'll be doing:

  • Designing, implementing, and maintaining reliable, scalable ML systems while justifying key architectural decisions for production environments.

  • Driving the development of shared libraries and infrastructure for model deployment, lifecycle management, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Leading model integration with infrastructure by creating APIs and services that enable scalable AI functionality in applications.

  • Overseeing the delivery of multiple complex workstreams and defining project problems in high-risk environments.

  • Ensuring reliable model performance by defining testing frameworks and model versioning systems for senior engineers to implement.

  • Managing and coaching multiple individuals, setting team-wide development goals to improve technical depth and client delivery.

  • Executing proactive recommendations for adopting new technologies and AI frameworks to maintain Faculty's competitive market position.

  

Who we're looking for:

  • You are an expert at defining technical roadmaps and managing project priorities to deliver high-stakes outcomes within high-growth environments.

  • You possess mastery of cloud-native ecosystems and orchestration tools like Kubernetes to automate complex model lifecycles and robust CI/CD pipelines.

  • You have a proven ability to design large-scale, AI-powered platforms and provide the technical justification for critical architectural decisions in high-risk environments.

  • You bring expert-level experience in operationalising models within frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch to solve complex, high-impact business challenges.

  • You define the engineering standards and architecture patterns for agentic systems, ensuring teams build to a consistent, production-grade bar.

  • You demonstrate an exceptional ability to align multi-disciplinary technical teams with broader business objectives and evolving customer needs.

The Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the Hiring Manager (30 minutes)

  3. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

  4. System Design Interview (90 minutes)

  5. Commercial & Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

     

#LI-PRIO

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Lead Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
🚀 Why Midnite?

Midnite is a next-generation sports betting and gaming platform built for a new wave of players.

We combine sharp product thinking, bold brand, and fast execution to create experiences that feel modern, intuitive, and built for how people actually play today.

Over 400,000 players have already made the move, and we’re only just getting started.

We’re a high-performance team operating at pace. High ownership. Constant iteration. No hiding behind processes. We move quickly, test relentlessly, and turn ambitious ideas into real impact. If you’re driven, creative, and thrive in fast-moving environments where you can shape meaningful outcomes - keep reading.

Not your grandad’s bookie.

👀 The Role

Title: Lead Product Manager

Team: Product - Core

Location: United Kingdom, Remote

Core is the foundation that every Midnite customer and product depends on. As we grow, we're organising Core around two journeys: getting new players from sign-up to their first deposit, and keeping them once they're with us. This role leads the second.

You'll own Core Engagement: a player's life with Midnite after they've made their first deposit, and every point where friction could cost us a good customer. That includes some of the hardest moments in our product, such as affordability and enhanced due diligence checks, limits and suspensions, safer gambling interventions, and location and self-exclusion checks. It also includes the everyday Core experience players touch every week: their account, transactions, login and security, navigation, safer gambling tools and support. And it includes keeping fraud out without getting in the way of genuine players.

You will:

  • Own Core Engagement end to end, from strategy and discovery through to delivery and continuous improvement, measured on how many players we keep after key Core friction.

  • Build the data foundation for it: how many players hit a limit, check or restriction, when, and how many we lose afterwards. Then set targets, stay disciplined on a small number of key results, and move them through constant experiments and small, frequent improvements rather than waiting for big projects.

  • Lead our in-life regulated journeys, including affordability and EDD, limits and other safer gambling interventions, geolocation and self-exclusion checks, and fraud risk scoring, along with the partners behind them.

  • Own the everyday Core experience: account and settings, transactions UI, login and MFA, the app shell (top navigation and footer), safer gambling tools, notification opt-in and the help and support experience.

  • Work hand in hand with the teams either side of you: Onboarding and Activation, which owns everything up to a player's first deposit, and Nucleus, which owns the back-office compliance and safer gambling operations behind your journeys.

  • Build capabilities that are set per market rather than rebuilt for each one, across the UK, Ireland, Canada and future Midnite markets.

The next Midniter:

  • You're an experienced Product Manager with 6+ years' experience who has owned complex products end to end with measurable outcomes, ideally within a high-growth technology company.

  • You've moved a retention, engagement or lifecycle metric, and can show how you measured it and what you changed to move it.

  • You have hands-on experience with regulated customer journeys in any industry, such as affordability, AML and EDD, safer gambling, player limits, KYC or payments risk, and you know the regulatory outcome behind them, not just the requirement.

  • You're technically fluent. You can explain how your products worked under the hood, including the systems, the integrations and what happens when something fails, and you work directly with engineers without needing a translator.

  • You're at home in a lean team. You pull your own data, talk to customers yourself and run your own delivery, rather than relying on a layer of analysts, researchers or delivery managers.

  • You start from a number and prioritise ruthlessly. You can turn a vague goal like "improve retention" into a measurable outcome and a short list of bets, and separate the genuinely important problems from the noise.

  • You're comfortable challenging stakeholders, including Compliance, and can confidently explain the product reasoning behind a different approach.

  • You're an excellent communicator who can make complicated regulatory and technical subjects understandable to a wide range of audiences.

  • You've embraced AI, both as a tool for making yourself more effective and as a capability that can fundamentally change the products we build.

💰 Winnings

  • Private health insurance with zero excess, including optical cover and optional dental.

  • Income protection to protect your earnings and give you peace of mind.

  • Tenure holiday policy. After three years you receive an extra two days leave, increasing to 30 days annually after five years.

  • Flexible working and a fully supported home office setup so you can do your best work from home.

  • Nursery salary sacrifice scheme helping parents save thousands each year on nursery fees.

  • Salary sacrifice schemes for tech and holidays so you can spread the cost of the things you want.

  • Retail discounts and subscription perks across a wide range of brands.

  • Quarterly team socials to connect, celebrate and have fun together.

At Midnite, we’re committed to creating equal opportunities for everyone. We actively strive to build balanced teams that reflect the diversity of our communities, including ethnic minorities, people with disabilities, the LGBTQIA+ community, and all genders.

We aim to provide an inclusive and supportive interview experience for all candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments, please let us know in advance so we can ensure you feel comfortable and set up for success.

Working with multidisciplinary teams across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and more, you will manage the interdependencies between technical departments and use model-based systems engineering (MBSE) to keep system-level decisions connected. Your work will lay the technical foundation for successful vehicle integration and launch.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

  • Act as the Systems Technical Authority for the orbital rocket programme, providing vehicle-level systems leadership and maintaining technical coherence across the complete vehicle.

  • Lead the definition, ownership, and resolution of system interfaces across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and other technical departments.

  • Identify and manage interdependencies, assumptions, constraints, and cross-subsystem impacts as the vehicle design develops.

  • Use MBSE models and related system artefacts to maintain a connected view of vehicle architecture, requirements, and interfaces.

  • Lead cross-disciplinary systems discussions and reviews, bringing forward system-level trade-offs, resolving technical conflicts, and ensuring decisions are clearly recorded.

  • Coordinate technical departments around vehicle-level priorities and help keep subsystem work aligned with the needs of the overall programme.

  • Track system-level issues and interface actions through to resolution, helping establish the conditions for successful vehicle integration and launch.

What we’re looking for

  • Strong understanding of model-based systems engineering and its application to complex, multidisciplinary engineering programmes.

  • Strong understanding of rocketry and how vehicle subsystems interact across the complete system.

  • Experience leading systems engineering work, system interfaces, or cross-disciplinary technical efforts on complex engineering projects.

  • A proven track record of successfully completing engineering projects.

  • The ability to maintain a vehicle-level perspective while engaging with technical teams across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and other disciplines.

title: Marketing Intern
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

Most people have no idea what benefits they actually have. And most of the teams running those benefits spend their week managing them in spreadsheets. Both of those are problems AI can help solve.

Ben is the agentic benefits platform for global enterprise. One system across every market, with AI doing the checking and the chasing so the people can do the deciding. We're seven years in, we built it from scratch, and there's a lot left to solve.

Your Mission

As Ben's Marketing Intern, you'll turn marketing strategy into the things people actually see. The direction is set — the positioning, the argument, who we're talking to. Your job is to make the work that carries it: the posts, the pages, the campaign assets, the video clips.

You'll sit with the marketing team for twelve months and learn from how great marketing actually gets made. You’ll get to experience the whole process: from the argument to the thing that ships: the report, the posts, the pages, the ad variants, the clips, the event stand. At a bigger company you'd get one of those. Here you get all of it, and quick, direct feedback from experts who care how it's done.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Content production and reuse: taking a report, a podcast episode or an article and building the posts, emails, pages and sales assets that carry it

  • Social: owning the company page calendar, and making it easier for our execs and the wider team to post

  • Website and SEO housekeeping: on-page fixes, metadata, internal linking, blog uploads, and the audit items that never reach the top of anyone's list

  • Event and campaign creative build: turning a concept into the invites, stand copy, follow-ups and post-event content.

  • Video and podcast support: clips, captions, show notes, distribution

  • Paid and campaign build alongside our demand gen lead: social ad variants and audiences, HubSpot landing pages, forms, emails and lists, and tracking.

You'll Love This Role If You...

  • Have built something of your own. A social account with a following, a YouTube series, a newsletter, a side project. Growing an audience from nothing teaches you how content moves people, and that's most of what we do

  • Can take a brief and improve it. Not follow it to the letter, not rewrite it from scratch. Interpret, then make something

  • Are comfortable with new tools, including AI. You'd rather work out how something functions than wait to be shown

  • Care who's reading. You want to know who's on the other end of the thing you're making. Everything else is teachable

No marketing degree and no marketing experience required. What you've made matters more than where you learned to make it.

Why Join Us?

Most internships hand you a spreadsheet and a coffee order. This one hands you the LinkedIn account.

You'll be one of a small marketing team, reporting to our Content Lead, working on the launches and campaigns that the rest of the year hangs off. You'll get the whole experience, from strategy to content shipped, because you'll be the one shipping it. You'll get direct feedback, quickly, from people who care about the craft.

It's a twelve-month fixed term. If it goes the way we think it will, we'll want to talk about what comes next.

Our Compensation & Benefits

It's important to us to practise what we preach when it comes to our benefits. We know what good looks like and we want to provide the best for our team, with a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package. This means you have a choice over the things that are most important to you.

  • ❤️ Comprehensive Private Medical Insurance

  • 🧠 Comprehensive and tailored mental health support and professional coaching through a leading provider

Diversity and Culture at Ben

We are organically growing a brilliantly diverse, inclusive and respectful bunch of people we are extremely proud of. This should go without saying but all applications are very much welcome. title: Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wir bauen humanoide Systeme: Full Stack, von Hardware und Elektronik über Software bis zur Fertigung, alles in-house in Berlin.

Bei Cell Labs verschieben wir die Grenze dessen, was Robotik leisten kann. Unser Ziel ist klar: Systeme bauen, die Menschen stärken statt sie zu ersetzen. Unsere Technologie ist bereits bei führenden Industriekunden und Partnern im Einsatz. Jetzt steht unser eigenes Produkt kurz vor dem Launch.

Die leise Phase ist vorbei. Wir suchen Menschen, die früh dabei sein wollen, Verantwortung übernehmen und das bauen, worüber andere nur reden.

Ort: Berlin · Start: Ab sofort · Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort · Anstellung: Vollzeit

Deine Aufgaben

  • Marketingstrategie & Umsetzung: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Gründer:in und dem restlichen Kreativteam die Markenstrategie von Cell Labs weiter und gestaltest u. a. den bevorstehenden Produktlaunch aktiv mit, von Messaging über Kampagnen bis zu Events.

  • Digital Marketing & Performance: Du entwickelst unsere digitale Sichtbarkeit weiter, optimierst Website, SEO und SEA und setzt zielgerichtete Kampagnen auf. Dabei testest du neue Ansätze und verbesserst kontinuierlich ihre Wirkung.

  • Content & Kommunikation: Du übersetzt komplexe Robotik-Technologien in verständliche und überzeugende Inhalte für unsere Website, Social Media, Newsletter und weitere Kanäle. Dafür arbeitest du eng mit unseren Gründern, dem Brand- und Designteam sowie den Engineers zusammen.

  • Go-to-Market: Du planst und steuerst Marketingkampagnen entlang des gesamten Funnels, entwickelst Maßnahmen zur B2B-Leadgenerierung und machst Cell Labs bei relevanten Industrieunternehmen und Partnern sichtbar.

  • Events & Kooperationen: Du planst und begleitest relevante Messen, Konferenzen und Partneraktivitäten – von der Vorbereitung der Marketingmaterialien über die Kommunikation bis zur Nachbereitung.

  • Marketing Operations & Analytics: Du definierst, misst und berichtest die Kennzahlen, die zählen: Pipeline-Beitrag, Conversion, Cost per Lead und Funnel-Entwicklung. Daraus leitest du Entscheidungen ab, statt nur Reports zu verwalten.

  • Sales Enablement: In enger Abstimmung mit unseren Gründern unterstützt du Vertrieb und Business Development mit Pitch-Materialien, Use Cases, Case Studies und Produktkommunikation für konkrete Verkaufssituationen.

Was du mitbringst

  • Erfahrung: Du hast mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung im Marketing, idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld eines Startups, Scale-ups oder Technologieunternehmens. Du hast Kampagnen eigenständig umgesetzt und idealerweise bereits einen Produktlaunch begleitet.

  • Breites Marketing-Know-how: Du kennst dich mit digitalen Marketingkanälen aus und hast praktische Erfahrung mit SEO, SEA, Content Marketing und Kampagnenmanagement. Du musst nicht alles perfekt beherrschen, weißt aber, wie du die richtigen Maßnahmen priorisierst und umsetzt.

  • Zahlenverständnis: Du setzt dir messbare Ziele und weißt, wie du sie nachhältst. Google Analytics, CRM-Software und Performance-Kennzahlen gehören zu deinem Arbeitsalltag. Du nutzt Daten, um Marketingmaßnahmen kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

  • Interesse für Technologie: Du interessierst dich für komplexe Technologien und hast Lust, tief in die Robotik einzutauchen. Du kannst technische Zusammenhänge verstehen und so vermitteln, dass sie auch für Menschen außerhalb der Entwicklung greifbar werden.

  • Kommunikation & Content: Aus einem technischen Gespräch mit einem Engineer machst du eine Case Study, Website-Copy oder einen Social-Media-Beitrag, der die richtige Zielgruppe erreicht.

  • Arbeitsweise: Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, arbeitest eigenständig und pragmatisch und hast Freude daran, neue Strukturen mit aufzubauen. Du wechselst zwischen Planung und Umsetzung, ohne eines von beidem aus dem Blick zu verlieren.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher.

Benefits

  • Marketing von Grund auf: Es gibt kein fertiges Playbook und keine Altlasten. Du gestaltest gemeinsam mit unserem Marketingteam, wie Cell Labs am Markt sichtbar wird, und siehst die Wirkung deiner Arbeit direkt.

  • Alles unter einem Dach: Büro, Werkstatt und Teststände liegen im selben Gebäude in Kreuzberg. Wenn du eine Story für eine Case Study brauchst oder den Roboter in Aktion sehen willst, ist der Engineer ein paar Schritte entfernt, kein Ticket.

  • Room to Fail & Grow: Bezahlte Lernzeit mit persönlichem Budget für Kurse, Marketing-Konferenzen und die Tools, die du brauchst. Du bekommst Raum, Neues auszuprobieren, und bringst ein Produkt an den Markt, das bisher kaum jemand gesehen hat.

  • Benefits: Ein Leistungspaket, das du dir selbst zusammenstellst und das Mobilität, Gesundheit, Ernährung oder Fitness abdeckt. Dazu gibt’s einen zusätzlichen bezahlten freien Tag im Jahr für ehrenamtliches Engagement oder ein Projekt, das dir am Herzen liegt.

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Zeilen zu einer Marketingkampagne oder einem Projekt, das du eigenständig umgesetzt hast. Was war das Ziel, was hast du getan und was kam dabei heraus? Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Der Prozess: Intro Call, Deep Dive in deine bisherige Arbeit, Besuch bei uns mit einer kleinen Case Study, Angebot.

Wir bauen Roboter für alle, deshalb wollen wir ein Team, das das abbildet. Wir stellen nach Fähigkeiten ein und freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die in Marketing und Tech unterrepräsentiert sind. Wenn du nicht jeden Punkt erfüllst, aber denkst, das ist dein Job: bewirb dich.

descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

 

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Consumer SEO & AEO team helps people discover Kraken through search engines and AI answers, understand our products and become customers. We connect content, technical SEO, international growth and automation to measurable acquisition, working with Product, Web, Engineering, Data and Compliance.

You will report to the Head of SEO & AEO and work closely with our SEO & AEO Content Lead. Together, they set priorities and provide strategy, briefs and guidance; you help turn those plans into shipped improvements across the website. Your focus is hands-on SEO/AEO delivery and always-on work, giving both leaders more capacity for GTM, strategy and content direction.

 

The opportunity

  • Own the delivery of SEO and AEO improvements across the website, helping turn the team’s strategy into live changes quickly and accurately.

  • Work hands-on in the CMS and other tools to update metadata, internal links, page content, technical SEO and localised pages.

  • Check changes in the CMS and on the live site, including links, metadata, formatting and mobile presentation, and follow through on anything that is missing or incorrect.

  • Work cross-functionally with Legal, Compliance, Web, Engineering and Localisation to unblock work, manage feedback and get changes over the line.

  • Use approved AI tools and agents to speed up delivery, while checking outputs, flagging bugs and suggesting improvements to tools and workflows.

  • Compare agreed plans with what is live on the site, spot gaps and opportunities, and keep prioritised work moving when the wider team is busy.

  • Create and refresh evergreen educational content from SEO and Content briefs, making sure it is useful, search-optimised, accurate and in Kraken’s voice.

  • Keep Jira and the publishing queue up to date, with clear visibility on what has shipped, what is blocked, what needs a decision and what happens next.

   

What you bring

  • 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, including implementing website improvements through a CMS, with examples of changes you personally shipped, checked and followed through to completion.

  • You understand search intent, metadata, internal linking, on-page optimisation and the basics of crawling, indexing, canonical URLs and structured data. You can implement agreed changes and recognise when specialist support is needed.

  • You can update, build and check pages yourself, and learn unfamiliar publishing and website editing tools with guidance.

  • High attention to detail. You check instructions against the CMS and live website, catch inconsistencies and take responsibility for getting the details right.

  • You use AI tools to accelerate research, implementation and content work, verify their outputs and give useful feedback when something does not work.

  • An understanding of AEO. You understand how AI search systems find and cite information, why accuracy matters and how to check whether changes improve Kraken’s visibility.

  • Strong writing, editing and fact-checking skills. You can turn a brief or AI-generated draft into useful, search-optimised content that follows brand guidance. You verify product claims and incorporate detailed review feedback accurately.

  • Clear communication and delivery reporting. You keep tasks current, coordinate with reviewers and technical teams, and explain what has shipped, what is blocked and what needs to happen next. You can use performance data to help assess completed work.

   

Nice to haves

  • Experience with Sanity, our content management system, or comparable CMS platforms.

  • Familiarity with Surfer SEO for content optimisation, Ahrefs for SEO research, Google Search Console for search performance, or equivalent tools.

  • Experience with Profound or another platform for tracking visibility and citations in AI-generated answers.

  • Experience in crypto, fintech or regulated financial services, including working through Compliance approvals. Familiarity with Adclear, a marketing compliance review tool, is useful.

  • Experience implementing localised content and metadata across multiple markets, using AI-assisted workflows alongside language and Compliance reviewers.

title: Mechanical Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

You design the mechanics of our robotic hands — from the kinematics of a single finger to a complete hand ready for series production.

Multiple drives, gear trains, tendons, tactile sensors and electronics have to fit into a human-sized envelope while surviving hundreds of thousands of cycles. Every millimetre matters, and almost every design decision affects another discipline.

You work hands-on between CAD, test rig and workshop, and report to the CTO.

What you will do:

  • CAD design. Design components, mechanisms and assemblies within tightly constrained envelopes, owning the design from concept through production release.

  • Mechanism & kinematics. Design finger and thumb kinematics, tendon and spindle drives, joints and bearings. Calculate motion envelopes, trajectories, gripping forces and transmission ratios.

  • Calculation & validation. Validate designs through structural and fatigue calculations, FEA, tolerance stack-ups and GD&T before parts are manufactured.

  • Material selection. Select and qualify materials for lightweight structures, wear surfaces, tendons and elastomeric gripping surfaces, and characterise their behaviour under real loads and contact conditions.

  • Assembly design. Design assemblies for efficient assembly, adjustment-free interfaces, serviceability and repair. Specify the required fixtures and tooling.

  • Design for manufacturing. Design for the intended manufacturing process from the outset — machining, injection moulding, sheet metal, additive manufacturing — balancing cost, tolerances and production volumes.

  • Prototyping & testing. Build prototypes, design test rigs and endurance setups, run cycle and load tests, and drive failures to root cause.

  • Documentation & release. Create drawings and BOMs, manage design changes and configuration, and support product development reviews.

  • Suppliers & production. Work with machine shops, material suppliers and manufacturing partners from first prototype through pilot series and production ramp-up.

  • Cross-functional integration. Work closely with Electronics, Sensors and Software to align packaging, interfaces and load paths across the complete system.

What you bring:

  • Degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, precision engineering, or a comparable qualification.

  • 5–10 years of experience in mechanical design of precision mechatronic products, including at least one product taken through to series production.

  • Advanced 3D CAD skills in CATIA, NX, SolidWorks, Creo or comparable systems, with confident 2D drawing creation and GD&T.

  • Strong understanding of mechanism design: linkages, gear trains, bearings, shafts, power transmission, backlash and stiffness.

  • Experience with FEA, structural and fatigue analysis, and tolerance calculations as part of everyday design work.

  • Strong knowledge of material selection for lightweight, high-load and wear-critical components.

  • Practical DFM/DFA experience across multiple manufacturing processes.

  • Hands-on mentality — you build the prototype, run the test and analyse the broken part yourself.

  • Fluent in English and German.

Bonus:

  • Experience with robotic hands, grippers, prosthetics or similarly highly integrated mechanisms.

  • Experience with compact drive trains, including planetary, harmonic or cycloidal gearing, spindle drives and actuator integration.

  • Experience with elastomers, soft goods, injection moulding of complex geometries or compliant structures.

  • Experience integrating tactile or force sensors into mechanical structures.

  • Experience with multi-body simulation or topology optimisation.

  • Knowledge of Machinery Regulation, ISO/TS 15066 and mechanical design for collaborative applications.

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that works reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Neuroscientist
descriptionHtml:
Type: Full-time
Location: University of Sussex, Brighton - On-site

The Role

Netholabs is building AI grounded in biological intelligence. We record petascale, high-resolution neurobehavioural data from living systems and use it to train neural foundation models — a new substrate for the next generation of AI, robotics, and personalised intelligence. We aim to greatly reduce the burden of animals used in basic scientific research and pharmacological work, with eventual removal and replacement by in silico models.

We're looking for a Neuroscientist to join our Brighton research team as an independent contributor driving experiments from design through analysis. You'll design and run in vivo electrophysiology and behavioural experiments, work with large-scale neural and behavioural datasets, and partner closely with our ML team to translate what we learn about real brains and bodies into better foundation models. This is a role for someone who wants their science to feed directly into what gets built next.

Responsibilities

In Vivo Electrophysiology & Neural Recording

  • Design and run in vivo electrophysiology experiments in animal models

  • Develop and refine neural recording protocols and rigs alongside the hardware team

  • Ensure recordings meet the quality and fidelity standards our models are trained on

Behavioural Neuroscience & Experimental Design

  • Design behavioural paradigms that generate rich, well-controlled datasets

  • Plan and oversee data collection sessions, in collaboration with technicians

  • Iterate on experimental design based on data quality and downstream modelling needs

Data Analysis & Computational Modelling

  • Analyse large-scale neural and behavioural datasets

  • Build and apply computational models to characterise neural and behavioural dynamics

  • Validate findings and communicate results clearly to the broader research team

Neuroscience → AI Translation

  • Partner with the ML team to translate biological findings into model design choices

  • Help define what neurobehavioural data and features are most valuable to capture

  • Contribute to internal research direction connecting neuroscience and foundation model development

Requirements

Core (essential)

  • BSc/MSc in neuroscience, behavioural sciences, or a related field, with hands-on experimental research experience.

  • Preferred: PhD and experience with in vivo electrophysiology and behavioural neuroscience experiments

  • Strong data analysis skills, including experience with Python or a similar language

  • Able to design rigorous experiments and think critically about data quality

  • Excellent communication; comfortable working cross-functionally with engineering and ML teams

The Leeds office is home to most of iwoca's collections, customer success and account management teams, plus smaller groups from across the business. It's the busiest midweek, when most teams come in together.

title: Onboard Software Engineer - Peripheral Services
descriptionHtml:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the Hub’s onboard computers, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit.

The Peripheral Services team owns the software that integrates third-party devices and payloads into Loft’s standardized satellite platform. We enable the control and monitoring of many key spacecraft components, including optical payloads, radios, power controllers, and GNSS receivers. Many of these components are reused across all satellite programs and form the building blocks of our onboard architecture.

The applications developed by our team handle the low-level communication protocol details, exposing the connected devices behind standardized APIs used across mission operations. The team is also responsible for the automation and orchestration that allows Loft to safely and reliably operate the equipment at scale.

In this role, you’ll help develop the software that connects diverse spacecraft hardware to the rest of the platform, and ultimately enables successful missions in orbit.


About this role:
  • Design, implement, and refine software with a high degree of ownership, driving impactful features from concept through delivery while ensuring robustness and reliability.
  • Review code, provide clear feedback, and enforce adherence to established development processes, style guides, and design standards to maintain consistency and quality across the codebase.
  • Design and implement unit and integration tests for both self-authored and peer-authored code.
  • Utilize version control systems to create feature branches, push code, and merge approved code into production branches.
  • Contribute to the onboard software architecture through design proposals and collaborative review
  • Participate in the review and enhancement of software development processes and design standards.
  • Coordinate with downstream teams on the distribution and adoption of the latest releases.
  • In addition to responsibilities within onboard software, you’ll have the opportunity to directly be involved in operating our on-orbit fleet of satellites.

Must Haves:
  • 3+ years' software engineering experience, using programming languages including C/C++ (C++11 or newer) and Python.
  • Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows
  • Experience with continuous integration tools (GitLab-CI, Jenkins, or similar).
  • Knowledge of build systems (e.g., Make, CMake).
  • Understanding of distributed architecture.
  • Familiarity with networking protocols (e.g., UDP, TCP, IP) and POSIX standards.
  • Experience in developing multi-threaded applications.
  • Previous team leader or manager role

Nice to Haves:
  • Familiarity with additional programming languages, such as Go or Rust.
  • Experience with embedded Linux operation, including Yocto, device trees, systemd, and Linux on ARM platforms.
  • Proficiency with unit test frameworks (e.g., pytest, Googletest, Unity)
  • Experience with middleware framework (gRPC, ZMQ/NATS, etc.)
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, K3S, systemd-nspawn)
  • Experience with space systems and concepts

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    • *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.
    Who We Are
    Loft: Space Made Simple.
    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.
    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.
    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

Das Team

Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, eingespielten Onboarding-Teams mit vier Personen. Als Teil des Business Operations Departments arbeitest du in einem Bereich mit insgesamt rund 20 Kolleginnen und Kollegen, zu dem auch das Customer Success Team gehört. Im Alltag verbindet uns eine enge, cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit, mit der wir gemeinsam die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden erzielen. Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, denken mit und packen gemeinsam an. Gleichzeitig pflegen wir eine Teamkultur, die über den Arbeitsalltag hinausgeht – und eine Company Culture, auf die wir wirklich stolz sind.

Als Operations Intern (m/w/d) spielst du eine Schlüsselrolle im Aufbau von Prozessen und Strukturen eines aufstrebenden und schnell wachsenden Technologie-Startups. Wir stellen fortlaufend für eine Praktikumsdauer von 3–6 Monaten ein.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ownership für operative Prozesse: Du führst entscheidende operative Aufgaben in Eigenverantwortung durch und trägst dazu bei, dass unsere Organisation in allen Kernbereichen reibungslos läuft.

  • Automatisierung von Prozessen: Du entwickelst Ansätze zur Effizienzsteigerung und Automatisierung von Prozessschritten.

  • Begleitung beim Onboarding: Du unterstützt bei der Einführung unserer Neukund:innen in das trawa-Universum und sorgst für eine exzellente Kundenerfahrung.

  • Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung der Organisation: Du gestaltest Prozesse aktiv mit und hilfst uns dabei, als Unternehmen weiter wachsen zu können.

  • Daten im Blick behalten: Du übernimmst die Datenpflege in unseren Systemen (z. B. CRM) und stellst durch sorgfältige Arbeit eine hohe Datenqualität sicher.

Nach wem wir suchen

  • Du bist Student:in, im Bachelor-Studium, Gap Year, Master-Studium oder Absolvent:in mit guten akademischen Leistungen.

  • Erste praktische Erfahrungen in Startups, anderen schnelllebigen Umfeldern oder der Energiewirtschaft sind ein starkes Plus.

Deine ersten 90 Tage:

  • Lerne unsere Prozesse kennen – vom internen Handover der Neukunden von Sales, über die Anmeldung von Lieferstellen bis hin zur Marktkommunikation im komplexen Energiemarkt.

title: Organic Discovery, Growth Engineer
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR:
How people discover Lovable is being rebuilt in real time. They now find software through Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Claude and others, and nobody has the full playbook yet. We're looking for an SEO and AEO specialist who wants to write it for Lovable and turn that visibility into subscribers and revenue. You're technical enough to land your own code and agentic enough to build the tools you need with AI. One sprint you're fixing how lovable.dev gets crawled and rendered; the next you're shipping pages for our highest-intent searches, or an agent that tracks where Lovable shows up in AI answers. Your first instinct is always: will people and answer engines find this, and does it help us grow?

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

The role

You'll own organic discoverability for Lovable. Answer engines come first, on top of a strong foundation in traditional search. You do the strategy, building and measurement, there's no queue between an insight and a live change.

You'll build most of your tools, pages and agents on Lovable itself, and take what you learn straight to the product team. Millions of apps are published on Lovable and each one needs to be found too, so what works for lovable.dev should become better defaults and guides for our users.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years in SEO, AEO or organic growth on a user-facing web product at scale. Results you've driven count for more than years.

  • Hands-on AEO. You've tracked how AI assistants mention and cite a brand, tested what moves it, and can show the results.

  • Deep technical SEO. Rendering, crawling, indexing, structured data, sitemaps, canonicals and internal linking at scale. When something breaks, you find out why.

  • Agentic by default. You use AI coding tools and LLM APIs to build agents, scripts and internal tools that automate audits, monitoring and reporting, without waiting on engineering.

  • You land code. You know enough web fundamentals (HTML, JavaScript, React, APIs) to work in our codebase, get changes through review into production, and own them after launch. You don't need to be a senior software engineer.

  • Strong with data. SQL, Search Console, log files, event tracking, and tests that tell you something real.

  • Good content and product judgment. You know what makes a page worth citing and cut what isn't working.

  • Motivated by the scoreboard: traffic, citations, subscribers, revenue.

What you’ll do

In one sentence: you'll own how Lovable gets found across search engines and AI assistants, and build the site, systems and tools that turn that into growth.

  • Set the organic roadmap. Decide where Lovable needs to show up across Google, AI Overviews and AI assistants, which topics and queries matter most, and what we leave alone.

  • Own the technical health of lovable.dev. Rendering, crawling, indexing, site structure, internal links, structured data and speed are yours. Keep search traffic safe through relaunches and redesigns.

  • Ship pages that win high-intent search. Use search demand, prompt data and competitor gaps to pick what to build and refresh, then ship hub pages, templates, comparisons and other page systems. Work with content and product marketing on what goes on them.

  • Get Lovable cited beyond our own site. Find the forums, communities, publications and docs that AI answers lean on for our category, and work with community, PR and partnerships to earn a place there.

  • Make experimentation cheap and fast. Build the setup that lets the team test page formats, technical changes and distribution ideas in days, keep a record of each test, and double down on what works.

  • Build the tools search runs on. Replace manual audits, monitoring and reporting with automations and agents, ideally built on Lovable, with a person checking the work where accuracy matters.

  • Own how we measure organic. Tie rankings, AI citations and organic traffic to subscribers and revenue in the warehouse, so we can invest in organic with the same confidence as paid. Say plainly where the data has gaps.

  • Help Lovable apps get found. Work with product engineering on SEO and AEO defaults (metadata, social previews, sitemaps, rendering) for the apps our users publish, and share what works as guides.

  • Share what you learn. Bring findings back to product, and share our results with users and the wider community.

  • Keep it Lovable. Search should make the site better for people, never worse.

Our tech stack

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:

  • Frontend: React

  • Backend: Golang and Rust

  • Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers

  • DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform)

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach.

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Patient Support Coordinator
descriptionHtml:
At Montu, our Patient Support team plays an important role in the patient journey, helping people access their prescribed medication and ensuring they feel listened to, informed and supported throughout their treatment.

We are looking for a friendly, proactive and compassionate Patient Support Coordinator to join our Pharmacy Support team at Winnersh Triangle.

This is an opportunity to make a genuine difference to patients, many of whom are living with complex and often debilitating health conditions.

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping people, has the confidence to manage challenging conversations and takes pride in delivering excellent customer service.

For someone who thrives in a busy, people-focused environment and wants to be part of a growing healthcare organisation where the work really matters, this could be a fantastic opportunity.

What is the job?

As a Patient Support Coordinator, the role focuses on supporting patients with prescription queries, medication availability, deliveries and any challenges that may arise throughout their treatment journey.

This is a predominantly telephone-based position, with live chat and email enquiries also forming part of the day-to-day responsibilities.

Working closely with our Pharmacy, Clinical and wider Patient Support teams, the priority is to resolve enquiries efficiently, provide accurate information and ensure patients receive the support they need.

Some conversations are straight forward, while others require patience, empathy and the confidence to support patients who may be frustrated, worried or experiencing difficulties accessing their medication.

It is a fast-paced environment where no two days are quite the same. Strong communication, attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving are essential, alongside the ability to balance a busy workload without losing sight of the person behind each inquiry.

Ultimately, this role is about much more than answering calls. It is about taking ownership, building trust and helping patients feel supported throughout their treatment.

What will you be doing?

  • Acting as a friendly and professional first point of contact for patients, primarily over the telephone, alongside live chat and email enquiries.

  • Supporting patients with questions relating to prescriptions, medication availability, deliveries and potential delays.

  • Taking ownership of patient enquiries, finding solutions and keeping patients informed throughout the process.

  • Working closely with Pharmacy Dispensers and the wider Pharmacy team to resolve prescription, stock and dispensing queries.

  • Liaising with Clinical teams and healthcare professionals to ensure patient enquiries are directed appropriately.

  • Providing clear information about prescription processes and escalating clinical questions to qualified healthcare professionals.

  • Recognising when patients require additional support and escalating complex or sensitive concerns to the appropriate teams, including Clinical Governance.

  • Maintaining accurate patient records in line with internal procedures and regulatory requirements.

  • Managing a busy workload while maintaining a high standard of service and attention to detail.

  • Working collaboratively with colleagues across the business to ensure enquiries are handled efficiently.

  • Contributing ideas and feedback to help improve processes and the overall patient experience.

What you will need?

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys working with people and understands the importance of delivering excellent customer service, particularly when supporting individuals who may be dealing with difficult or sensitive situations.

Strong communication skills are essential, alongside the ability to listen, show empathy and remain calm when conversations become challenging.

This role would suit someone who is naturally proactive, enjoys problem-solving and takes pride in seeing an enquiry through to resolution.

  • A minimum of two years of experience in a customer service or patient-facing environment.

  • Experience managing a high volume of telephone enquiries, including challenging or sensitive conversations.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a compassionate and professional approach.

  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise competing demands in a fast-paced environment.

  • Confidence using multiple IT systems and learning new processes quickly.

  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when handling patient information and maintaining accurate records.

  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach and the confidence to take ownership of enquiries.

  • An understanding of the importance of following policies, procedures and standard operating procedures (SOPs), particularly within a regulated environment.

  • A positive, collaborative approach to teamwork and a willingness to support colleagues across different departments.

  • Confidence working towards service standards and performance targets without compromising the patient experience.

  • The ability to work five days per week from our Winnersh Triangle office, including one Saturday per month.

Desirable experience

  • Previous experience within healthcare, pharmacy or another regulated environment.

  • Experience supporting patients or customers with complex, sensitive or time-critical enquiries.

  • A background in a busy contact centre or high-volume customer service environment.

  • Previous healthcare or pharmacy experience would be beneficial, but it is not essential. What matters most is a positive attitude, strong communication skills and a genuine desire to help people.

Location and working hours

  • This is a full-time, office-based position at our Winnersh Triangle office in Berkshire.

  • Working hours: 8:30am to 5:30pm, including a one-hour unpaid lunch break.

  • Working pattern: Five days per week, on a rota that includes one Saturday per month.

  • Location: Fully office-based at Winnersh Triangle, including during and following training.

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three + 8 bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Private Healthcare Scheme

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

title: People Operations Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the role

We’re growing fast! We’re a team of around 200 in 4 locations, and we’re looking for someone to help keep our people processes running smoothly as we scale.

You’ll be the go-to person for employee questions and the engine behind our day-to-day People ops, from onboarding and contracts to HRIS data and compliance. You won’t just be running processes, you’ll be building them too, so there’s real ownership and lots of room to make things better. It’s a broad, hands-on role, and it’s perfect for you if you’re organised, curious, and love making things work seamlessly behind the scenes.

What you’ll be doing

  • Admin: Looking after onboarding, offboarding, contracts and changes, probation, and leave and absence across all countries

  • Compliance: Overseeing background screening, and keeping our policies up to date as employment laws change

  • HRIS and data: Keeping HiBob accurate and tidy, and building workflows that cut down on manual admin

  • Payroll: Coordinating compensation and payroll-related administration with the Finance team, including employee query resolution

  • Benefits: Managing enrolment, changes, and employee queries across benefits programmes

  • Employee support: Being the first point of contact for questions on policies, processes, benefits and systems, and knowing when to sort things yourself and when to escalate

  • Employee relations: Supporting employee relations cases from start to finish, including intake, notes and case tracking, with support from the wider People team and Legal

  • Self-serve and AI: Helping us build our People knowledge base in Confluence from the ground up so everyone can find answers fast, and exploring smart ways to use AI and automation to take the busywork out of People ops

  • Projects: Getting stuck into People initiatives as we grow, from performance and engagement cycles in Culture Amp to policy rollouts and process improvements

What you’ll need

  • 2–4 years in People Ops, HR Ops or an HR Generalist role, ideally in fintech or somewhere fast-growing

  • Good working knowledge of UK employment law

  • Hands-on experience across the full employee lifecycle

  • Exposure to employee relations, such as supporting cases, taking notes or tracking issues through to resolution

  • Experience with a multi-country team, or the ability to pick up local nuances quickly and work across time zones

  • Experience using an HRIS (bonus points for HiBob), and you’re comfortable with Excel

  • A real eye for detail and the organisation to juggle lots of requests without dropping the ball

  • Discretion and good judgement with confidential info and sensitive situations

  • Clear, friendly communication with everyone from new joiners to senior leaders

  • A helpful, reliable approach, and a habit of always looking for a better way to do things

  • Comfort with pace and a bit of ambiguity, because lots of our processes are still being built

What we offer

  • Everyone owns a piece of the company - equity

  • Hybrid with 3 days a week in the office

  • 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • One month paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Employee loan

  • Free gym membership

  • Team wellness budget to be active together - set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering
