title: Platform Site Reliability Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software .

As we scale our platform and expand our engineering organisation, we are looking for leaders who can build strong teams, uphold high standards, and deliver reliably at pace.

Role Responsibilities

  • Deploy and Manage Kubernetes Clusters, deployed at scale to support AI centric workloads, across both our bare metal clusters and via trusted partner infrastructure

  • Develop Kubernetes Manifests and Operators: Facilitate application deployments and maintain Kubernetes-native services for networking, storage, security, identity and infrastructure management

  • Optimize Linux system configuration including kernel, driver, filesystem and services to support workloads running via our orchestration layer

  • Build and maintain automation scripts and infrastructure as code to support platform lifecycle, as well as simplifying troubleshooting for Incident resolution and provision of tooling for our support organisation

  • Apply ITSM frameworks: Incident, Major Incident, Change Management, and service improvement.

  • Maintain and enhance Radiant’s observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, and custom monitoring integrations

  • Operate and support services in 24x7 production environments, including on-call rotation

  • Contribute to Incident postmortem analyses, root cause analysis, document learnings, and automate remediations

  • Mentor junior engineers and act as an Operational requirements consultant to other departments

  • Communicate technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders and customers

  • Uphold a culture of: do, document, automate

  • Willingness to cross train with Platform Engineering/Platform SRE to fully support both our infrastructure and platform stacks.

  • Willingness to cross train with HPC Engineering, supported by NVIDIA to enhance our HPC supportability offering

Requirements

  • 5+ Years Proven experience in globally scaled, performance-intensive environments operating to a 24/7 support model in an SRE or equivalent role

  • 3+ years experience in both running, deploying and optimising orchestration platforms with a strong emphasis on Kubernetes

  • Expert-level Linux administration, especially Ubuntu distributions

  • Proficiency in system tuning, disk I/O optimization, and hardware-level performance tweaks

  • Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching

  • Strong experience with API interrogation

  • Strong experience with infrastructure scripting and automation (Bash, Python, Ansible)

  • Deep understanding of observability principles and tools (Prometheus, Grafana preferred)

  • Strong grasp of ITSM and service operation best practices

  • Excellent communication and mentorship skills

  • Comfortable interfacing with internal stakeholders and external customers

  • Bonus: Knowledge of running AI workloads via orchestration platforms

Bonus Requirements

  • Bachelor or Masters Level degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field, or equivalent experience.

  • LPIC Certifications

  • ITIL Foundation level qualification or equivalent experience

  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)

Qualities we look for:

  • You approach problems with a systems mindset - balancing practical execution with long-term scalability

  • You elevate the team, setting high standards for technical quality and engineering excellence.

  • You hold yourself and others accountable - giving direct feedback and expecting the same

  • You take initiative, owning challenges end-to-end and proactively driving solutions.

  • You invest in others, mentoring to build both capability and confidence.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging

We are an equal opportunity employer and we strive to reduce unconscious bias throughout our hiring process. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity status or disability status. To ensure our recruitment processes provide an equal opportunity for all applicants to succeed, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments that we can make.

title: PR & Communicatie Stage
descriptionHtml:
Amsterdam - Voor het B2B Marketing team van DPG Media zijn we op zoek naar een enthousiaste stagiair(e) vanaf februari 2027, voor een periode van minimaal 5 maanden. We zijn op zoek naar diegene met een vlotte pen, feeling voor PR, (interne)communicatie, marketing en media.

Wat ga je doen?
Wil jij leren hoe je collega’s betrekt door middel van interne communicatie? Hoe je de zichtbaarheid van DPG Media vergroot in de B2B-markt? En hoe je content effectief inzet via verschillende kanalen? Tijdens deze veelzijdige stage houd je je bezig met:

● Partnerships op het gebied van content en events.

● Het schrijven en publiceren van artikelen voor ons kennis- en inspiratieplatform.

Wie zijn wij?
Het team is verantwoordelijk voor de positionering van DPG Media in de B2B markt en houdt zich bezig met business to
business ontwikkelingen binnen de mediawereld. We ontwikkelen verschillende merkverhalen, signaleren en produceren
nieuwe cases, onderhouden (content) partnerships, zijn verantwoordelijk voor de interne en externe (B2B) communicatie en
organiseren verschillende events. Ons team werkt nauw samen met sales, het onderzoeksteam en het digital marketing team.

Wat krijg je van ons?
● Een leuke omgeving, goede begeleiding, borrels en de gezelligste collega’s.

Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat?

Stagelopen bij DPG Media betekent niet alleen dat je de door jou geleerde theorie in de praktijk brengt door een bijdrage te leveren aan onze ambitieuze teams, ook ga je bij ons écht wat leren. DPG Media heeft met haar sterke merken een stevige marktpositie in alle onderdelen van de mediabranche. title: Principal Data Engineer, Data Warehouse (TPL)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified – giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.  Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.

In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.

Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship.

About the Role 

As Principal Data Engineer, you will own the intraday and end-of-day data serving layer between the CTRM platform and its downstream consumers. You will shape the architecture, standards and engineering practices that enable teams across the business to access trusted, timely and well-defined data. This is a hands-on technical leadership role with the opportunity to influence how the business builds and uses its data platform. 

This will be a full-time role, based in our London office, owning the following responsibilities: 

  • Own the intraday and EOD data serving layer between the CTRM platform and its consumers, including Market Risk, Credit Risk, Treasury, Finance, Reporting and desk tools. 
  • Design and maintain robust data schemas and serving contracts, including SQL, APIs and Kafka-based distribution. 
  • Define data versioning and reproducibility patterns, including as-of timestamps and run IDs, snapshots and incremental updates, with appropriate treatment of position and P&L data. 
  • Own the CTRM-to-warehouse data pipeline, ensuring reliable ingestion, transformation, validation and delivery to downstream consumers. 
  • Lead the implementation and production use of the data warehouse serving layer, closing out the current proof of concept and turning it into a production-ready platform. 
  • Set engineering standards for data modelling, schema evolution, data quality, observability, testing and operational support. 
  • Build and operate solutions using relevant platform technologies, including ClickHouse, S3, Kafka and schema registry tooling. 
  • Work closely with stakeholder teams to understand their needs, propose solutions, explain trade-offs and establish clear, dependable data contracts. 
  • Provide technical leadership to the data engineering team, raising the quality of design and implementation while encouraging collaboration, constructive challenge and continuous improvement. 
  • Help shape the longer-term data architecture and engineering approach as the business and its data requirements evolve.

About You 

You will be a technically strong and proactive data engineering leader who can turn complex business requirements into robust, scalable data products. You are comfortable supporting multiple teams, bringing forward clear recommendations and new ideas, and engaging constructively when your designs are challenged. You want to help shape the future data architecture of the business, not simply deliver against a predefined specification. 

As a result, we believe the following experiences and skills are essential for this role: 

  • Demonstrable experience designing and building data warehouses; this is a non-negotiable requirement. 
  • Hands-on production experience with ClickHouse; this is a non-negotiable requirement. 
  • Experience delivering a columnar OLAP data platform in production, with a strong understanding of analytical query performance and data modelling. 
  • Practical experience with Kafka and event-driven or streaming data architectures. 
  • Strong Python engineering skills and sufficient C# literacy to work effectively with systems and codebases that use C#. 
  • Experience modelling versioned position and P&L data, including point-in-time or as-of views and reproducible runs. 
  • Experience working in a trading or other time-sensitive, data-intensive business environment. 
  • Previous technical leadership, including setting standards and guiding engineering decisions. 
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to put forward solutions, bring ideas into discussions and engage positively with challenge. 
  • A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to balance the needs of multiple downstream teams while maintaining coherent platform standards. 

The following experience is not required, but highly desirable for this role: 

  • Experience in commodities trading or energy markets. 
  • Exposure to a Commodity Trading and Risk Management (CTRM) system, such as Orchestrade or Endur. 
  • Familiarity with dbt and/or data quality frameworks. 

What we offer 

  • Competitive compensation and participation in Engelhart’s discretionary bonus plan.  
  • 25 days of annual holiday entitlement, excluding UK public holidays. 
  • Robust benefits package such as medical, dental, life insurance, generous pension contribution, and supplemental benefits partially subsidised by the Company.   
  • Eligibility to receive external and internal training in accordance with our Training & Development Policy. 

We believe in inclusivity and are therefore dedicated to ensuring all employees – across gender identity, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, life experience, background and more – feel welcome and included in the company. We promote diversity because we believe it is essential to our ability to think holistically.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Real-Time Voice
descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

About The Role:

Voice is one of the most demanding and differentiated parts of what we do. As Principal Software Engineer for Voice/VoIP, you'll own the technical direction of our real-time voice infrastructure — the systems that let AI agents have natural, low-latency phone conversations at enterprise scale, across telephony providers, carriers, and global markets.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll set architectural direction, solve the hardest problems yourself, and raise the bar for how the wider engineering org builds and reasons about voice systems. You'll work closely with infrastructure, AI/ML, and product teams to ensure our voice stack is fast, reliable, and ready to scale globally.

  • Own the architecture and technical roadmap for Parloa's Voice/VoIP infrastructure, including SIP trunking, media handling, and real-time audio pipelines

  • Design for low-latency, high-availability voice at enterprise scale — across global telephony carriers and providers

  • Drive technical decisions on protocols and standards (SIP, SDP, RTP/SRTP, RTCP, WebRTC, ICE, STUN/TURN) and real-time media transport

  • Partner with AI/ML teams to optimise the integration between voice infrastructure and conversational AI models (ASR, TTS, turn-taking, barge-in)

  • Diagnose and resolve deep, systemic issues in call quality, latency, jitter, and packet loss across distributed, multi-region deployments

  • Define and uphold engineering standards for reliability, observability, and security across the voice stack

  • Mentor senior and staff engineers, acting as a technical multiplier across the organisation

  • Evaluate and integrate with telephony providers, carriers, and SIP trunk vendors as Parloa expands into new markets

title: Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 2, that looks like this:

 

What you'll be doing

  • Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

  • Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

  • Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

  • Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

  • Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

  • Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

  • Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

  • Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

  • Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

  • Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

  • Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

 

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

 

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

 

Interview process

  1. Initial chat with our Talent team

  2. Lead Hirer Interview

  3. Live AI Skills Assessment

  4. Values Interview with the CPTO

  5. Meet the CEO

 

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses.


Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity.

About the Team

The Enterprise team owns 1GLOBAL's products for businesses: global mobile connectivity for multinational enterprises, delivered through one platform, one contract and one invoice. Our customers manage their entire mobile estate in the Enterprise Portal, from subscriptions, usage and invoices to orders such as SIM swaps and suspensions, spend alerts, user roles and single sign-on.

We recently retired two legacy portals and moved every enterprise customer onto our new Enterprise Portal. That has created strong demand and a steady flow of requests from customers and internal teams, with a lot of exciting work ahead. We work closely with engineering, design, customer support, customer success, account management, operations and commercial teams.

We are looking for a Product Manager to shape the next chapter of the Enterprise Portal: what we show, how we show it, which reports and analytics we offer, and which actions customers can take themselves. This is a UI and UX-heavy role, where design judgement matters as much as sharp prioritisation.

About the Role

You will lead discovery and delivery for the Enterprise Portal, turning a high volume of customer and internal requests into a clear roadmap and a portal that enterprise customers enjoy using.

  • Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for the Enterprise Portal, deciding which dashboards, reports, analytics and self-service capabilities come next.
  • Run customer and UX research: talk to portal users directly and gather the voice of the customer from support, customer success, account management and operations.
  • Work hands-on with design from first concept to final UI, shaping flows, wireframes and prototypes and holding a high bar for UX and UI quality.
  • Shape the portal's integrations with mobile device management (MDM) platforms such as Jamf and Microsoft Intune, so enterprise IT teams can manage devices and connectivity together.
  • Prioritise work of every size, from small fixes and quick improvements to large multi-quarter projects, and communicate decisions and trade-offs clearly to every stakeholder.
  • Use analytics and data to understand how customers use the portal, spot friction and measure the impact of what we ship.
  • Write clear requirements and acceptance criteria with engineering, understanding the APIs behind the portal well enough to shape what is feasible.

Requirements

About You

Must Have

  • 4+ years in product management, including ownership of a B2B portal, dashboard or web application used by business customers.
  • Hands-on experience with customer and UX research: interviews and turning feedback from many channels into clear problems worth solving.
  • Experience with event-based product analytics such as Amplitude or similar products: defining events, building charts and funnels, and using the data to make decisions.
  • Strong prioritisation across a constant flow of requests, with the judgement to say no and the ability to explain why.
  • Proven collaboration across many departments, from engineering and design to customer success, account management, operations and sales, in fluent written and spoken English.
  • A working understanding of APIs and how a portal reads and writes data through them. This is not a technical role, but API fluency will help you shape what is feasible with engineers.


Nice to Have

  • Telecom experience, for example enterprise mobile services, MVNO platforms or eSIM.
  • Hands-on Amplitude experience, including tracking plans, event taxonomy and dashboards.
  • Experience with design systems, or with data visualisation for business users.

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Product Manager, Safety & Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Product Manager, Safety & Compliance

CreatorIQ is the software enterprise brands and agencies use to run their creator marketing programs. Customers include Burson, Delta Air Lines, Google, LVMH, Nestlé and Sephora. Those programs only hold up if the content is brand safe, sponsorships are disclosed, the music is cleared, and every campaign follows the rules in the markets it runs in. You'll own the product that makes that happen.

The core is SafeIQ, our always-on brand safety system. It runs multimodal AI classification on audio, video, images and text across millions of creator posts, and flags risk before it becomes a headline.

If you like turning messy classification and regulatory problems into workflows that risk, legal and compliance teams trust, you'll fit in. We're growing fast, and we work with teams around the world who care about doing great work.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Own the in-app brand safety review and workflow experience end to end, with one goal: shorten the path from "AI flagged something" to "a human made a confident decision." Ship, measure, learn, repeat.

  • Decide how AI classification reaches people: severity, categories, thresholds, review states and false-positive handling. Work with data science on what the models look for across audio, video, images and text, how confident they need to be before surfacing something, and where a human stays in the loop. Make every flag explainable and auditable.

  • Own compliance beyond content risk: sponsorship and ad disclosure under FTC guidelines and their equivalents, music licensing and rights clearance, legal drinking age (LDA) rules for alcohol promotion, and GDPR and regional privacy requirements. Work with Legal, Trust & Safety and regional compliance stakeholders to stay ahead of regulatory change without making every workflow wait on a legal review.

  • Understand the business nuance for API contracts, webhook payloads and data models with engineering so customers can pull safety and compliance signals into their own systems.

  • Work with GTM on positioning, packaging and enablement so what we sell matches what the product does and what regulators require.

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

  • You've spent 4+ years in product management or equivalent technical product ownership in B2B SaaS.

  • You have good product taste. You can look at an AI-generated feature or output and tell good UX from an AI slop, and you can say why.

  • You think critically and independently. You don't take a model's output, a legal requirement, a stakeholder request or a roadmap item at face value.

  • You can turn a dense, ambiguous regulatory or licensing requirement into a workflow engineers can build, and write it up clearly without needing a meeting.

  • You know the basics of AI classification pipelines: inference, confidence thresholds, false positives and negatives, and human review. You don't have to build them.

  • You're comfortable with API contracts, webhooks and role-based access well enough to write requirements with engineers.

  • You care more about solving real user problems, like getting a risk team to zero backlog with confidence, than about shipping features for their own sake.

  • You're curious, self-driven and low-ego. You own the product end to end, don't wait to be told what's next, and are allergic to "that's not my job."

  • You're comfortable working with distributed teams. Most work is async and flexible, but occasionally we'll ask for a later call. Stakeholders for this role are distributed across NA, EU, and APAC timezones

Nice to have:

  • Experience with trust and safety, content moderation, risk scoring or compliance tooling.

  • Experience with multimodal AI, content classification or ML evaluation workflows.

  • Experience with regulated content and privacy rules: FTC disclosure guidelines, music and content licensing, alcohol promotion, or GDPR and CCPA, and how they shape product requirements.

  • Experience shipping customer-facing APIs, webhooks or enterprise integrations.

  • Familiarity with social media platforms, martech or influencer workflows.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Interested about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply!

 

What you will get from us:

  • People: Work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do.

  • Guidance: Utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you'll need to become successful here from your first day with us.

  • Work/life harmony: 25 days of vacation, floating and company holidays, wellness benefits, and paid parental leave.

  • Whole Health Package: Comprehensive healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, vision, mental health support, life insurance, income protection, and other wellness benefits.

  • Planning for the future: A Royal London Pension Plan to help you plan ahead.

  • Equity: Stock options as part of our equity-sharing program.

  • Work from home stipend: To assist you in setting up a home office that works for you.

 

Compensation, benefits, and beyond:

We know that benefits play a significant role in your overall compensation. We invite you to review our benefits and perks.

Who we are:

CreatorIQ is enterprise infrastructure for creator marketing, trusted by more than 1,300 of the world's leading brands and agencies, including Beiersdorf, Delta Air Lines, Dentsu, Google, Nestlé, and Wella. Powered by the Creator Graph®, CreatorIQ's proprietary AI and intelligence foundation grounded in over 11 years of data, it’s built for teams, agents, and the entire enterprise tech stack. With headquarters in Los Angeles and offices in Austin, London, Manila, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw, CreatorIQ’s global team moves quickly and deliberately because we're setting the pace for an industry that's still being defined.

Learn more at www.creatoriq.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

At CreatorIQ, different perspectives make our work better. The people we hire come from different backgrounds and think in different ways — and that's exactly what helps us connect with each other, and with the customers and creators we serve.We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and empowering work environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. By embracing our core values of being intentional, pursuing excellence every day, embracing the journey together, and being a good human, we create an atmosphere that promotes collaboration and growth. Join us to celebrate differences, innovate together, and be a part of a business that is disrupting the marketing industry.

AI Transparency Notice

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and note taking during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

title: Product Support & Enablement Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the role

We are looking for a Product Support & Enablement Lead to lead and develop our existing L1 Product Support team. You will help the team resolve more customer issues without escalating to L2, while improving the tools, training, and workflows that allow support to scale.

This is a senior technical and people-management role—not simply a role overseeing today’s queue. You will lead frontline delivery for Product Support (L1) and develop the team’s ability to investigate and resolve increasingly technical requests, including paid self-serve and first-level enterprise issues.

You will work closely with L2 and other teams to define clear ownership, identify work Product Support (L1) can safely take on, and build repeatable escalation paths. You will also contribute to operational continuity for the wider Support organization.

You will be equally comfortable coaching a team member through a customer issue, investigating an API error, improving a support workflow, and partnering with Engineering or Product to address a recurring problem.

Key responsibilities


Lead frontline support delivery

  • Lead, coach, and develop a distributed L1 Product Support team, providing regular feedback and supporting technical growth.

  • Own day-to-day L1 Product Support delivery, including queue prioritization, backlog management, customer communication, and regional handoffs.

  • Define and maintain clear ownership of L1 Product Support queues and handoffs to L2, including for paid self-serve and first-level enterprise requests.

  • Monitor service quality, response and resolution times, backlog health, and customer satisfaction; turn insights into practical improvements.

  • Stay hands-on with complex or sensitive customer issues and model strong technical judgment.


Increase Product Support (L1) technical autonomy

  • Train and coach Product Support (L1) agents to investigate, reproduce, and resolve more technical issues across Mistral products, including Vibe, Studio, and APIs.

  • Work with L2 to identify issue types that Product Support (L1) can safely take on and define the knowledge, access, and safeguards needed.

  • Create playbooks, troubleshooting guides, and escalation criteria that help Product Support (L1) agents resolve issues independently and consistently.

  • Improve L1-to-L2 handoffs so escalations contain customer impact, investigation steps, and relevant evidence.

  • Track escalation patterns and use them to prioritize training, documentation, and product improvements.

Scale systems, workflows, and automation

  • Own improvements to frontline support tooling, routing, workflows, macros, and internal processes.

  • Own improvements to frontline Product Support (L1) tooling, routing, workflows, macros, and internal processes.

  • Develop AI-assisted support and automation, including Intercom Fin, to reduce repetitive work while maintaining response quality and appropriate human escalation.

  • Identify recurring contact drivers and partner with Product, Engineering, and other teams to address them at the source.

  • Build reporting and operating reviews that make workload, service performance, escalation patterns, and risks visible.

  • Establish shared processes with specialist Support teams while respecting their ownership of technical delivery.

Build knowledge and operational continuity

  • Develop onboarding materials and technical training that help agents become autonomous.

  • Work with Documentation and Product teams to keep internal guidance and customer-facing help content accurate and useful.

  • Share customer insights and support trends with Product, Engineering, and go-to-market teams.

  • Help coordinate support readiness for new products, features, and processes.

  • Contribute to operational continuity for the Support organization through team coordination, reporting, and escalation management.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience in customer-facing technical support, product support, or support operations in a fast-moving technology environment.

  • Senior people-management experience, including leading, coaching, and developing a Support team.

  • Strong technical judgment and troubleshooting skills, including the ability to investigate product issues, reproduce bugs, and understand API requests and errors.

  • Experience managing support queues, escalations, service quality, and operational performance.

  • Experience improving workflows, tooling, or knowledge management.

  • Ability to use support data to identify bottlenecks and prioritize improvements without losing sight of the customer experience.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to explain technical issues clearly to different audiences.

  • A pragmatic, collaborative approach and comfort working across time zones and functions.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Intercom, Fin, or comparable support and AI automation tools.

  • Experience supporting developer tools, APIs, SaaS products, or AI applications.

  • Familiarity with scripting or lightweight automation.

  • Experience building onboarding programs, technical training, or support playbooks.

  • French language skills.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

title: Production Engineer (TL2)
descriptionHtml:
• Location:  UK - Hybrid 

  • Level: TL2

  • Team: Applied Engineering

This role is based in the UK and requires existing right to work in the UK.

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza Overview

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

  • Drive the architectural design, technical strategy, and reliability engineering of Kaluza's distributed infrastructure to support multi-region scalability and continuous uptime.

  • Champion Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, optimizing system observability, automated incident response, chaos engineering, and post-incident root cause analyses.

  • Build, enhance, and maintain secure Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and CI/CD automation pipelines, minimizing deployment friction across cross-functional engineering teams.

  • Own complex production engineering initiatives end-to-end, acting as a technical authority and key escalation point for mission-critical infrastructure incidents.

  • Mentor and upskill engineers across the department, cultivating a strong culture of operational excellence, modern DevOps practices, and architectural standards.

  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering leaders to balance rapid feature delivery with system performance, security compliance, and infrastructure cost optimization.

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Strong hands-on production engineering, SRE, or DevOps experience managing high-throughput distributed systems in public cloud environments (AWS/GCP).

  • Demonstrated technical leadership skills with a track record of architecting scalable infrastructure, driving platform ownership, and upskilling team members.

  • Deep proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), container orchestration (Kubernetes/Docker), and modern CI/CD tooling.

  • Hands-on experience with observability and monitoring platforms (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana) alongside strong scripting or programming skills (Python, Go, or TypeScript).

  • Solid understanding of distributed network design, cloud security best practices, automated failover, and disaster recovery strategies.

What will set you apart:

  • Prior experience in high-concurrency event-driven SaaS architectures, IoT platforms, or the green energy sector.

  • Track record of introducing and scaling SLI/SLO/Error Budget frameworks across multiple product teams.

  • Active contributions to open-source infrastructure tools or cloud-native technology projects.

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.

Our Perks

  • Pension Scheme

  • Discretionary Bonus Scheme

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

title: Projectmanager Datacenters
descriptionHtml:
Krijg jij energie van het leiden van grote en complexe projecten waarin techniek, samenwerking en commercie samenkomen? Weet jij multidisciplinaire teams mee te nemen en houd je tegelijkertijd grip op kwaliteit, planning, budget en klantbelang? Als Projectmanager Datacenters bij Deerns neem jij de regie over uitdagende advies- en ontwerpprojecten binnen een sector die continu in ontwikkeling is.

De uitdaging

Als Projectmanager Datacenters ben je verantwoordelijk voor het succesvol realiseren van grote en complexe projecten binnen de datacentersector. Je stuurt multidisciplinaire projectteams aan en zorgt ervoor dat projecten binnen de afgesproken kwaliteit, planning en financiële kaders worden gerealiseerd.

Daarbij combineer je projectmanagement met technische inhoud. Je begrijpt wat er binnen de verschillende technische disciplines speelt en weet de juiste specialisten met elkaar te verbinden. Je hoeft niet zelf ieder technisch detail uit te werken, maar bent inhoudelijk sterk genoeg om keuzes te beoordelen, risico's te herkennen en richting te geven aan het project.

De datacenterwereld stelt hoge eisen aan onder andere betrouwbaarheid, energie-efficiëntie en veiligheid. Binnen Deerns werken we aan uiteenlopende projecten, van de ontwikkeling van nieuwe datacenters tot uitbreiding, verduurzaming en renovatie van bestaande locaties.

Je bent daarbij niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor het project zelf. Ook de samenwerking met de opdrachtgever, het financiële resultaat en het herkennen van nieuwe kansen behoren tot jouw rol.

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren:

  • Het leiden en aansturen van multidisciplinaire projectteams;

  • Het bewaken van kwaliteit, planning, budget, scope en projectresultaat;

  • Het opstellen en bewaken van projectplannen, planningen, begrotingen en voorstellen;

  • Het organiseren en leiden van kick-offs, project- en coördinatieoverleggen;

  • Het tijdig signaleren van risico’s en afwijkingen en hierop gericht bijsturen;

  • Het afstemmen met opdrachtgevers, architecten, aannemers, installateurs en andere projectpartners;

  • Het onderhouden en verder uitbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties;

  • Het signaleren van commerciële kansen en het bespreken van meerwerk en aanvullende opdrachten;

  • Het bewaken van de financiële voortgang en bijdragen aan een gezonde projectmarge;

  • Het bijdragen aan het verbeteren van projectprocessen en onze manier van samenwerken.

Het team en de projecten

Je wordt onderdeel van een hecht en multidisciplinair team met een gedeelde passie voor datacentertechnologie en duurzame techniek. Binnen het team komen verschillende expertises samen, waaronder werktuigbouwkunde, elektrotechniek, brandveiligheid en duurzaamheid. Kennisdeling, samenwerking en werkplezier staan centraal.

Je werkt aan nationale en internationale projecten voor uiteenlopende opdrachtgevers binnen de datacenterbranche. Daarbij krijg je te maken met complexe technische vraagstukken en verschillende stakeholders. Geen project is hetzelfde en juist die combinatie van techniek, organisatie en samenwerking maakt deze functie uitdagend.

Door jouw ervaring speel je daarnaast een belangrijke rol in de verdere ontwikkeling van het team. Je deelt kennis, begeleidt minder ervaren collega’s en helpt ons om onze projecten steeds slimmer en efficiënter te organiseren.

Dit ben jij

Je bent een ervaren projectmanager die techniek, mensen en commercie met elkaar weet te verbinden. Ook wanneer projecten complex worden, behoud je het overzicht en weet je de juiste prioriteiten te stellen. Je durft beslissingen te nemen, communiceert gemakkelijk op verschillende niveaus en creëert duidelijkheid voor zowel de opdrachtgever als jouw projectteam.

Je geeft mensen de ruimte om vanuit hun eigen expertise bij te dragen, maar bent duidelijk wanneer richting of besluitvorming nodig is. Tegelijkertijd kijk je verder dan het project van vandaag: je begrijpt het belang van duurzame klantrelaties en herkent kansen om onze samenwerking met opdrachtgevers verder uit te bouwen.

Verder beschik je over:

  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een technische achtergrond;

  • Ruime ervaring binnen complexe technische ontwerp- en/of adviesprojecten;

  • Bij voorkeur circa 15 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan een belangrijk deel in projectleiding of projectmanagement;

  • Brede multidisciplinaire technische kennis;

  • Ervaring met het aansturen, motiveren en coachen van projectteams;

  • Kennis van projectmanagementmethodieken, planning en financiële projectbeheersing;

  • Kennis van relevante contractuele en bouwrechtelijke aspecten;

  • Commercieel inzicht en ervaring met klant- en stakeholdermanagement;

  • Een resultaatgerichte en oplossingsgerichte manier van werken.

Dit bieden wij

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5.623 en € 8.033 (op basis van 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van jouw ervaring, kennis en expertise.

  • Een functie van 32-40 uur per week.

  • Uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in Nederland en internationaal.

  • Een werkomgeving waarin innovatie en duurzaamheid dagelijks in de praktijk worden gebracht.

  • Aandacht voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling en vitaliteit met ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden, fiets- en sportregelingen, flexibele werkuren, 33 vakantiedagen en mogelijkheid tot aankopen van extra dagen.

  • Hybride werken, waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om afwisselend thuis en op kantoor in Den Haag te werken.

  • Een team waar samenwerking en collegialiteit voorop staan en waar we informeel met elkaar omgaan.

  • Duurzaamheid zit in onze genen. Dit uit zich bijvoorbeeld in een mobiliteitsbeleid waar gezondheid en duurzaamheid voorop staan. Veel van onze kantoren liggen bij OV-knooppunten, fietsen wordt aangemoedigd en je reiskosten worden 100% vergoed op basis van OV.

Over Deerns
Deerns is als onafhankelijk ingenieursbureau gespecialiseerd in advies, ontwerp en uitvoeringsbegeleiding op het vlak van installatietechniek, bouwfysica, energievoorziening en duurzaamheid. Onze expertises dragen bij aan duurzame, intelligente en toekomstbestendige gebouwen die de processen van onze opdrachtgevers optimaal ondersteunen. We zijn verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp van de installaties en het realiseren van een goed comfort en een prettig klimaat in de meest uiteenlopende gebouwen; van kantoren, tot luchthavens en van ziekenhuizen tot datacenters.


Daarnaast is Deerns benoemd als Great Place to Work!

Kennis maken?

Wil je meer weten over werken bij Deerns? Neem dan contact op met Maarten Borgmeijer (Corporate Recruiter) via +31 6 11 66 75 44. Wil je meer weten over de inhoud van de functie? Neem dan contact op met Ester Vlielander (Unit Director Data Center en Life Sciences) via +31 6 50 73 68 41

title: Recruiter – Quereinstieg aus Vertrieb & Marketing (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du willst Menschen gewinnen. Und an Ergebnissen gemessen werden.

Für uns hat Recruiting dieselbe Energie wie guter Vertrieb: Chancen erkennen, eine überzeugende Ansprache entwickeln, viel umsetzen und konsequent am Ball bleiben.

Du planst und drehst Recruiting-Ads und Content. Du knüpfst Kontakte, entwickelst dein Netzwerk und gehst im Active Sourcing auf interessante Menschen zu. Du testest neue Ansätze, führst Gespräche und hältst die nächsten Schritte verbindlich nach.

Was dich antreibt: Verantwortung, eine hohe eigene Schlagzahl und sichtbare Ergebnisse. Klare Ziele geben dir Orientierung. Leistungsabhängige Vergütung motiviert dich. Du willst selbst beeinflussen, was du erreichst.

So gewinnst du die richtigen Menschen für unser Team

Bei Rügamer & Steiner rekrutierst du für unser eigenes Unternehmen – von Sales über Projekt- und Accountmanagement bis zu Content und AI/Tech. Dafür verbindest du mehrere Wege:

  • Recruiting-Ads: Du entwickelst Botschaften und Videoideen für unsere Stellen und planst die Aufnahmen gemeinsam mit uns. Vor der Kamera stehen unter anderem Aurelian, Simeon und Noah – gelegentlich auch du selbst.

  • Content: Du planst und drehst Inhalte, die unsere Arbeit, unser Team und die beruflichen Möglichkeiten bei uns sichtbar machen.

  • Netzwerk: Du baust aktiv Beziehungen auf, erschließt Empfehlungen und bringst interessante Menschen zusammen. Zum Beispiel organisierst du ein monatliches Abendessen mit Account-Managern aus Düsseldorf: zum Kennenlernen, für fachlichen Austausch und um langfristig Kontakte zu Menschen aufzubauen, die unser Team verstärken könnten.

  • Active Sourcing: Du findest passende Kandidaten und sprichst sie persönlich an – über LinkedIn, Nachrichten und Telefon.

  • Gespräche und Nachhalten: Du klärst Erfahrung, Motivation und Erwartungen, hältst Kontakt und bringst gemeinsam mit den Teamleads der einzelnen Abteilungen die nächsten Schritte bis zur Entscheidung voran.

Du schaust dir an, welche Ansprache funktioniert, welche Inhalte Interesse wecken und über welche Wege passende Menschen kommen. Daraus entwickelst du die nächsten Maßnahmen. Du verantwortest, dass aus deinen Aktivitäten gute Gespräche und erfolgreiche Besetzungen entstehen.

Das bringst du mit

Du hast bereits Menschen gewonnen und Stellen besetzt – in einer Personalberatung, im Inhouse-Recruiting oder für dein eigenes Unternehmen.

Oder du kommst aus Vertrieb oder Marketing und willst deine Erfahrung jetzt im Recruiting einsetzen. Du weißt, wie man Zielgruppen versteht, Interesse weckt, überzeugende Gespräche führt und aus ersten Kontakten konkrete Ergebnisse entwickelt.

Entscheidend ist, dass du Menschen gewinnen kannst, eigenständig ins Handeln kommst und bereit bist, dir das Recruiting-Handwerk anzueignen. Zeig uns anhand konkreter Beispiele, was du selbst vorangebracht und erreicht hast.

Du kommunizierst überzeugend auf Deutsch und Englisch, organisierst mehrere Suchen gleichzeitig und hältst Zusagen zuverlässig nach. Du hast Lust, sichtbar zu werden, Ideen auszuprobieren und dich an Ergebnissen messen zu lassen.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern und den Verantwortlichen unserer Fachbereiche zusammen. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss darauf, mit welchen Menschen wir unser Unternehmen weiter aufbauen.

Du gestaltest unsere Ansprache mit, entwickelst neue Wege der Kandidatengewinnung und übernimmst Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung. Klassische HR-Verwaltung gehört nicht zu deiner Rolle. Bei Kampagnentechnik und Videoschnitt arbeitest du mit den jeweils Zuständigen zusammen.

Dein Arbeitsort ist unser Büro in Düsseldorf. Wir bieten eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und 26 Urlaubstagen.

Leistung soll sich für dich lohnen

Unser Ziel ist, dass du bei uns 100.000 € und mehr im Jahr verdienen kannst. Für die Position sehen wir eine Gesamtvergütung von 6.000–12.000 € brutto im Monat inklusive variablem Anteil vor. Wir suchen jemanden, den klare Ziele, Verantwortung und leistungsabhängige Vergütung motivieren – und der seinen Erfolg selbst mitgestalten will.

Zeig uns, wie du Menschen gewinnst

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein konkretes Beispiel: Wie hast du passende Menschen erreicht, ihr Interesse geweckt und daraus ein Ergebnis entwickelt? Das kann eine Besetzung sein oder – bei deinem Quereinstieg – ein passendes Beispiel aus Vertrieb oder Marketing. Ein Satz dazu reicht für den ersten Schritt. Alles Weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam im Call. Bitte ohne vertrauliche Personen- oder Kundendaten.

title: Regional Sales Director, Core Enterprise – France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in France, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role: you will create the market and the pipeline machine behind it, rather than inherit an established playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

In this role, you will

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
  • Build a pipeline machine and a market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across France
  • Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
  • Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large French enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across France's largest accounts
  • Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting
  • Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers
  • Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and into new markets

Minimum requirements for the role

  • Three or more years of proven success leading new business sales at enterprise level, with a track record of revenue delivery and overachievement against target
  • Has built something rather than inherited it, with experience building a market or a new sales function from scratch
  • Full team lifecycle experience: has recruited, ramped and retained a team, and can show where each happened
  • Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths
  • Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business
  • Fluent French and access to our Paris office

An ideal candidate also has

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional
  • Intelligence and genuine coachability: you learn fast, welcome feedback and apply it
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you are expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity: you can set the market strategy and also step into a deal review to show a rep where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.

 

Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Web Dependability Engineering team, you'll make sure websites just work in DuckDuckGo's browsers across Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, helping ensure our users have the best-possible experience browsing with DuckDuckGo. Recent projects include:

  • Reverse-engineering how sites detect our privacy protections and building countermeasures that keep pages working

  • Shimming browser APIs so sites work seamlessly across different browser engines and system webviews

  • Building LLM agent pipelines that automatically reproduce and triage reported site breakage

 

As a Senior Web Compatibility Engineer, you'll be our resident expert on why websites break and how to fix them: owning the webcompat side of our triage process, debugging gnarly issues in code you don't control, distinguishing site bugs from browser bugs from privacy protection-induced breakage, leading the charge when a top site breaks and becomes an incident, shipping durable fixes across every platform, and work on related projects that prevent user churn and keep users coming back to DuckDuckGo.

About You

  • 7+ years of experience building and debugging complex web applications with vanilla JavaScript.

  • Detailed knowledge of web standards, web components, and browser APIs. Any additional experience with our stack is a bonus: Swift/Kotlin/C#/C++/Python.

  • Advanced ability to reverse-engineer obfuscated third-party code and reduce issues to minimal test cases.

  • Passion for hunting elusive bugs and tracing them to their root cause.

  • Interest in automating repetitive work and building agentic tooling that multiplies the team's impact.

  • Experience triaging issues, leading incident response, and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience shipping code beyond the web, like native or desktop clients.

  • Ability to lead complex, ambiguous projects with little to no oversight.

Compensation

Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation, plus stock options:

  • United States: $190,500 USD

  • United Kingdom: £134,600 GBP

  • Canada: CA$253,500 CAD

  • All other regions*: €157,350 EUR

*Team members outside the US, UK and Canada are currently paid $178,500 USD. Pay converts to the EUR amount above on January 1, 2027 for Spanish team members, and approximately February 1, 2027 in all other regions.

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

Hiring Process
