title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.

You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.

Why this role exists

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

What you’ll do

Product contribution

  • Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.
  • Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.
  • Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

Strategic technical stewardship

  • Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.
  • Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.
  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.
  • Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.
  • Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle

  • Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.
  • Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.
  • Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.

Thought leadership

  • Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.
  • Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.
  • Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.
  • Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.

What you’ll bring

  • Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.
  • Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.
  • Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.
  • Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.
  • Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.
  • Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations.
  • The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal authority.
  • Strong written communication and sound judgment, including the ability to create technical narratives and distinguish reusable product work from customer-specific customization.

Strongly preferred qualifications

  • Direct experience with GitLab as a platform, including GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, or GitLab Self-Managed.
  • Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools.
  • Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior.
  • Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents.
  • A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems.
  • Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments.

Technologies and domains

Directly relevant technologies and domains include:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Go
  • AI-assisted development and the agentic SDLC
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis and Sidekiq
  • Git internals
  • GitLab CI/CD and Runner architecture
  • Kubernetes and containers
  • Terraform
  • Linux, networking, observability, and performance analysis
  • Vue and TypeScript
  • APIs and automation
  • DevSecOps governance, security, and compliance

What this role is not

This role isn't:

  • A generic field engineering role.
  • A proof-of-concept factory.
  • A replacement for Solutions Architecture, Customer Success Architecture, Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Support, SRE, Product, or Engineering.
  • A customer-specific customization function.
  • Unbilled Professional Services.
  • A requirements-gathering role that only escalates to Product.
  • An AI evangelism role disconnected from product execution.

Success measures

Success in this role may include:

  • Stabilizing strategic customer adoption or retention risks.
  • Fixing product bugs or contributing features.
  • Removing AI adoption blockers for strategic accounts.
  • Creating reusable implementation patterns and transitioning them to long-term owners.
  • Producing or enabling Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, or technical narratives.
  • Resolving cross-functional customer challenges without creating permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.
  • Equipping Product, Engineering, Support, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and SA teams with better guidance based on learning from the field.
  • Increasing adoption and effective use of GitLab capabilities, especially GitLab Duo and GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in targeted accounts.

About the team

The Forward Deployed Engineering team connects strategic customer needs with GitLab product execution. The team works directly with customers and across GitLab to resolve complex adoption challenges, contribute durable product improvements, and create reusable technical guidance. Its goal is to stabilize urgent situations, improve the product, and transition ongoing ownership to the appropriate team rather than create a permanent dependency.

Ideal candidate profile

You're a Staff-level product or platform engineer who can operate in the field without becoming field-only. You're comfortable reading traces, writing production code, debugging architecture, discussing AI governance, leading a customer technical session, opening a merge request, outlining a whitepaper, and coordinating across teams to achieve a strategic customer outcome.

You're not simply a strong communicator with technical awareness. You're a credible engineer with the judgment, presence, and narrative ability to turn customer reality into product contributions, adoption guidance, and company-level thought leadership.

We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience. Many successful candidates don't meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply and let our recruiting team assess your application.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave 

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

title: Research Engineer - Web Crawlers
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a Research Engineer to join the research team at ElevenLabs, focused on large-scale web crawling for our frontier AI models. The quality of our models is bounded by the quality and scale of the data behind them, and you will own the crawling systems that source world-class data from the open web. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy:

  • Building and operating large-scale, distributed web crawlers that discover, fetch, and extract data across billions of pages reliably and efficiently.

  • Solving hard crawling problems such as content extraction from messy HTML, deduplication at web scale, freshness and recrawl strategies, and politeness and rate-limit handling.

  • Designing targeted crawling pipelines that find high-value data sources, including audio, video, and multilingual content, and turn them into clean training-ready datasets.

  • Creating tooling and infrastructure that lets researchers request, monitor, and explore newly crawled web data quickly and reliably.

 

Requirements

We do not require any formal certifications or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. Ideally, you bring:

  • Hands-on experience building and scaling web crawlers or scraping systems, ideally in support of machine learning training data.

  • Strong engineering skills in distributed systems at scale (e.g., Kubernetes, queue-based architectures, or custom pipelines processing billions of documents).

  • The capacity to autonomously evaluate the quality, coverage, and compliance of crawled data, and to build the tooling to measure it.

 

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

title: Research Scientist Intern (PhD) - Cohort '27
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

About the role

You’ll join our research team for a 4 to 6 month internship, in the cohort that starts in May 2027. The work is hands-on, with tabular foundation models, a new class of AI model, and how they’re applied. We have more open research problems than people to work on them, and you’ll get a project matched to your interests and expertise, with the chance to publish the results. Some of the problems we’re working on:

  • Scaling model architectures and training

  • Models that read text and tables together

  • Architectures for time series, forecasting and anomaly detection

  • Faster training and inference

  • Causal reasoning in foundation models

  • Learning across multiple related tables

  • Benchmarks that show where tabular foundation models work and where they break, in science and in industry

What we’re looking for

  • You’re doing a PhD in computer science, applied maths, statistics, electrical engineering or a related field.

  • You have at least one first-author or shared-first-author paper at a top venue such as NeurIPS, ICML or ICLR.

  • You've turned your own research ideas into working experiments, for example in PyTorch, and you can tell when code is quietly wrong, whether you or a coding agent wrote it.

  • You can join us in Freiburg or Berlin from May 2027 for 4 to 6 months.

  • Experience with data science for tabular data or time series data is a plus

Mentorship at Prior Labs

Your mentor will be one of the researchers building TabPFN, who’ll help you with the technical side of your project and with your development as a researcher. Before you accept, we agree on a project area and a mentor with you, so you know what you’re working on and who you’re working with from day one. During the internship you’ll also work alongside the rest of our research and data science teams.

Benefits

  • A cohort of PhD interns who start with you, and a week-long workshop in Freiburg with the whole cohort in summer 2027

  • Opportunity to publish your work

  • Compute for your project

  • Healthcare, transportation and fitness covered

Key dates

  • Applications close on 1 January 2027. We review applications as they arrive, so applying early helps.

  • The cohort starts on 1 May 2027 with a joint onboarding. We can make exceptions, but we’d like you to start with the cohort.

  • The internship lasts 4 to 6 months, with 6 preferred.

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

title: Responsable comptable adjoint(e)
descriptionHtml:

Vos missions

2. Participer aux clôtures et à la révision des comptes

  • Préparer et contribuer aux clôtures comptables mensuelles et annuelles.

  • Réaliser les travaux de révision : justification des comptes, contrôle des écritures, rapprochements et régularisations.

  • Veiller à la fiabilité et à la cohérence des données comptables.

3. Contribuer au reporting et à la consolidation

  • Participer aux travaux de consolidation des comptes du Groupe.

  • Collecter, contrôler et fiabiliser les données financières des différentes entités.

  • Élaborer les reportings périodiques et les tableaux de bord destinés au Responsable Administratif.

  • Participer à l'analyse des résultats et à la préparation des données financières présentées au Groupe.

4. Apporter votre soutien au contrôle de gestion

  • Participer à la préparation et à l'analyse des résultats.

  • Contribuer au suivi des données analytiques et à l'analyse des écarts entre le réalisé et les prévisions.

  • Participer à la fiabilisation des indicateurs de performance.

5. Participer au suivi de la trésorerie et de la fiscalité

  • Contribuer au suivi des flux et des positions de trésorerie des filiales françaises.

  • Préparer, établir et contrôler les déclarations de TVA et autres déclarations fiscales.

  • Veiller au respect des échéances et des obligations déclaratives.


Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation supérieure en comptabilité, gestion ou finance, de type DCG, Licence professionnelle ou équivalent (Bac +3 minimum).

Vous maîtrisez les mécanismes comptables, les opérations de clôture et de révision ainsi que les obligations fiscales courantes, notamment en matière de TVA.

Une connaissance des processus de consolidation, du reporting financier et du suivi de trésorerie sera particulièrement appréciée.

Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques, notamment Excel, et savez exploiter des données comptables pour en tirer des analyses fiables.

Au-delà de votre parcours, nous recherchons une personne :

  • Rigoureuse et organisée, attachée à la fiabilité de son travail.

title: Restaurant Operations - Munich
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland.

 

About the Role:

We’re looking for a true startup Operations person. Good onboarding is what makes our merchants set up for success. From the first meeting, the go-live to working and growing together - this person will own the onboarding process and make it all happen. This role is for someone who likes working with the product, becoming an expert in it and teaching others.

Your day-to-day will be a mix of hands-on ops, project management, customer communication and problem solving. We are reshaping the future of hospitality tech, and this role is at the forefront of it.

What You’ll Do:

Our Operations happen on a restaurant floor, in a lively neighbourhood, at a busy bar - we operate in the city:

  • Run restaurant onboarding: train, connect and implement together with the restaurant team

  • Problem-solve for our merchants on the ground while running live operations

  • Support restaurants after the go live and make sure that Tebi adds value to their business long-term

  • Find opportunities for improvement in our process, materials and systems

  • Continue investing in our relationship with our merchants to make sure they are happy with our product and growing as a business

  • Identify product and process gaps and bring it to internal central teams such as product, engineering and central operations

What You’ll Need:

  • You are a creative problem solver who enjoys interacting with hospitality businesses

  • You are empathetic towards our merchants and curious about their business

  • You can juggle multiple things at once and bring structure

  • Curious about the product, want to be an expert in Tebi system and can apply your knowledge

  • Good communication - you are great at proactive contact and managing expectations

  • Being comfortable with high-pace environments: both the hospitality flow and the startup day-to-day

  • Interest in data, process improvement and automation

  • Flexibility in working hours that fit our merchants’ needs and ensuring a healthy balance

  • At least 2-4 years of experience in hospitality, early startup operations, fast-paced account management or customer operations

  • You are comfortable working in both English and German

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Flexible Time-off

  • Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Senior Airspace Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Electra

Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be. Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50–500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you've been one of them. At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We're backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we're moving toward first test flights in 2027.

Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another.

Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways.

The Role

Electra.aero is seeking an experienced Senior Airspace Engineer to develop the methods, operational concepts, procedures, airspace solutions, and policies needed to safely integrate Ultra Short operations into the national airspace system, including at major airports and novel, distributed access points.

The engineer will shape flight demonstrations, tabletop exercises, simulations, and data collection to inform Ultra Short policy, guidance, and standards development in the US and Europe. Collaboration with the FAA, NATCA, and industry standards development organizations is central to the role.

This role requires a deep understanding of how aircraft performance, flight operations, airspace design, VFR/IFR procedures, PBN, RNAV/RNP operations, obstacle evaluation, navigation systems, FAA/EASA regulations, and real-world operational constraints intersect. The successful candidate will translate new aircraft capabilities and operational concepts into safe, certifiable, and operationally useful flight-path infrastructure.

The ideal candidate understands airspace design and air traffic management concepts, tools, and workflows across congested terminal and en route airspace, and has led or contributed to research translating novel aircraft capabilities into operational procedures. They are comfortable working directly with the FAA, international civil aviation authorities, air navigation service providers, airport authorities, and local stakeholders to advance integration projects. Firsthand experience in procedure design, airspace design, or air traffic control is valuable; working familiarity with the FAA’s 8260-series Orders is expected.

The engineer will collaborate with Electra and FAA teams through Electra’s Cooperative Research and Development Agreement (CRADA) with the FAA Tech Center, the FAA eIPP program, the Virginia Smart Airspace Program, and the International Test Arena in Norway, as well as through company-led testing and procedure development.

What You’ll Do

  • Translate EL9 performance characteristics into Ultra Short operational capabilities, including ground footprint, obstacle clearance, and maneuvering.
  • Collaborate with aircraft performance engineers to model EL9 capabilities under normal, degraded, and contingency conditions, incorporating system safety analysis to define feasible Ultra Short procedures.
  • Develop candidate procedures for novel urban access points and existing airports, taking into account EL2/EL9 Ultra Short performance, instrument procedure design criteria, airport traffic flows, and the obstacle environment.
  • Review FAA, EASA, ICAO, and national standards—including fixed-wing, heliport, and vertiport frameworks, FAA 8260-series Orders, and international equivalents—to identify regulatory and policy gaps affecting proposed procedures.
  • Evaluate candidate procedures with Electra’s product team, the FAA, airport operations teams, and local air traffic control to prepare for flight demonstrations, tabletop exercises, simulations, and future policy and standards development.
  • Define learning objectives and data collection requirements for flight demonstrations and simulations to validate operational concepts.
  • Synthesize flight test results, lessons learned, and operational insights to inform regulatory workstreams developing Ultra Short policy and standards.
  • Support Electra’s commercial and infrastructure partnerships teams in assessing the feasibility of candidate access points in urban settings and at airports.
  • Develop thought leadership materials that clearly explain novel Ultra Short operational concepts to regulators, local stakeholders, and airport authorities.
  • Represent Electra in FAA, EASA, and ICAO working groups and industry standards development organizations to help shape standards, guidance, and policy for Ultra Short airspace integration and operations.

What you Bring

  • Master’s degree or PhD in aerospace engineering, aviation management, airport planning, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in airspace management research, policy and regulatory development, airspace or procedure design, or a related domain.
  • Strong working knowledge of FAA and/or EASA regulatory frameworks, including the AC 150 series, Part 135, Part 23, TERPS/PANS-OPS, 8260-series Orders, and relevant airport design standards.
  • Experience working with regulators, air navigation service providers, airport operators, and industry partners.
  • Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment with evolving requirements and limited precedent.

Bonus Points

  • Experience leading or contributing to airspace integration research, including FAA, NASA, or MITRE airspace modernization initiatives.
  • Experience as an air traffic controller or with a non-FAA service provider specializing in instrument procedure design and development.
  • Private or commercial pilot experience.

What We Offer

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance; STD, LTD, and life insurance
  • Generous PTO, sick leave, and company holidays
  • Paid winter break
  • 401(k) with immediate vesting
  • Free catered lunches, coffee, snacks, and drinks at our Manassas headquarters
  • Free on-site parking

descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Brand & Communications Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Overview

PR kann heute mehr, als nur Sichtbarkeit verwalten.

Bei getpress bauen wir an einer Marke, die zeigt, wie moderne Kommunikation für Europas ambitionierteste Unternehmen aussehen kann: strategisch, messbar, relevant und mit einem klaren Gefühl für Qualität.
Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die unsere externe Kommunikation ownt und vor allem sichtbar macht. Jemanden, der*die starke Themen erkennt, gute Formate daraus entwickelt und sie auch selbst umsetzt – von LinkedIn und Website über Podcast, Blog und Whitepaper bis zu Speaker- und Event-Content.

Deine Rolle

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Brand, Content, Thought Leadership und externer Kommunikation. Dabei bist du strategisch genug, um Themen, Kanäle und Formate kritisch zu hinterfragen und hands-on genug, um auch selbst zu schreiben, zu produzieren, zu redigieren und Dinge live zu bringen.

  • Du planst, steuerst und produzierst unseren Content für alle relevanten Kanäle und Formate – darunter LinkedIn, Website, Blog, Podcast, Whitepaper sowie Speaker-Auftritte und Events.
  • Du schreibst, redigierst und schärfst Inhalte selbst – von LinkedIn-Posts und Website-Texten über Case Studies und Blogartikel bis zu Podcast-Beschreibungen, Speaker-Profilen und Präsentationsinhalten.
  • Du denkst Visuals, Präsentationen, Social Assets und einfache Foto-/Video-Formate mit und kannst kleinere Content-Produktionen selbst umsetzen oder sauber briefen.
  • Du sparrst mit unseren Corporate Creator*innen und dem C-Level zu Personal Brands, Thought Leadership, Themen, Tonalität und Formatideen.
  • Du betreust unseren Podcast redaktionell von Gäste-Recherche und Briefings bis zur Veröffentlichung und begleitenden Kommunikation.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass getpress über alle Touchpoints hinweg konsistent, hochwertig und markant auftritt, in Sprache, Look, Dramaturgie und Qualität.
  • Du beobachtest, wie unsere Inhalte performen, leitest daraus Learnings ab und bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir Formate, Kanäle und Botschaften weiterentwickeln.
  • Du repräsentierst getpress auch nach außen – auf Events, in Netzwerken und an den Stellen, an denen Marke durch echten Kontakt entsteht.

Wer du bist

Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Kommunikation, Brand, Content oder PR, idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld und in einer Agentur oder einem dienstleistungsnahen Kontext.

Außerdem macht dich folgendes aus:

  • Ein feines Gespür für Sprache, Tonalität und Qualität. Du erkennst schnell, wann ein Text, Auftritt oder Format wirklich sitzt.
  • Du denkst strategisch mit, verlierst dich aber nicht in Konzepten. Dein Ziel ist Sichtbarkeit schaffen.
  • Du hast LinkedIn, Organic Social und Personal Branding vollständig durchdrungen und weißt, wie man echte Markenwirkung erzeugt.
  • Du kannst Themen priorisieren, Kommunikationsmaßnahmen einschätzen und Redaktionspläne eigenständig strukturieren.
  • Ein gutes Auge für Design, Ästhetik und Brand Consistency, auch bei Slides, Social Assets, Website-Elementen und Event-Content.
  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Tools wie Canva und hast keine Berührungsängste mit Adobe Creative Cloud, Adobe Lightroom oder einfachen Editing-Workflows.
  • Du bringst Foto- und Video-Basics mit oder hast Lust, dich in einfache Inhouse-Content-Produktion einzuarbeiten.
  • Du arbeitest souverän mit KI-Tools und nutzt sie für bessere Recherche, Briefings, Struktur, Workflows, Varianten und Qualität, nicht als Abkürzung für generischen Content.
  • Du hast eine eigene Meinung, gibst klares Feedback und bringst dich im Sparring mit Team und C-Level aktiv ein, statt Aufträge nur abzuarbeiten.

Was dich erwartet

  • Volle Ownership: Du bist bei uns die einzige Person in dieser Rolle und gestaltest Brand und Content ohne Doppelstrukturen, mit direktem Draht zum C-Level.
  • Eine Rolle, in der du strategisch gestaltest und selbst umsetzt, und direkt siehst, welche Wirkung deine Arbeit hat.
  • Ein Umfeld, in dem Kommunikation als echter Faktor für Sichtbarkeit, Vertrauen und Relevanz gesehen wird.
  • Die Möglichkeit, neue Tools, Formate und Arbeitsweisen auszuprobieren – besonders an der Schnittstelle von Brand, Content und AI.
  • Ein Team, das ambitioniert, warm und beweglich ist und richtig Bock hat, Dinge voranzubringen.
  • Du wirst regelmäßig vor Ort in Berlin gebraucht – für Abstimmungen, Content-Produktion, Events und die enge Zusammenarbeit mit zentralen Stakeholdern. Gleichzeitig kannst du auch remote arbeiten. Wir setzen auf flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit viel Eigenverantwortung, klarer Kommunikation und Vertrauen.
  • Gehalt: 60.000–70.000 € brutto jährlich

Wie gehts weiter?

Wenn sich das nach deinem nächsten Schritt anfühlt, dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf oder LinkedIn-Profil, relevante Arbeitsproben oder ein Portfolio.

Uns interessiert nicht nur, was du gemacht hast. Sondern vor allem auch, wie du denkst, wie du Qualität einschätzt und welches Gefühl du für starke Kommunikation mitbringst.

title: Senior Communicatie Adviseur
descriptionHtml:
Senior Communicatie Adviseur

Almere | 32–40 uur per week | HBO/WO | €5.300 – €6.200

Wil jij werken op het snijvlak van strategie, merk en groei? Krijg je energie van het bouwen aan sterke merken, het adviseren van directies én het zichtbaar maken van impact? Dan is dit jouw volgende stap.

Als Senior Communicatie Adviseur speel jij een sleutelrol in hoe onze merken naar buiten treden – én hoe we intern verbonden blijven. Je werkt voor meerdere labels binnen onze groep en zorgt dat strategie niet op papier blijft staan, maar voelbaar wordt in alles wat we communiceren. Eigenaarschap nemen over communicatievraagstukken en knopen door durven hakken, ook als belangen uiteenlopen, vind je geen probleem. Je beweegt je makkelijk in een omgeving met veel stakeholders, strakke deadlines en uiteenlopende belangen.

Wat ga je doen als Senior Communicatie Adviseur?

Je komt terecht in ons Marketing & Communicatie team van elf enthousiaste collega’s. Je bent hét aanspreekpunt voor interne & externe communicatievraagstukken voor de directe collega’s, voor alle bedrijven binnen de MSPS Groep en de overkoepelende groep. Je zorgt voor consistente, heldere en doelgroepgerichte communicatie die de reputatie en positionering van elk merk versterkt, terwijl je synergie en efficiency bewaakt.

Een dag uit jouw werkweek: ’s Ochtends adviseer je een directie over de positionering van een label. Daarna werk je aan een campagne met marketingcollega’s. ’s Middags schaaf je aan content die écht converteert. En tussendoor zorg je dat alles klopt: boodschap, timing, kanaal en impact. Geen dag is hetzelfde. Wel altijd betekenisvol.

Dit is waar jij het verschil maakt

Jij zorgt dat communicatie en marketing elkaar versterken en commercieel bijdragen aan groei.

  • Je vertaalt organisatiedoelen naar krachtige communicatie- en marketingverhalen.

  • Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt merkpositionering en tone of voice.

  • Je creëert content die klopt – inhoudelijk sterk én commercieel slim.

  • Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen strategie, creatie en stakeholdermanagement.

Je weet je advies stevig neer te zetten en blijft koersvast, ook als belangen uiteenlopen of de druk toeneemt. Of het nu gaat om een campagne, een directievraagstuk, een reputatie-issue of een interne verandering: jij zit aan het stuur.

Waarom deze rol aantrekkelijk is

  • Echte invloed: je bent sparringpartner van directies en management.

  • Meerdere merken, één speelveld: afwisseling, complexiteit én schaal.

  • Van denken naar doen: jij bedenkt niet alleen, je realiseert.

  • Zichtbare impact: jouw werk zie je terug bij klanten, medewerkers en media.

  • Ruimte voor ondernemerschap: initiatief wordt gezien én gewaardeerd.

Wie ben jij?

  • Een ervaren professional met commerciële scherpte en strategisch overzicht die stevig in de schoenen staat. Je brengt het volgende mee:

  • Afgeronde HBO/WO-opleiding in Communicatie, Marketing of een vergelijkbaar;

  • Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in een (middel)grote organisatie;

  • Sterk in stakeholdermanagement en taal;

  • Strategisch denker met een hands-on mentaliteit;

  • Digitaal vaardig en data bewust;

  • Gedreven om merken te laten groeien.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Salaris tussen de €5.300 en €6.200 (o.b.v. 40 uur);

  • Een afwisselende functie met veel ruimte voor initiatief;

  • Thuiswerkbudget & -vergoeding;

  • Minimaal 26 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. 40 uur) + flexibele feestdagen;

  • Ruim opleidingsbudget en doorgroeimogelijkheden;

  • Pensioenregeling met lage werknemersbijdrage;

  • Extra’s zoals een workation.

Wie zijn wij?

MSPS Groep B.V. (Medical Software & Processing Services) bestaat uit meerdere bedrijven die zich inzetten om de zorg efficiënter en menselijker te maken. Jaarlijkse ondersteunen we duizenden zorgverleners in o.a. mondzorg, farmacie, GGZ en specialistische zorg – met meer dan 400 collega’s die iedere dag het verschil maken.

Meer informatie vind je op www.mspsgroep.nl.

Het eerste gesprek is met je toekomstige leidinggevende en een teamlid, gevolgd door een tweede gesprek met een MT lid. Voor deze functie is een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) vereist.

title: (Senior) Consultant (m/w/d) SAP BusinessObjects
descriptionHtml:
Seit über 25 Jahren verwandeln wir bei der Windhoff Group Daten in echte Geschäftschancen – von klassischer Business Intelligence bis zur KI-getriebenen Automatisierung. Dabei denken wir ganzheitlich: Wir begleiten unsere Kunden End-to-End, von der Strategie über die technische Umsetzung bis zum produktiven Betrieb. Ob BI-Reporting, Data Warehousing, Predictive Analytics oder KI-Lösungen – unser Anspruch ist es, aus Daten messbaren Mehrwert zu machen.

Als Teil unseres Teams wirst du gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen an anspruchsvollen Projekten arbeiten und dich in der gesamten Data & AI-Landschaft in die Richtung weiterentwickeln, die zu dir passt.

Warum solltest du jetzt bei Windhoff starten?

Windhoff wird in der aktuellen Lünendonk®-Studie 2025/2026 explizit als einer der 20 führenden Anbieter von Data & AI Services in Deutschland genannt. Getragen wird unser Wachstum von unserem Gesellschafter Aurelius, einem globalen Private-Equity-Investor, der seit 2023 an der Windhoff Group beteiligt ist. Unser SAP-Kerngeschäft bauen wir dabei gezielt zu einer Multi-Vendor-Strategie aus – mit Databricks, Snowflake, Dremio sowie den Cloud-Plattformen Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud und AWS (u. a. Amazon Athena). Du profitierst von einem Marktumfeld, das deutlich stärker wächst als der klassische IT-Dienstleistungsmarkt – und von einem Unternehmen, das dieses Wachstum aktiv mitgestaltet, statt nur zu verwalten.

Neben unserer fachlichen Expertise sind wir ein Arbeitgeber, der Vielfalt fördert und sicherstellt, dass alle Mitarbeitenden fair behandelt werden. Teile
uns mit, wenn wir auf etwas besonders Rücksicht nehmen sollen - wie zum
Beispiel auf bestimmte Arbeitszeiten oder andere Rahmenbedingungen, deine
Situation im Privatleben oder besondere Bedürfnisse bei der Arbeit.

Klingt nach einem Traumjob? Dann jetzt Teil des Teams werden!

Aufgaben

  • Du startest mit einer strukturierten Einarbeitung – bei uns und beim Kunden. Erfahrene Kolleg:innen begleiten dich, bis du dich in der Systemlandschaft und den Fachbereichen sicher bewegst.

  • Du arbeitest nicht allein beim Kunden, sondern im Windhoff-Projektteam: Ihr unterstützt euch gegenseitig, teilt euer Wissen und löst knifflige Fragestellungen gemeinsam.

  • Du entwickelst gewachsene Data-Warehouse- und BI-Landschaften unserer Kunden weiter und sorgst für ihren stabilen Betrieb – im Frontend mit SAP BusinessObjects, im Backend mit SAP Data Services und Microsoft SQL Server.

  • Gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen wie Sales, Controlling oder Marketing nimmst du Anforderungen auf und setzt sie in Kennzahlen, Datenmodelle und Berichte um.

  • Du konzipierst und implementierst Datenmodelle (z. B. mit SAP PowerDesigner) und ETL-Strecken in SAP Data Services, pflegst Universen im Information Design Tool und erstellst Web-Intelligence-Berichte.

  • Im Application Management Support analysierst du Datenabweichungen über ETL, Universum und Bericht hinweg bis auf die Datenbank, findest die Ursache und behebst sie nachhaltig – vom 1st- bis zum 3rd-Level.

  • Du begleitest Vorhaben von der Anforderung über Test und Produktivsetzung bis zur Übergabe in den Betrieb.

  • Als Senior Consultant übernimmst du die Verantwortung für Teilprojekte und das Windhoff-Projektteam, schätzt Aufwände, stimmst Prioritäten mit Fachbereichen, Kunden-IT und weiteren Dienstleistern ab und unterstützt bei Presales- und Angebotsprozessen.

  • Du gestaltest die Modernisierung bestehender Landschaften mit, etwa die Überführung von Berichten nach Microsoft Power BI oder erste Machine-Learning-Anwendungen, und denkst im Sinne unserer Multi-Vendor-Strategie mit SAP als Kern mit.

  • Durch Wissenstransfer und interne Formate gibst du dein Wissen an Kolleg:innen weiter.

Qualifikation

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Data Warehousing und BI mit, idealerweise mit SAP BusinessObjects (Web Intelligence, Information Design Tool / Universe Design Tool) und SAP Data Services.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit SQL, insbesondere T-SQL auf Microsoft SQL Server; Kenntnisse in IBM DB2 oder Oracle sind ein Plus.

  • Du kennst relationale Datenmodellierung (Star Schema, gern auch Data Vault) und mehrschichtige DWH-Architekturen.

  • Du analysierst Daten mit Ausdauer und Struktur und behältst auch bei vielen Quellsystemen den Überblick.

  • Du sprichst gern mit Fachbereichen und übersetzt fachliche Fragestellungen in technische Lösungen.

  • Von Vorteil sind Erfahrung mit Microsoft Power BI und im IT-Betrieb nach ITIL. Branchenerfahrung setzen wir nicht voraus – Kenntnisse aus Handel, Automotive oder Dienstleistung sind gern gesehen.

  • Von Vorteil ist Erfahrung darin, agentische KI in deinen Arbeitsalltag und die Durchführung von Data-Engineering-Projekten zu integrieren. Dafür stellen wir dir ein modernes Toolset mit verschiedenen Integrationsmöglichkeiten rund um unseren SAP-Kern bereit.

  • Durch deine hohe Eigeninitiative und sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit bringst du deine Ideen sowohl intern als auch im Umfeld unserer Kunden erfolgreich ein. Hierfür sind verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (C1-Niveau) und gute Englischkenntnisse erforderlich.

Benefits

  • Wir stellen standortunabhängig ein. Du kannst größtenteils von zuhause aus oder an einem unserer Standorte arbeiten, wenn dieser für dich gut erreichbar ist. Zu gelegentlichen Kundenterminen und Teamevents startest du von deinem Lebensmittelpunkt aus, egal wo in Deutschland du wohnst.

  • Über 100 Data & Analytics Consultants zum Austausch sowie eine interne Weiterbildungsacademy

  • Langfristige Projekte mit wechselnden technologischen Herausforderungen

  • Ein festes Budget für Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsperspektiven

  • Eine gute Work-Life-Balance durch flexible Arbeitszeiten, Überstundenausgleich sowie bis zu 40 Tagen Urlaub

  • Sowohl erstklassige Hard- und Softwareausstattung als auch Leasingangebote für Firmenwagen, IT-Hardware und Fahrräder

  • Kurze Wege im Unternehmen, ein fairer Umgang miteinander sowie unterhaltsame Teamevents

Du verfügst über die gewünschten Erfahrungen und suchst eine neue Herausforderung? Du bist flexibel, lösungsorientiert und kommunikationsfähig?

Nutze deine Chance: Wir bieten das passende Umfeld für deine Karriere.

title: Senior Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:

Nice to have:

Soft Skills

title: Senior Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the role

Abound is changing the face of lending. Our data lake will change the pace and the way we operate. It will power most of the decisions we make, from credit and pricing to operations and finance, and it is the foundation of our AI future.

None of that works without data people can trust. Our data is our most valuable asset, and this role is its custodian. As our Senior Data Engineer, you will own the warehouse that turns raw data from underwriting, lending, open banking and finance into the facts the whole company runs on.

You will help shape that future. Through a semantic layer and natural-language-to-SQL tools, anyone at Abound will be able to ask a question in plain English and get a correct answer in seconds. You decide how the model is built, what it measures, and how AI uses it.

You will not start from a blank page. The first version of the warehouse is live, with real users and real problems to solve. This is an engineering role, not a SQL-only ETL job: you will write production Python and Spark, and work side by side with data science.

Responsibilities

  • Make the semantic layer and natural-language-to-SQL tools the way teams answer everyday questions. Define each metric with its business owner, and test that the tools return the agreed number.

  • Own the warehouse design and modelling standards, and approve every change to it.

  • Work with data scientists to turn their use cases into tested facts, dimensions and marts.

  • Move features from the application backend, and reports from QuickSight, onto the lake, and prove they match the originals.

  • Run and tune the Spark pipeline that feeds the warehouse, and fix performance bottlenecks in Spark and Athena.

  • Own data quality, reconciliation and PII handling, and keep Glue and Athena costs in check.

  • Mentor the engineers and analysts who contribute to the warehouse.

What we're looking for

You have owned a production warehouse before, and you can point to a dimensional model you designed and the decisions behind it. You write Python and Spark as confidently as SQL.

  • 5+ years in data engineering, with at least 2 owning the design of a production warehouse or lakehouse.

  • Proven dimensional modelling: conformed dimensions, fact grain, SCD2, and late-arriving or restated data. You can explain the trade-offs you made.

  • Experience making data usable by AI: a semantic layer such as MetricFlow, Cube or LookML, natural-language-to-SQL or LLM agents over governed data, and checking that their answers are right.

  • Strong dbt in production: incremental models, macros, tests and CI.

  • Strong PySpark and Python: tuning jobs with the Spark UI, and reimplementing application logic on Spark with tests that prove both agree.

  • Advanced SQL on a distributed engine, ideally Athena or Trino.

  • BI experience, ideally QuickSight, including moving report logic out of the BI tool and into the warehouse.

  • A track record of working with data scientists or analysts, turning loosely stated questions into models they trust.

Nice to have

These are not required, but they would let you take on data sourcing as well as the warehouse.

  • Apache Iceberg and AWS data services: S3, Glue, Athena, and IAM for data access.

  • AWS DMS for change data capture from Postgres and MySQL.

  • Infrastructure as code with AWS CDK in Python.

  • Ingesting third-party data over SFTP and APIs.

  • Lending, credit risk or financial services data.

What success looks like in the first 6 months

  1. Month 1: you can run and release every part of the pipeline without help.

  2. Month 3: you own warehouse changes and have a roadmap agreed with data science.

  3. Month 6: teams use the semantic layer and AI tools for everyday questions, with answers checked against agreed metrics. The first features and reports run from the lake.

Our Tech Stack:

Sources: PostgreSQL and MySQL application databases, SFTP and vendor feeds

Ingestion: AWS DMS (CDC), S3 bronze

Processing: AWS Glue (PySpark, Glue 5.1 and 6.0), Apache Iceberg silver

Warehouse: dbt Core with dbt-athena, Athena engine v3 (Trino), Glue Data Catalog

Semantic layer: dbt MetricFlow, served to AI assistants through an MCP server

BI: Amazon QuickSight

Infrastructure: AWS CDK (Python), GitLab CI

Languages: Python 3.12, SQL

What we offer

  • Everyone owns a piece of the company - equity

  • Hybrid with 3 days a week in the office

  • 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • One month paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Employee loan

  • Free gym membership

  • Team wellness budget to be active together - set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Database Observability, Grafana Cloud | Germany | Remote
descriptionHtml:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Spain and Germany.

About Grafana Cloud Observability

Grafana Cloud is our fully managed observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to use the best open source observability software, including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo, without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.

Within the Observability department, we build products that help customers understand and troubleshoot their applications and infrastructure. We work closely with product management, design and other engineering squads to provide seamless and highly curated experiences for our customers.

The squad: Database Observability

We build and evolve Grafana Cloud Database Observability. We want to help users understand the health and performance of their databases, identify slow queries and troubleshoot issues through clear, actionable insights.

As a frontend engineer on the squad, you’ll build experiences that make complex database telemetry easy to explore and understand. You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product management and design to take ideas from early exploration through to production and improve them based on customer feedback.

Our frontend stack is primarily TypeScript and React, interacting with backends written in Go. Your primary focus will be frontend engineering, with opportunities to work across the stack, contributing to APIs and backend functionality to deliver complete customer experiences. Frontend engineers at Grafana also have opportunities to contribute to open source communities.

The opportunity:

  • Own technical projects from problem framing through rollout, including getting user feedback and measuring whether what you shipped actually worked.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Product Design and backend engineers to build intuitive user experiences using clean, reusable components, contributing to supporting APIs and backend functionality where needed.
  • Mentor and collaborate with other engineers. Raise the engineering bar through code review, design feedback, pairing on hard problems, and writing that leaves the team better than you found it.
  • Participate in on-call for the software you help build, contributing to incident response and learning from incidents.
  • Provide technical support in customer escalations and help us identify areas of high friction to address.
  • Collaborate with other squads on shared dependencies, contribute to design proposals, and share the team’s work through demos and technical discussions.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

  • We highly value those who are intellectually curious, who default to transparency, possess a high bias towards action, and who are also kind and enjoy working as a team.
  • Strong frontend engineering experience, with experience across the stack. You have experience building and maintaining production web applications with React and TypeScript, and are comfortable contributing to backend services and APIs. You value maintainability, readability, automated testing and secure development practices.
  • Technical ownership. You have solid experience delivering complex projects, mentoring other engineers and helping teammates work more effectively. You communicate clearly in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.
  • You take responsibility for operating the software you have built. You have experience being on-call, supporting software in production, ensuring reliability and responding to incidents as needed.
  • You enjoy working on complex solutions, building production software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems with minimal supervision.
  • User focus and pragmatism. You break complex problems into short feedback loops: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate.
  • AI experience with a practical mindset. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully to improve productivity and quality, validate their output, and share useful practices with teammates.
  • You care about our community of users and contributors and are keen to be an active Grafana Community Contributor.

Bonus Points for 

  • Open-source contribution or maintainership, and comfort engaging a community in the open.
  • An active interest in observability (metrics, logs and traces) and experience with tools like Grafana, Prometheus or other observability platforms.
  • Experience with databases, SQL or database performance monitoring.
  • Experience building backend services in Go.
  • Experience as an on-call user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo in a previous role (or on a homelab).
  • Experience in a fully remote, globally distributed team.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Germany, the base compensation range for this role is €100,000 - €125,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (React / Typescript / Java)

Why this role matters

We are scaling our engineering team past 6+ developers and need an experienced, versatile full-stack builder who excels at frontend craft and rapid design prototyping. We design and iterate directly in Storybook before building, ensuring exceptional user experience before locking in our robust Java/Spring backend architecture. Your contributions will directly accelerate our product velocity and lift our frontend and design standards across the board.

What you'll own

End-to-end feature delivery, rapid UI prototyping, and full-stack development across our core platform.

  • Rapidly prototype, iterate, and refine UI designs in Storybook before building production code.

  • Design, build, and ship polished frontend experiences using React, TypeScript, and modern design systems.

  • Build robust, scalable backend services and APIs using Java and Spring Boot.

  • Collaborate closely with the CTO and senior developers on domain modeling (DDD/Arc42), testing (TDD/BDD), and heavy execution.

  • Leverage AI-agent pairing workflows and modern CI/CD automation on Azure and Kubernetes to maximize development velocity.

Your first 90 days

  • Month 1: Ramp up on our product domain, explore our Storybook setup, and deliver your first rapid UI prototypes and production-ready contributions.

Who you are

  • ~7+ years of software engineering experience delivering robust, production-grade applications.

  • Strong product and visual design sensibility with deep hands-on expertise in React, TypeScript, and Storybook.

What you'll get

  • High autonomy to shape product design, iterate rapidly in Storybook, and influence architecture.

  • Direct collaboration and high trust alongside the CTO and senior peers in a flat setup.

  • Modern AI-agent pairing workflows that supercharge individual delivery and eliminate busywork.

This probably isn't for you if...

  • You prefer pure backend work and dislike hands-on UI design, prototyping in Storybook, or frontend craft.

  • You prefer purely remote work and do not want regular face-to-face collaboration in Munich.

Let's talk

If you are an experienced builder who thrives on fast-paced UI prototyping, modern frontend craft, and robust backend engineering in a flat team, let's talk. Apply with a link to your GitHub, Storybook, or design work to start the conversation.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

Team's mission

Upvest's core product is an API: the execution layer that moves securities for our clients. Upfront extends into the layer above it. It's Upvest's operational service panel for enterprise clients, giving their operations, support and compliance staff the ability to handle first-line requests themselves: looking into an end-user's account, checking what happened to an order, answering the question in front of them. Today their options are to ask Upvest support or to build a service panel of their own, which most of them won't do.

Our mission is to prove that financial institution customers can replace their fragmented operations with Upfront. That case isn't settled yet, and this team is the one making it. Our users do this work all day, so a clumsy interface is how a task turns back into a ticket for us. Our clients are already asking what AI can do for their operations teams. Agentic operations, exposed over MCP, is where we think this goes. What it should look like in Upfront is still open, and we'd like the person in this role to help define it.

Upfront is part of the Clients Tribe at Upvest. Together with the Public API and Tooling Apps teams we enable Upvest’s business to scale efficiently, accelerate our client’s time-to-market and embed intelligence and automation into client processes.

Your mission

You’ll focus on building what actually creates value for our clients. While our OKRs set the destination, we expect you to help map the route. We prioritize impact and shipping speed over a perfectly groomed backlog. Because you're on a client-facing team, the quality of your output directly impacts client trust – especially since we are handling their customers' money.

In our domain, the bar is high: anything touching client funds must be correct and auditable, or it's an incident. We will give you the client context, access, and autonomy to figure out what needs building, rather than just handing you a rigid spec. We also expect you to challenge our internal processes if they are slowing down your efficiency or shipping speed.

What you’ll do:

  • Take operational problems from concept to production, working across our React/TypeScript frontend and Go backend services.

  • Own modern interface security. Upfront is where external users act on real end-user data, so you will tackle per-client isolated environments, least-privilege access, and Auth0 integrations in a regulated space.

  • Expand the operational surface across Upvest's internal domains and develop a deep understanding of how our core systems piece together.

  • Help define how software delivery works in an AI-enabled company by pushing AI tooling to its limits to maximize quality and speed while staying compliant.

  • Build agentic operations as we move toward exposing Upfront over MCP. Every action requires a strict audit trail, so you will solve real design problems around what an agent can do autonomously versus what requires human intervention.

  • Work in weekly cycles with bi-weekly retrospectives to prioritize high-quality, high-frequency shipping.

     

What you bring:

  • A strong product engineering mindset where you care about the "why" just as much as the "how" and proactively bring ideas to the table.

  • Solid backend experience in Go, Java, or Kotlin (we build in Go but will give you time to ramp up).

  • Practical experience building modern client-facing interfaces using React and TypeScript.

  • Experience building products that require per-customer configuration without devolving into a custom fork per client.

  • Deep knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security best practices.

  • A strong focus on quality, extensibility, and automated testing.

  • True end-to-end ownership across containers, CI/CD pipelines, and relational data modeling.

  • A working understanding of event-driven architectures.

  • A pragmatic approach to engineering and the ability to make smart tradeoffs under constraints.

  • Real-world experience using AI tools to drive software engineering workflows, not only writing code snippets .

  • The ability to navigate undefined problems and align other teams without needing formal authority.

     

It’s great if you have:

  • Experience with Investment products or the Fintech domain, in general.

  • Experience building operational or back-office tooling for business users.

  • Experience with identity platforms such as Auth0, or with multi-tenant isolation.

  • Experience with operating services in a decoupled, event-driven system, leveraging modern observability tooling (e.g. monitoring and tracing).

     

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Senior-Level. Unsere Kunden brauchen Leute, die ab Tag eins liefern und eigenständig arbeiten.

Du musst nicht alles können. Wichtig ist, dass du auf beiden Seiten sicher bist und dich schnell in neue Stacks reinfindest.

AI-Tools sind Pflicht, kein Bonus

Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor: Damit musst du produktiv arbeiten können. Nicht weil wir hip sein wollen, sondern weil unsere Kunden das erwarten und wir auch so arbeiten. Wenn du AI-Tools für einen Hype hältst und lieber alles selbst tippst: falsche Firma. Intern investieren wir in deine AI-Skills.

Lebenslauf reicht. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage.

title: Senior HPC Engineer, GPU Compute
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior HPC Cluster Engineer to join our team and play a key role in the development of our cutting-edge hyperscaler platform. The GPU & InfiniBand team is responsible for enhancing and optimizing the core components of our Cloud platform, with a specific focus on GPU computing, InfiniBand networks, and the KVM/QEMU stack. You’ll work closely with hardware virtualization and device emulation technologies, ensuring high performance and security in multi-GPU, HPC environments. The role involves analyzing, troubleshooting, and improving infrastructure to support new hardware, fine-tuning system performance, and automating fault detection and resolution in a complex system.

In this position, you will be responsible for:

  • Tuning the performance of GPU clusters and InfiniBand networks to ensure optimal operation in HPC and GPU-based environments. 
  • Analyzing and troubleshooting the root cause of issues related to GPUs and InfiniBand networks, and proposing corrective actions. 
  • Integrating new hardware into the existing infrastructure, including support for new GPU hardware through software stacks like Kubernetes, QEMU, and KVM. 
  • Enhancing automation systems for proactive monitoring, detecting, and resolving issues in GPU and InfiniBand environments. 
  • Configuring and managing GPU devices and InfiniBand fabrics, ensuring efficient and reliable operation.

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in system-level software development (focused on performance optimization, low-level programming). 
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Linux systems (administration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning). 
  • In-depth understanding of server architecture, including PCIe devices, NICs, Linux OS/Kernel, and high-performance computing (HPC) systems. 
  • Strong proficiency in one or more performance-oriented programming languages (C/C++, Go, Python).

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Experience with GPU end-to-end testing in a cluster environment using InfiniBand networking. 
  • Proven track record of analyzing and optimizing the performance of HPC workloads (e.g., simulations, data analysis, AI/ML workloads). 
  • Familiarity with RDMA, RoCE, and InfiniBand protocols for high-performance communication. 
  • Background in Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and experience with HPC cluster networking. 
  • Understanding of QEMU/KVM virtualization and managing virtualized environments. 
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow, and their integration with HPC systems. 
  • Familiarity with collective communication libraries like MPI and NCCL for distributed computing. 

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.
