title: Senior HR Adviseur
descriptionHtml:
Maak impact op HR, organisatie en medewerkers

Wil jij als Senior HR Advisor complexe HR-vraagstukken vertalen naar praktisch en toekomstgericht HR-beleid? En krijg je energie van adviseren, verbeteren én zelf de handen uit de mouwen steken?

Bij Priva werk je nauw samen met onze HR Business Partners, HR Director en HR Operations-collega's. Je bent een ervaren sparringpartner voor het HR-team en de business en draagt bij aan complexe HR-casuïstiek, organisatieontwikkeling en strategische HR-projecten.

Je combineert een brede HR-expertise met een praktische aanpak. Van arbeidsrecht en verzuim tot HR-processen, beleid, data en systemen: jij weet wat er nodig is om onze HR-dienstverlening continu te verbeteren.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior HR Advisor:

  • adviseer je over complexe HR-vraagstukken, arbeidsrecht, verzuim, arbeidsvoorwaarden en organisatieveranderingen;

  • ondersteun je HR Business Partners en management bij individuele en collectieve HR-casuïstiek;

  • draag je bij aan strategische HR-projecten rondom onder andere cultuur, organisatieontwikkeling, transformatie en HR-beleid;

  • vertaal je HR-strategie en wet- en regelgeving naar duidelijke en werkbare processen en oplossingen;

  • werk je samen met HR Operations aan een professionele en efficiënte HR-dienstverlening;

  • analyseer en verbeter je HR-processen en systemen;

  • zet je HR-data en technologie in om betere beslissingen en procesverbeteringen mogelijk te maken;

  • werk je actief met HR-systemen zoals AFAS en kijk je verder dan alleen de gebruikerskant om processen slimmer in te richten.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren HR-professional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie, advies en uitvoering. Je hebt een stevige inhoudelijke HR-basis, maar kijkt tegelijkertijd verder: waar kunnen processen beter, welke impact heeft een verandering op de organisatie en wat hebben managers en medewerkers nodig?

Je bent kritisch wanneer dat nodig is, praktisch wanneer het kan en weet verschillende stakeholders mee te nemen in veranderingen.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld HRM, Human Resource Management, Bedrijfskunde of Arbeidsrecht;

  • circa 2 tot 6 jaar relevante HR-ervaring, bijvoorbeeld als Senior HR Advisor, HR Adviseur of in een vergelijkbare brede HR-rol;

  • gedegen kennis van het Nederlandse arbeidsrecht en sociale wetgeving;

  • ervaring met complexe HR-casuïstiek, zoals verzuim, reorganisaties en arbeidsvoorwaarden;

  • ervaring met strategische HR-projecten, beleidsontwikkeling of organisatieverandering;

  • het vermogen om strategisch te adviseren én betrokken te blijven bij de operationele HR-praktijk;

  • affiniteit met HR-technologie, HR-data, AFAS en procesoptimalisatie;

  • uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal;

  • beschikbaarheid van 32 tot 40 uur per week.

Wat bieden wij?
In cijfers:

  • Een bruto salaris tussen €4.000,00 en €5.000,00 o.b.v. 40 uur per week (op basis van je ervaring);

  • Een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé vinden wij belangrijk: 30 vakantiedagen per jaar en de mogelijkheid om meer bij te kopen;

Voor je eigen duurzaamheid:

Klaar om jouw HR-expertise in te zetten én écht invloed te hebben op hoe we HR binnen Priva verder ontwikkelen? Breng je strategische blik, praktische aanpak en verbetermentaliteit mee en bouw samen met ons aan een HR-organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst.

Solliciteer als Senior HR Advisor en maak het verschil vanaf dag één.

title: Senior Integration Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Integration Software Engineer to bring our algorithms and software backend together into reliable, operational solutions, and to take technical ownership of how our software is integrated.

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who enjoys building clean, reliable interfaces between components and working where software meets hardware, and who takes ownership of making complex systems work together end to end.

As a Senior Integration Software Engineer, you will support their integration into operational systems: connecting algorithms to the backend through robust APIs, building data connectors, health reporting and control software, and defining and verifying integrations with Command and Control (C2) systems.

You will work closely with domain experts in acoustics, signal processing and machine learning, and with the software engineering team, and hands-on with our monitoring systems at our headquarters and production facility. You will also take technical ownership of work delivered by internal and external engineers and set the standard for good engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably.

  • Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components.

  • Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable.

  • Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery.

  • Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests.

  • Testing & debugging: Develop system-level test suites and CI/CD pipelines, diagnose communication failures, and ensure secure, reliable data transfers as the toolbox and backends evolve.

  • Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers.

  • Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits.

  • Review the work of junior engineers and external development partners in depth, promote good practices for packaging, versioning and release, and share integration knowledge across the team.

Why Join Us?

  • Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

  • Fresh team lunches provided 5 times/week.


Qualifications:

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

  • Significant professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on system integration, backend or platform development.

  • Extensive experience developing production software in Python, including packaging, testing, dependency management and writing maintainable, well-structured code.

  • Familiarity with systems programming in C++, or Rust, for the purpose of extending Python for more performance or hardware control.

  • Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and messaging interfaces (e.g. MQTT, WebSocket) and data serialization (e.g. protobuf).

  • Experience with realtime data pipelines, and handling high-throughput or streaming data.

  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD and automated testing in a Linux environment.

  • Experience working with software that interacts with physical systems, and comfort doing hands-on integration and troubleshooting in a lab or production environment.

  • Experience reviewing code and designs, mentoring junior engineers, and setting engineering standards.

  • An outcome-focused mindset, with the ability to own a problem end to end or break it down for others.

  • Ability to work with algorithm developers and translate research code into robust, maintainable software.

  • Flexible and proactive in taking on what needs to be addressed, and comfortable in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

  • Good communication skills in English and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external partners.

  • Willingness to work primarily from our Amsterdam headquarters, as parts of the role involve classified information and physical systems.

Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of defense systems or defense standards (e.g. NATO STANAGs, MIL-STD), for example in naval, maritime security or surveillance systems.

  • Experience with the scientific Python stack (e.g. NumPy, SciPy) or integrating signal processing or ML models into production systems.

  • Experience developing software interfaces for controlling instruments or devices.

  • Experience with other messaging or streaming frameworks (e.g. Kafka, ZeroMQ, DDS).

  • Familiarity with observability tooling.

Security & Compliance:

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

title: Senior Manager AI Content
descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 (Kijimea Reizdarm). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.

Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Mission bei uns

Du willst in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen Europas die Zukunft der Content-Erstellung mit generativer KI gestalten? Du hast Freude daran, intelligente Workflows, Prompts und Agents aufzusetzen und mit ihrer Hilfe hochwertigen Content für eine der führenden Gesundheitsmarken Europas zu entwickeln? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
The role

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognized as the go-to expert on cost across the team.

What you’ll do

  • Develop a harmonized cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.
  • Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.
  • Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalization and consolidation opportunities.
  • Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.

You are...

  • An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership.
  • Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging.
  • A clear communicator who turns complex analysis into a simple story that regional teams can act on.
  • Collaborative: you build alignment with Finance, procurement, and market teams through influence rather than authority.
  • Self-directed: you manage several analyses at once and take ownership from the question through to the recommendation.

You have...

  • 5+ years in procurement, cost analysis, or consulting in a global food, retail, or consumer goods business.
  • Hands-on experience building should-cost models or total cost of ownership frameworks, and using them to influence real commercial decisions.
  • Experience measuring cost and savings across multiple markets, including the common pitfalls such as inconsistent methods, inflation effects, and volume mix.
  • Experience with food, ingredient, or packaging categories, including origin, certification, and specification considerations.
  • Fluent in English. Bonus if fluent in French, German, or Dutch. Comfortable working across time zones, with the ability to travel up to 20%.

Nice to have...

  • Familiarity with sustainability certification schemes and their cost implications.
  • Experience with commodity price risk or hedging frameworks.

  • Flexible working arrangements and generous vacation and parental leave in line with local market practice

  • Annual learning & development budget

title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, DashOS EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

DashOS is DoorDash's merchant technology platform. It brings together the products restaurants and local businesses use to run their own business, sell on their own channels and keep their guests coming back, including online ordering, websites and apps, and loyalty. DashOS connects these tools with the demand and growth learnings of the DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo marketplaces, so merchants can grow both on our marketplaces and on their own channels.

In EMEA, we are building DashOS market by market. The team is small and works like a startup within the larger DoorDash. When joining DashOS, you will help shape a new business from an early stage: what we offer merchants to fuel their growth, how we take it to market and how we support merchants once they are live.

Our Strategy & Operations team builds the DashOS business end to end in EMEA: what we focus on, how we measure success, and the playbooks that make growth repeatable. We work in small cross-functional pods that find improvement opportunities, launch and iterate, together with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Legal, Marketing, our merchant and consumer teams.

About the Role

We are now looking for a Senior Manager, Revenue Operations to build the commercial engine behind DashOS. You will own the systems, numbers and operating rhythm that turn a multi-product strategy into predictable revenue, across all DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo markets in EMEA.

What you'll be doing

As the Senior Manager, Revenue Operations for DashOS EMEA, you will partner directly with DashOS commercial leadership to co-own the go-to-market plan and run the operating cadence for the sales and account management teams selling DashOS. This is a senior individual contributor role for a builder: you will set up the tracking and planning foundations, then use them to make the sales organisation measurably better.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

  • Build the revenue tracking infrastructure: own our CRM setup and the data flows into our BI stack, so pipeline, activities and revenue for every DashOS product live in one place
  • Run the commercial operating cadence, including pipeline tracking, pacing and weekly forecasting with sales and account managers, and own the DashOS commercial narrative to EMEA leadership
  • Own sales planning across markets: set targets and quotas through bottom-up and top-down allocation, and design books of business, territories and coverage models that match our growth goals
  • Turn sales performance data into action by building dashboards that act as the single source of truth for account-level performance and risk, and surfacing insights that managers and sellers can act on
  • Design and roll out incentive systems, including MBOs, SPIFFs and variable compensation, together with Finance, so sales and account managers own DashOS revenue alongside marketplace revenue
  • Make DashOS part of the core commercial motion, so it shows up in every account manager's book of business, account plans and business reviews rather than running on the side
  • Automate and scale with AI, removing manual work for sellers and managers (e.g. pre-populated account plans, automated pipeline views) so teams spend their time with merchants

Our humble expectations

  • Significant experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy & Operations or a similar commercial role, ideally in a fast-growing tech company. A management consulting background is a plus.
  • A track record in sales planning: quota and target setting, territory and book-of-business design, and forecasting cadences for a multi-market sales organisation.

title: Senior Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
What We’re Building

Cello helps businesses turn their users into their best acquisition channel. Our product is the easiest way to embed user and partner referrals directly into the products you love to use. With just a few lines of code, a company is set up for hyper growth that runs on autopilot instead of spending money on ads.

Teams at Bolt, Miro, Typeform, VEED, and Descript already run their referral programs on Cello. which is proof that word-of-mouth can be engineered as a real growth channel, not being a nice to have.

We're a small, remote-first team that builds infrastructure that lives in other people's products. That means our bar for craft and attention to detail is exceptionally high. Our UI has to feel native inside other people's products that we don't control, our components have to hold up wildly across different use cases, and our decisions get scrutinized by the world's best growth, design and engineering teams. So in addition to caring deeply about how things look and feel, we need people who can think in systems, tracing how a decision plays out across different user segments and across levels of the product.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to work closely with our founding designer, product and engineering teams on the core Cello experience. You'll be involved in every aspect of the product design cycle and expected to take ownership of the work end-to-end.

This role is fully remote but your work schedule needs to overlap comfortably with a European work day. We're an async-first culture that values deep focused work, but we still make time to get together in person at regular team off-sites.

What you will do

  • Partner directly with our founding designer, product and engineering teams to take projects on our roadmap from rough problem to shipped solution.

  • Look for opportunities to improve our existing product areas. Sometimes that's a full rethink of how something works, others itʼs fixing smaller quality issues you pick up in the product.

  • Help define and improve our evolving design system.

  • Bring our brand to life across marketing, social and launch content.

  • Design mockups and prototypes in low and high fidelity to communicate ideas and how things might work.

  • Be part of and contribute to a growing design culture that's still taking shape.

  • Sweat the details that make embedded UI feel trustworthy.

What we are looking for

  • Solid and proven software design experience

  • Youʼve ideally designed software for SaaS businesses, but we also love to see range in the type of products youʼve worked on.

  • Breadth of craft: Youʼre able to comfortably flex across visual design, product thinking, brand, and interaction design.

  • Systems thinking: you can design components and patterns while thinking about how they fit into the broader system, but you also know when to push past convention and innovate.

  • Courage to challenge ideas, try new things and push a product direction forward.

  • Fluency designing in Figma and other prototyping tools. You also experiment regularly with new tooling.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills. We have an async work culture.

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment, where the stakes are high and priorities can shift quickly. Bonus points if you have both in-house (especially at a startup) and agency experience.

What we offer:

  • Remote-first, Europe-based (but must be within CET +/-3 hours)

  • Competitive salary + eVSOPS

  • Backed by leading VCs like HV Capital, byFounders, Notion Capital


❤️ In the end, it’s all about the team and our culture. Understand why we love our job and see what it’s like to work at Cello in our People Playbook. We have some compelling perks and benefits.

title: Senior Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to help expand the breadth and depth of the 9fin platform.

You’ll join a cross-functional product and engineering team solving complex, high-value problems for professionals across global debt markets, spanning AI-powered workflows, financial data and analysis, transaction intelligence, document management, and other emerging product areas.

You’ll help shape products used by teams at leading investment banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisory businesses - sophisticated users working with large volumes of complex information, where speed, accuracy, and trust are critical.

It’s a chance to shape frontier AI-native products inside a company using technology to transform one of the world’s largest financial markets.

What you'll work on


Product & Design Strategy

  • Partner with customers, Product Managers, engineers, and subject matter experts to shape product vision and design strategy — not just how it looks, but how it works and why it matters.

  • Synthesise research, feedback, domain expertise, and data to frame clear problems, and translate complex financial workflows into intuitive product experiences.

  • Run discovery to understand what users need, how they work, and where technology can create real value.

  • Align your work to clear outcomes, manage competing priorities, and focus your effort where it has the most impact in high-precision environments.

Designing AI-Native Workflows

  • Design interfaces that help users explore, understand, and act on AI-generated insights and complex datasets.

  • Translate model outputs into clear, trustworthy interfaces — with source attribution, confidence, transparency, and appropriate user control.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on feedback loops and evaluation workflows to improve AI-powered experiences in production.

  • Spot opportunities to apply emerging AI capabilities to real customer problems, prototyping new patterns where no playbook exists yet.

Craft & Collaboration

  • Own design end-to-end — flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI that hold up across edge cases and complex data conditions.

  • Work as an embedded partner to Product, Engineering, Data, and subject matter experts.

  • Communicate design rationale clearly and bring stakeholders along, especially in new or ambiguous territory.

  • Contribute to and evolve the design system to support increasingly sophisticated, data-heavy, AI-driven workflows.

About you

This role will be a great fit if you are:

  • Comfortable with complexity: you’ve designed for sophisticated users or high-stakes domains (fintech, enterprise SaaS, data platforms, professional tools). Financial markets experience is useful but not required — curiosity matters more.

  • A systems thinker: you shape workflows, behaviours, and trust, not just screens, zooming from the big picture to the finest interaction detail.

  • Focused on trust and precision: you think in edge cases, error states, and ambiguity, especially where AI is involved.

  • AI-native in how you work: generative AI is a natural part of your process, from research to prototyping to stress-testing ideas.

  • A natural prototyper: you find the fastest way to make an idea tangible, whether that’s AI tools, Figma, code, or a pencil sketch.

  • Energised by a blank page: you thrive defining something new and iterating quickly through ambiguity.

  • A strong communicator: you run discovery interviews, facilitate workshops, and know when to challenge, align, or move a team forward.

  • Skilled in your craft: fluent in Figma, comfortable choosing the right fidelity, and experienced contributing to a design system.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

Time off

Training & Culture

The Role

CreateFuture are looking for a collaborative and pragmatic Lead Product Manager to join our growing team and help us define and develop an exciting array of products over a variety of industries, technologies and domains.

Our Product Managers are responsible for working with senior leadership, our internal design and engineering teams and our clients to help define and implement product strategies that are consistent with our clients’ vision. This can be from early stage research and market analysis through to development, delivery and iteration.

As we rapidly scale, we’ve identified an exciting opportunity for a Lead Product Manager to help support our growth. 

This person will be responsible for shaping and leading client engagements. We have a variety of clients across many industries all of whom look to us to provide leadership and guidance.  

You will rapidly gain their trust and guide them toward a valuable customer focused outcome. To do this you’ll use your deep understanding of product management methodologies and a consistent application of good practice. 

You will also be responsible for the wellbeing of a team of product managers. You will help embed good practice and coach your team in client management techniques and the application of product management. 

Does this sound like you? Do you have experience in developing Product Managers and a passion for the craft of Product Management? Do you have an empathetic leadership style with a focus on coaching each person to help grow their career and skills? If so, we’ve got a great role for you to stretch your wings and see what you’re really capable of.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Reporting into the Head of Product Operations and be able to represent the team as we grow
  • Leading a team of Product Managers and support recruitment 
  • Helping embed and support career progression pathways using our development framework for personal growth
  • Providing support to the team through mentorship and coaching
  • Acting as an escalation point for the team, helping to remove internal and external blockers as needed
  • Supporting resourcing of Product Managers on projects
  • Identifying training and development needs
  • Lead clients through their digital transformation journey, ensuring long term lasting relationships are made with key decision-makers
  • Working with the team to improve, shape and structure the Product Management ways of working

About you

  • Passionate about Product Management as a discipline and keen to keep up to date on emerging trends, as well as experimenting with new tools and techniques
    • Recent relevant experience of leading product focused engagements 
    • Knowledge and experience of Product Management frameworks and approaches for continuous discovery and delivery
  • Have experience of product research and collecting evidence to support value propositions

  • Experience working within a digital transformation and AI consultancy, delivering technology solutions to enterprise clients.

  • Practical experience applying AI to products, services or delivery, with a good understanding of how AI can create value for clients.

  • Experience mentoring, coaching and developing Product Managers and supporting the growth of product capability.

  • Have experience of using data to help drive decisions and steer the direction of the product towards the client’s north star

  • Knowledge of web and mobile technologies and practices
  • Experience leading or supportingclient discovery, workshops and product strategy, translating business needs into digital solutions.
  • Be comfortable with ambiguity and help provide clarity in all situations   
We’re particularly interested in people who are curious about how AI is changing the craft of Product Management and are actively exploring what that means in practice.

Bonus points if you:
  • Have experience shaping or delivering AI-enabled products, services or propositions, from early discovery through to live products.
  • Understand the opportunities and limitations of LLMs, generative AI and agentic systems, and can translate these into meaningful customer and business outcomes.
  • Have experimented with AI-native product development, using AI to accelerate research, discovery, prototyping, analysis, documentation or decision-making.
  • Can identify where AI agents or automation could change a customer journey, business process or product experience, rather than simply adding AI features to an existing product.
  • Understand some of the new product considerations AI introduces — including evaluation, trust, human oversight, data, governance and responsible AI.
  • Are proactive about new AI capabilities, tools and ways of working, and enjoy helping others build their confidence and capability too.
You don’t need to arrive as an AI expert. If you haven’t yet had much opportunity to put AI into practice, that shouldn’t stop you applying. What matters to us is curiosity, a willingness to experiment and excitement about how AI is changing products and the craft of Product Management. Everyone at CreateFuture undertakes AI-native training, and we’ll support you to build these capabilities and put them into practice.

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

descriptionHtml:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

Core Experience shapes how millions of people discover, choose, and enjoy what to play on Spotify every day. Within Core Experience, our What to Play team builds the technology and shared capabilities that help Spotify deliver intuitive, reliable, and consistent listening experiences.

We're looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to shape the systems behind these experiences, from content distribution and mobile app architecture to shared user interface capabilities. You'll work closely with engineering and cross-functional partners to improve how Spotify works today while building flexible, scalable foundations for the future.

  • Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for your area, connecting technical investments to listener needs and Spotify's broader goals.
  • Partner with engineering teams to explore technical solutions, evaluate trade-offs, and guide decisions that improve product performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Develop shared platform capabilities that help teams build consistent, high-quality experiences across Spotify.
  • Improve the adoption and long-term value of platform capabilities by gathering feedback, measuring outcomes, and supporting teams that use them.

descriptionHtml:
tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 173 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.

With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.

Senior Product Manager – Devices (all genders)

This role may not be a great fit if...

  • You haven’t yet worked on consumer-facing connected devices. We need hands-on product management experience taking IoT or smart tech hardware to market, ideally end to end.

  • You prefer to work within clearly separated functions.
    This role looks beyond the device itself, to how it lands with customers and kids. Working closely with the other teams within the wider product function, collaboratively developing and delivering brilliant products.

  • You’re looking for established processes and formal tooling. We’re still building our infrastructure, and you’ll often be the one creating structure rather than stepping into it.

  • You prefer to be handed a roadmap. We need someone who spots what needs doing, picks it up independently and brings others along.

Your Role & Impact

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager – Devices to shape and evolve our connected consumer products, creating exceptional experiences that bring together hardware, software and digital services.

This is a senior individual contributor role with significant cross-functional leadership responsibility. You'll lead through influence, aligning multidisciplinary teams, driving decisions and ensuring that product ambitions translate into compelling, technically feasible and commercially successful products.

Working across engineering, design, digital, commercial and global development partners, you'll take a holistic view of the product experience, from the physical device and its connected ecosystem through to the way families interact with it every day.

We're looking for someone who combines deep connected consumer product experience, strong commercial judgement and the ability to lead complex product development in a matrix organisation.

What you'll do

  • Product vision and strategy: Own and evolve the product vision, strategy and roadmap for tonies devices, grounded in consumer insight, market opportunity and business objectives.

  • End-to-end product ownership: Lead product development from early exploration and concept validation through requirements, development, launch and ongoing optimisation.

  • Connected product experiences: Shape seamless consumer experiences across physical hardware, embedded software, connectivity, mobile applications and digital services.

  • Matrix leadership: Lead and influence cross-functional teams across hardware, software, engineering, design, operations and commercial functions, driving alignment, accountability and effective decision-making.

  • Product requirements and prioritisation: Translate consumer needs into clear, actionable product requirements, balancing customer value, technical feasibility, development complexity and commercial impact.

  • Commercial ownership: Develop compelling business cases and navigate product economics, including pricing, COGS, investment requirements and feature trade-offs.

  • Development partnerships: Work closely with internal engineering teams and external development and manufacturing partners to deliver against product requirements, quality standards and commercial objectives.

  • Go-to-market collaboration: Partner with Product Marketing, Brand and Commercial teams to ensure strong product positioning, compelling customer propositions and successful launches.

What You Bring

  • Significant product management experience in connected consumer electronics, IoT or software-enabled physical products, with demonstrable end-to-end product ownership.

  • Strong understanding of the interaction between hardware, firmware, connectivity, mobile applications and cloud-based services in delivering an integrated consumer experience.

  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary product teams within a matrix organisation, influencing senior stakeholders and driving decisions without direct reporting authority.

  • Experience developing product strategies, roadmaps and requirements that balance customer needs, technical complexity and commercial objectives.

  • Strong commercial acumen, including business case development, pricing, product costs and investment trade-offs.

  • Experience working closely with engineering teams and external development or manufacturing partners; ODM experience is advantageous.

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions and bringing clarity and structure to complex product decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical complexity into clear product direction and compelling narratives.

  • Collaborative, pragmatic and confident working across international teams and cultures.

  • Fluent English. German or Mandarin would be advantageous.

Location: Candidates must be based in the UK (London), Germany (Düsseldorf or Berlin) or France (Paris).

Why Join Us?

  • Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders. You’ll be part of a truly international community where every voice is heard.

  • Come as you are: This applies to the dress code and everything else. We believe you give your best when you feel truly comfortable being yourself.

  • Competitive Package: We offer a competitive salary and a range of comprehensive benefits tailored to your specific location, which we’ll share during the recruiting process.

  • Collaboration & Community: We’re big on "we." You’ll join a team that values connection and celebrates wins together, no matter the time zone.

  • Continuous Learning: Benefit from internal/external training and an individual learning budget to keep your skills as sharp as a Tonie’s ears.

  • Tonie Discounts: Enjoy attractive discounts on our entire range of products. You’ll quickly become the favorite guest at every birthday party!

  • Rest & Recharge: Great work requires a clear head. You’ll enjoy generous paid time off to ensure you have plenty of time for your own stories.

     

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faiths and genders. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Projectmanager
descriptionHtml:
Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

· Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%;

· Voordelen: Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer.

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀

title: Senior Sales Development Representative (UK)
descriptionHtml:
Coder is looking for a Senior Sales Development Representative (SDR) to fuel our growth by generating qualified pipeline for our Enterprise Account Managers. You’ll help bring Coder’s Environment-as-a-Service platform to some of the world’s largest companies that are adopting AI-driven development at scale.

This role is all about creating opportunities: finding and engaging the right prospects, uncovering the pain points Coder can help with, and setting up qualification calls that set our EAMs up for success. You’ll play a critical role in driving Coder’s outbound motion and helping large organizations build software faster, more securely, and at scale through the collaboration of AI coding agents and human developers.

 

What you’ll do here

  • Generate qualified opportunities for EAMs through targeted outbound prospecting

  • Conduct multi-channel outreach across phone, email, and LinkedIn using tools like SalesLoft, Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, 6sense, and Nooks

  • Research target accounts and key personas to craft personalized and value-driven messaging

  • Set up qualification calls for EAMs to run and advance through the sales cycle

  • Work closely with EAMs to strategize account outreach and hand off qualified opportunities seamlessly

  • Maintain accurate activity and lead data in CRM and engagement platforms

  • Collaborate with marketing to align messaging and campaigns to drive higher response rates

  • Stay sharp on developer tooling, platform engineering, and AI-driven development trends to speak credibly with prospects

 

What we’re looking for

  • 1-3 years in outbound SDR or BDR roles within SaaS or developer-focused technology companies

  • Proven ability to generate pipeline through outbound cold calling, emailing, and social selling

  • Experience with SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, 6sense, and similar prospecting tools

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to clearly articulate technical value propositions

  • Grit, curiosity, and the ability to handle rejection while maintaining a positive, proactive mindset

  • Highly organized and self-motivated with a focus on measurable goals and continuous improvement

  • Eagerness to learn about developer tools, DevOps, platform engineering, and AI workflows

 

Bonus tacos if you have

  • (Tacos? If you need an ice-breaker, ask how we say thanks by giving tacos!)

  • Prior experience selling into engineering or DevOps personas

  • Familiarity with AI and GenAI developer tools

  • Knowledge of open source ecosystems or cloud-native technologies

  • Experience collaborating closely with Account Executives in an enterprise sales motion

About Coder

Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. Coder provides self-hosted, agent-ready workspaces that unify developer productivity and platform governance. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at coder.com.

Interview process 

We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow. Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders.

AI use during the interview process

As an AI company, Coder embraces the use of AI tools, and we want to be transparent about our expectations as you navigate our interview process.

Not permitted: Using AI assistance during conversational interviews.

Permitted: Using AI tooling for take-home assessments. Please flag where and to what extent it was used in your take-home. Your submission will not be penalized for using AI as long as it is done honestly.

Our use of AI in hiring

We use AI tools to help manage our recruitment process efficiently and fairly. Specifically:

  • Ashby and Brainerr help us review inbound applications by surfacing candidates who best match the role requirements we've defined. This tool does not make hiring decisions; it helps our team prioritize which applications to review first.

  • Granola takes notes during our interview calls so our team can focus on the conversation with you.

All hiring decisions are made by humans. Our team reviews applications, conducts interviews, and makes final selections. AI tools assist us but never replace human judgment, and these practices are conducted in compliance with applicable data protection, AI governance, and labor laws. Your data is not used to train AI models.

In accordance with New York City Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on "Automated Employment Decision Tools"; results are available for Ashby.

If you're applying for a role at Coder and have questions about how we use AI in our process, or if you'd like to request information about the data we collect, please contact

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Senior Sales Engineer, DACH
descriptionHtml:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

  • Technical training - train the sales team on the technical aspects of our products to enhance their ability to sell more effectively.

  • Feedback loop - relay feedback from the field to our product and engineering teams, contributing to the ongoing improvement of our product.

  • RFP/RFI assistance - Assist in answering technical sections of RFPs and RFIs.

  • Post-sales support - On rare occasions, assist in post-sales processes to ensure the smooth implementation and satisfaction of our customers.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, cybersecurity, or a related field.

  • Advanced degree(s) are a plus.

  • 5+ years of experience as a Sales Engineer, ideally in the cybersecurity domain.

  • Strong understanding of cyber threats, risk management, and cybersecurity solutions.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Demonstrates ability to simplify complex technical topics for a non-technical audience.

  • Highly collaborative with a strong sense of initiative.

  • Communication skills - Business level German and fluency in English.

Travel Required

This job may require up to 50% of travel to be successful. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

  • Depending on experience, the compensation range for this position is: €160,000 - €190,000 OTE 70/30 split annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

title: Senior Security Architect - Enterprise & SaaS
descriptionHtml:
We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

 

The team

To sustain the company's growth, you'll join the Security Engineering team and will be the hands-on security architect for the applications and SaaS tools Ledger runs on: identity, collaboration, customer support, finance and the vendors behind them. You set the architecture standards, take on the hardest threat models yourself, and make sure data exposure through a vendor or an integration is found by us first.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead threat modelling and risk assessment of enterprise applications, SaaS tools and their integrations, hands-on, starting with the most critical tools and suppliers.

  • Set the security architecture standards and reusable patterns for enterprise systems: identity and SSO, access and least privilege, endpoints, network access, logging, data protection and integration tokens.

  • Review new applications, SaaS purchases and major changes at design stage, and agree the conditions for going live.

  • Design data masking and least-privilege access for customer support and customer-data tools.

  • Use offensive security techniques to challenge every design the way an attacker would, and work with the Red Team and external testers to validate it.

  • Turn findings into owned, dated actions, with the GRC team for the risk register.

  • Mentor the security engineers and help them grow into architecture work.

     
 

What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years in security engineering or architecture, including 5+ years in architecture and threat modelling for enterprise and cloud environments, and still hands-on.

  • Solid knowledge across the security disciplines: AWS, networking, endpoints, identity and access management (SSO, OAuth, OIDC), application and API security, and SaaS security.

  • Knowledge of offensive security techniques: how attackers abuse identities, integrations, tokens and endpoints, and how they move once inside.

  • Ability to challenge engineering and IT leads, and to be heard.

  • Fluent English is a must; French is a plus.

title: Senior Social Media Manager - 12 Month FTC (Maternity Cover)
descriptionHtml:
Frontier is an independent video game developer and publisher, crafting immersive gaming experiences with fun gameplay and unparalleled artistic quality. Renowned for its iconic creative management simulation games, Frontier captivates players worldwide with immersive and authentic game worlds. The modern studio is located in the vibrant technology hub of Cambridge (UK). The talented team at Frontier are dedicated to nurturing our existing portfolio and delivering our exciting future roadmap. This role is offered on a full in-studio basis or a hybrid basis (minimum 3 days per week in the studio). We can provide a comprehensive relocation support package as part of any offer, should you need to relocate.

WHAT'S THE ROLE?

We’re looking for a Senior Social Media Manager for a 12-month fixed term contract (Maternity Cover), who will provide senior operational ownership of our social media activity across multiple titles and channels. You will lead defined areas of social strategy, campaign planning and delivery, translating business and campaign requirements into clear channel plans, content priorities, and measurable outcomes. 

Working autonomously, you will coordinate social workstreams from brief through to delivery, provide senior guidance on channel activity and copy, support team best practice, and act as a key social media contact across Publishing and Development. You will use insights, social listening and performance data to improve activity, identify risks and opportunities, and inform decision-making.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Lead Frontier’s organic social strategy across X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube. 

  • Set channel plans aligned with brand, product, audience, and commercial goals. 

  • Maintain publishing standards and improve social processes and best practice. 

  • Own social workstreams across campaigns, launches, DLCs, live-service updates, and events. 

  • Turn campaign requirements into clear deliverables, timelines, priorities, and approvals. 

  • Own social content calendars and coordinate publishing across Frontier’s portfolio. 

  • Review social copy, content plans and channel activity to maintain quality and brand voice. 

  • Brief social-first assets and support reactive content, short-form video and event coverage where appropriate. 

  • Use social listening, audience insight and performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and risks. 

  • Coordinate with Product Marketing, PR and Communications, Influencer Relations, Community Management, Customer Support, Development and Creative Services. 

  • Represent social requirements in campaign planning and communicate plans, risks, and recommendations clearly. 

  • Build stakeholder buy-in and help resolve blockers or competing priorities. 

  • Coordinate day-to-day delivery, providing direction, support and mentoring to less experienced team members while sharing knowledge and developing team standards and capability.


    • WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Significant experience managing branded social media channels, ideally within games, entertainment, or another fast-moving consumer environment. 

  • Experience leading complex social campaigns through the full planning and delivery lifecycle across multiple channels and stakeholders. 

  • Strong experience developing and executing social media-led tactical plans and go-to-market strategies.

  • Strong project management capability, with the ability to define deliverables, manage dependencies, coordinate approvals, and protect deadlines. 

  • Excellent knowledge of X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube, including platform formats, audience behaviours and best practice. 

  • Excellent social copywriting, editing and proofreading skills, with strong judgement around brand voice, accuracy and audience context. 

  • Experience using social analytics, listening, and reporting tools to evaluate performance and turn insight into practical recommendations. 

  • Ability to identify emerging reputational or delivery risks and develop proportionate mitigation plans. 

  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders, gain buy-in and work effectively across functions and levels of seniority. 


    • BONUS IF YOU HAVE

  • Hands-on experience creating or editing reactive, short-form or social-first video and image content. 

  • Experience supporting event coverage, live activations or creator-led activity. 

  • Experience mentoring colleagues or helping to develop team standards, processes and capability. 

  • Experience working across a portfolio of products, franchises, or international channels. 

  • Strong understanding of gaming audiences, online communities and the role of social media across launches and live-service engagement. 

    • WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU

    You will work with talented and passionate people to support, develop or publish our sophisticated and enduring games, in a creative, collaborative and inclusive environment. We love what we do, and we work hard to provide outstanding experiences for our players.

    Wellbeing is a big focus at Frontier, and we are continually evolving how we can support our people. We encourage a healthy work/life balance and provide a range of wellbeing activities, initiatives and sessions to support both mental and physical health.

    We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes a success-based annual bonus, share option schemes, life assurance, private family healthcare, flexitime working hours, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, in-house subsidised catering, support with relocation, a Cycle to Work scheme, free bike servicing, and social activities and events.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Android
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo’s growth at scale.

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer - Android to join our London team. In this role, you’ll help us build and scale our world-class mobile applications, ensuring a seamless and high-performance experience for our global community of users.   • Partner with cross-functional disciplines (PMs, Experience Designers) to plan projects, assist with technical choices, and influence the team roadmap.

  • Own large-scale features from design to delivery, simplifying maintenance and promoting operational readiness across our production systems.

  • Support the growth of others by mentoring colleagues, encouraging efficiency, and taking an active role in our engineering hiring process.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Significant experience in building Android applications at scale, with a deep understanding of the Android SDK, AndroidX, and modern development tools like Android Studio.

  • Proven ability to scale Android architecture, delivering high-performance mobile experiences in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong proficiency in Kotlin and/or Java, with a keen interest in continuing to push the boundaries of what's possible with Kotlin.

  • Demonstrated ownership of technical delivery within cross-functional teams, guiding implementation choices and technical design.

  • A pride in software craft, with a commitment to writing readable, well-designed, and thoroughly tested mobile code.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide here to help you feel confident at each stage.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior Software Engineer, OS Integration
descriptionHtml:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, updater, and enterprise DLP support. 

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. In many cases work may be cross-platform or have a cross-platform component. This role will include maintenance and development of the installer and updater of Firefox. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

What you’ll do: 

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Contribute to new features and improvements.
  • Break down tasks and work with others to deliver solutions.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring: 

  • 5+ years of overall software engineering experience
  • Strong knowledge of C and C++
  • Experience with desktop application development on Windows, macOS, or Linux with C++.
  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript and HTML.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Play to win
    • Build for People first
    • Engage Evidence over Ego
    • Decide and Deliver
    • Ship, learn and repeat

Bonus Points for experience with:

  • Installer and/or Updater development on any OS
  • Windows internals like the BITS server or MSIX packages
  • Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.
